articleTitle: Review of Gravity Energy Storage Research and Development
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the grid-connected ratio of renewable energy growing up, the development of energy storage technology has received widespread attention. Gravity energy storage, as one of the new physical energy storage technologies, has outstanding strengths in environmental protection and economy. Based on the working principle of gravity energy storage, through extensive surveys, this paper summarizes various types of gravity energy storage technologies existing in the world and their development status. The advantages and shortcomings of different technologies are compared in depth , so as to provide reference for the development of gravity energy storage technology.

articleTitle: Distributed PV cluster partitioning strategy based on GAN data synthesis federation clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing scale of high-penetration distributed PV clusters in power systems, traditional PV sub-clustering methods can no longer meet the data privacy requirements of distributed PV multi-subjects. In this regard, this paper proposes a distributed PV cluster delineation framework based on federated learning synthetic clustering. Firstly, this paper addresses the data leakage problem of different distributed users in cluster partitioning by generating virtual data through a federated learning mechanism and GAN network. Secondly, the net load of distributed nodes, and the active and reactive regulation capacity of PV power supply are selected as the indexes for dividing PV clusters. Finally, a modularity function is used to measure the effectiveness of the distributed PV cluster partitioning results after considering data privacy protection. The simulation results show that the distributed PV cluster classification results obtained by the proposed method in this paper are highly reliable under the premise of privacy protection.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic MPPT Technique Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning Under Varying Irradiance Levels
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the traditional maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm for photovoltaic systems, such as poor tracking accuracy, long convergence time, large steady-state oscillation, and difficulty converging to the global maximum power point. This paper presents a reinforcement learning (RL) method based on a deep Q network (DQN) to improve and optimize the MPPT algorithm. In this method, the MPPT problem of photovoltaic systems is transformed into a Markov decision process (MDP), and the circuit composed of a photovoltaic cell and a DC-DC boost converter is set as the training environment. The DQN algorithm with continuous state and discrete action space is selected to train the environment. Through modeling and simulation in MATLAB/Simulink, the feasibility and effectiveness of this algorithm are proved under different solar irradiance variation levels. Compared with the perturbation and observation method (P&O) and incremental conductance method (INC), the tracking accuracy of this algorithm is significantly improved. Compared with particle swarm optimization (PSO) and grey wolf optimization (GWO), it is verified that the proposed algorithm can converge to the global maximum power point (GMPP) faster and has better steady-state performance under non-uniform solar irradiance.

articleTitle: Parameter tuning of new type energy virtual synchronous generator based on physics-informed reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the backdrop of the new type power system, the prevalence of new energy generation equipment and power electronic devices is rising. However, traditional power system analysis and parameter tuning methods are inadequate for this changing scenario. To address this, the paper proposes a reinforcement learning framework based on physical information guidance to adjust virtual synchronous generator parameters. This novel approach bridges the gap between traditional methods’ applicability and effectiveness in the new power system. It also improves interpretability by combining artificial intelligence with physical models. The method’s feasibility and efficacy are verified through IEEE-39 bus system simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Oriented Optimization of Integrated Energy System Considering Complex Coupling of Carbon and Hydrogen
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To satisfy the strategy of "carbon emission peak and carbon neutrality", integrated electricity-gas-heat energy system plays a crucial role as one of the most important support technology in the future. To fully employ the properties of green and low-carbon of hydrogen energy, this paper propose an integrated electricity-gas-heat energy system considering a complex cycle of carbon and hydrogen. Firstly, a flexible operation model of carbon capture and storage by using flue gas diversion and liquid storage tank is established. Secondly, a complex internal coupling model for carbon and hydrogen circulation is founded, including diverse hydrogen operational units such as hydrogen storage tank, hydrogen fuel cells, and hydrogen-enriched cogeneration, etc. There after, a low-carbon economic operation scheme for the aforementioned integrated energy system is proposed. GUROBI tool is then used to find the optimal operational solution of scheduling. By comparison analysis of different scenario conditions, it is demonstrated that the proposed integrated energy system could effectively reduce operational costs, enhance energy utilization efficiency, and improve the economic benefits by carbon reduction.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategies for Hydrogen Mixing Scheduling in Natural Gas Networks in Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Developing a clean and efficient Integrated Energy System (IES) is critical to optimizing the use of renewable energy sources and harnessing new forms of energy to achieve the country’s 2030 carbon peak and 2060 carbon neutrality targets. Existing natural gas pipelines in China facilitate the transport of hydrogen blended into the natural gas network and offer the possibility of storing hydrogen blended into natural gas pipelines. This paper proposes an optimal integrated energy dispatch strategy based on electricity-gas-hydrogen-heat-cooling demand, taking into account carbon emissions and economic efficiency, where renewable energy is no longer connected to the grid or stored in batteries, but converted to hydrogen mixed into the natural gas grid for transport and storage, with the economic objective of minimizing the total IES operating cost, the wind and light abandonment cost and the carbon emission cost. The CPLEX solver is used to solve the problem, and the feasibility of the proposed model is verified by simulation results, which promotes the consumption of renewable and clean energy.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy Systems Considering Master-slave Games and User Comfort
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Integrated energy system has significant benefits in improving energy utilisation, and gradually becomes a research hotspot, how to establish the optimal operation model of the integrated energy operator (IEO) and the users is an urgent problem to be solved nowadays. Firstly, this paper constructs a framework for the operation of regional integrated energy system and analyses the coupling relationship between the subjects in the system. Secondly, a demand response flexible load model is established to consider the response comfort, and the flexible load incentive strategy is dynamically adjusted according to the energy comfort. Then, the game relationship between IEO and user aggregators is analysed, the Stackelberg game model between IEO and users is proposed, and the existence and uniqueness of the Stackelberg equilibrium solution is proved. Finally, the master-slave game objective is regarded as a nonlinear optimisation problem, and the dynamic operator adjustment genetic algorithm is used to solve the problem, and the experimental study through Matlab to establish the arithmetic simulation shows that this scheduling strategy can realise the joint improvement of the benefits of the management side and the user side.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Detection and Clustering Method of Harmonic From Noisy Signal Based on Prony
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy resources based on power electronic devices results in increasing levels of harmonic distortion. It is necessary to improve the harmonic monitoring and control ability. The performance of the Prony algorithm can be promised if the order of Prony is set to half of the window length, but this will introduce many pseudo harmonic modes which interfere the harmonic mechanism screening. To solve the problem above, this paper proposes a detection and clustering method of harmonic from noisy signal. The exactly existed harmonics are adaptively detected using the estimated threshold that can reflect the level of pseudo harmonic modes caused by the time-varying background noise. Then, the harmonics of different mechanisms are classified by the agglomerative nesting (AGNES) hierarchical clustering method in the unsupervised sense. The performance of the proposed method has been verified by the numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Safety and Quality Risk Status Evaluation of Photovoltaic Power Plants in Operation based on AHP-Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the national photovoltaic installed capacity reaching 390 million kilowatts at the end of 2022, the number of accidents and disasters in the stock power station is also increasing year by year, and in recent years, various safety and quality accidents caused by the quality of engineering installation, equipment quality, operation and maintenance quality, natural disasters and other reasons have brought more and more losses to the photovoltaic power generation industry. Ensuring safety and quality is the first priority of power station operation, but also the fundamental place to achieve return on investment, carry out photovoltaic project safety and quality risk assessment, the overall safety and quality risk status of the power station to explore, can play a role in preventing safety and quality risks in advance, and identifying safety and quality defects in advance. In this paper, the safety and quality status of photovoltaic power plants in operation is studied, and a comprehensive safety and quality risk evaluation system with the quality status and safety quality system of key equipment as the measurement and evaluation object is constructed, and the data processing and analysis is carried out by combining the AHP-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method model, which plays a guiding role in the actual safety and quality risk evaluation of photovoltaic power plants.

Author Keywords: safety and quality risk status assessment

articleTitle: Study on the influence of desert dust accumulation on the output power of photovoltaic modules
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Desert photovoltaic power plants are dry and short of water. Cleaning photovoltaic modules in a fixed period will increase local water consumption. Taking a desert photovoltaic power station in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region as the research object, the best monthly installation dip Angle of the photovoltaic power station from January to December was calculated through the mathematical model. On the basis of this, the desert dust deposition experiment was conducted for one year. The results show that there are a total of 20 samples of 5 installation dip angles during the accumulative dust deposition time of 1 to 4 months, and the output power of 11 of them decreases by more than 5%. In the cumulative dust accumulation time of 5 to 12 months, the output power of 40 photovoltaic modules in 5 installation angles decreased by more than 5% in only 2 samples. The output power of photovoltaic modules in the desert photovoltaic power station did not decrease with the increase of dust accumulation days, so the photovoltaic modules should be cleaned from time to time based on the decline index of photovoltaic module output power.

articleTitle: A Method of Weak Node and Weak Line Identification in Distribution Network Based on Probabilistic Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing scale of distributed power supply in the distribution network, the problem of voltage exceeding the upper limit is becoming more and more prominent. For the management and operation of the distribution network, it is meaningful to identify which node voltages are easier to exceed the upper limit, and then take measures to control the voltage. At present, the nodes and lines with voltage exceeding the upper limit in the active distribution network are called weak nodes and weak lines in the active distribution network by academic circles. In this paper, a stochastic power flow algorithm based on cumulant and Gram-Charlier series expansion method is used to calculate the probability density function of node voltage and branch power flow variables, thus a weak node identification method for active distribution network is proposed, and an improved RTBS-bus6 topology model is used to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Topology and Fault Handling of AC/DC Flexible Interconnection and Distribution System Based on Cloud-edge Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Compared to traditional AC distribution networks, the DC side of flexible interconnected AC/DC distribution networks has a more intense fault process and greater damage to the system. Therefore, it is necessary to develop more efficient and rapid fault handling mechanisms for the DC side of AC/DC distribution networks. Firstly, based on the end-to-end cloud level architecture of the distribution Internet of Things, a fault handling system architecture for medium voltage AC distribution networks under the end-to-end cloud architecture is proposed, and then a fault handling algorithm is provided based on the proposed architecture。 Finally, a case study of the 10kV AC/DC line of branch line F in County L, City H is carried out. The results indicate that the proposed architecture can not only meet the stringent requirements of relay protection for DC distribution networks, but also significantly save computational time, making it suitable for real-time analysis and decision-making.

articleTitle: Short-term photovoltaic output prediction model based on MOSMA feature selection and TCN
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The prediction of photovoltaic power generation is an important basis for photovoltaic grid connection and consumption. In order to ensure the better participation of photovoltaic power generation in power grid dispatching., this paper presents a Short-term photovoltaic output prediction model based on MOSMA feature selection and TCN. Firstly, the correlation analysis is carried out, and the strong correlation meteorological factors are selected. The time series is decomposed by ICCEMDAN to reduce its volatility. and obtain a stable time series subsequence. Secondly, a multi-objective function of the minimum feature subset and the optimal prediction accuracy is established, and MOSMA is used for feature selection to obtain the feature set with the maximum fitness.. Finally, the most characteristic set is input into the TCN for photovoltaic power generation time series prediction, and the prediction results of other prediction models are evaluated and compared. Experiments show that t the TCN model can be optimized by adding modal decomposition and multi-objective feature selection,, and has higher prediction accuracy and feasibility than other prediction models.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Storage Converter Based on Two-stage Power Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The energy storage converter is the bridge between the battery system and the grid. In this paper, a two-stage topology is used to add a Buck/Boost type bidirectional DC/DC converter topology between the DC side capacitors of the energy storage unit and the power sub-module, so that the DC side capacitor is not directly connected in parallel with the battery and the impact of the DC side second harmonic current fluctuation on the energy storage unit is reduced. The two-stage energy storage converter system designed in this paper achieves two main objectives, one is to decouple and control the power of each sub-module, and the other is to balance the power between different phases and between the three-phase bridge arms. Firstly, the topology of the energy storage converter used in this paper is studied, secondly, the control strategy of the bidirectional power converter is investigated, secondly, the performance analysis of the energy storage converter is carried out, and finally, the simulation is built for verification.

articleTitle: Chance-constrained model predictive control based real-time dispatch strategy of regional integrated energy systems considering profit allocation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The regional integrated energy system (RIES) consisting of multiple multi-energy microgrids (MEMS) plays an important role in improving the efficiency of energy utilization and promoting the accommodation of renewable distributed generation. However, the presence of multiple stakeholders and various operational uncertainties in RIES poses great challenges to its energy management. To this end, this paper proposes a real-time energy dispatch strategy of RIES based on chance-constrained model predictive control (MPC) considering profit allocation. It combines the advantages of MPC and chance constraints to enable real-time energy dispatch and guarantee the operational reliability of RIES. In addition, the fair allocation of profits from energy sharing is achieved through Nash bargaining to stabilize the enthusiasm of MEMGs for part icipating in cooperation. The effectiveness of the proposed solution is extensively validated through numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Reverse Recovery Process Protection of Thyristors in Hybrid Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The thyristor devices in hybrid circuit breakers operate under high pulse current conditions, and power breakdown during reverse recovery is an important cause of device damage. In this paper, the thyristor model is used to analyze the changes of voltage, power density and energy accumulation density at both ends of the thyristor device in the reverse recovery process when the protection circuit adopts three protection schemes: RC buffer, Varistor and RC buffer+Varistor. The results indicate that the RC buffer+varistor protection scheme can effectively reduce the voltage rise rate at both ends of the thyristor device and suppress overvoltage. In one pulse cycle, this protection scheme can reduce the peak power density from 188.8 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 60 kW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and the accumulated energy density from 0.589J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 0.19J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, ensuring the safe operation of the device and improving the reliability of circuit breaker operation. Finally, a test circuit was built and the on-off characteristics of thyristor devices were tested, verifying the effectiveness of the simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Resilience Improvement Strategy of Distribution Network in Water Project Based on Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Traditional distribution network without power supply need to improve its resilience for operation safety.In order to enhance the ability of quickly recovering from extreme events for water project distribution network,resilience improvement strategy for distribution network based on battery energy storage system is proposed in this paper.Strategy proposed includes configuration optimization of battery energy storage systems and dispatch optimization of emergency power supplies. Configuration optimization of battery energy storage system before extreme events is based on battery energy storage system access points selection with the goal of maximizing the recovery of electrical energy for important loads.During the events uninterrupted power supply for important loads is achieved by quick transform to power supply of battery energy storage system.Minimizing recovery time of important loads after events is achieved by dispatch optimization of emergency power supplies for the distribution network.A composite resilience index considering recovery energy and recovery time of important loads at the same time is adopted to measure the effectiveness of resilience improvement for distribution network. Finally, feasibility and effectiveness of the strategy proposed for distribution network resilience improvement are verified with a water project distribution network.The results show that the proposed strategy can improve the resilience of distribution network in water project.

articleTitle: Research on circulation suppression of multi-module parallel power router based on zero-sequence component compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: When the three-level inverter is connected in parallel, there is usually a circulating current problem, and the existence of circulating current will lead to increased damage to the converter system, a decrease in the output power quality, and an impact on the stability of the system operation. In this paper, a mathematical model of multi-module parallel connection and the loop flow path between modules are first established, and the generation mechanism of circulation is analyzed. Then, according to the mechanism of circulation generation, the method of zero-sequence component compensation is proposed to suppress circulation. Finally, by building a simulation model, the feasibility of the scheme is verified by simulation. The results show that the zero-sequence component compensation can effectively suppress the circulation of multi-module parallel power routers and improve the operation stability of the system.

articleTitle: Study on rigid strength of magnetic pole connection of large capacity and high speed generator motor
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the static strength and fatigue of the magnetic pole rotating parts of Yang jiang project under various working conditions, and optimizes and improves the structure of the rotating parts through the results of analysis and calculation, so that each part can meet the requirements of strength and fatigue. According to the calculation results, the design quality control measures for the rotating parts are put forward[1].

articleTitle: Low carbon regulation and development evaluation system of coal-fired captive power plants based on superiority chart
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the two-carbon development goal, the national requirements for the supervision and management of coal-fired captive power plants and the participation of coal-fired captive power plants in the grid interaction are further strengthened. Coal-fired captive power plants and their high energy consumption enterprises are in urgent need of seeking a new low-carbon development path through technological upgrading and innovation research, but there is no set of low-carbon supervision and low-carbon development evaluation system for coal-fired captive power plants. Therefore, this paper proposes a set of low-carbon supervision and low-carbon development evaluation system for coal-fired captive power plants by using superiority chart method. The indicators and evaluation methods proposed scientifically quantify the low-carbon development level of coal-fired captive power plants, which is conducive to guiding the low-carbon transformation and upgrading of coal-fired captive power plants in a better way, so as to promote the standardized low-carbon operation and orderly development of coal-fired captive power plants. At the same time, it is of great significance for the government to strengthen the low-carbon regulation of coal-fired captive power plants, power grid enterprises to strengthen the grid-connected management and efficient regulation of coal-fired captive power plants, and to help improve the safe and reliable operation capacity of coal-fired captive power plants and the consumption of new energy.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Simulation Design Research Application of PEDF Building Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: At present, there are relatively few application cases of PEDF projects, and PEDF building photovoltaic systems are quite different from traditional building photovoltaic systems. This paper firstly introduces the important evaluation index of PEDF building photovoltaic system—the self-consumption rate of photovoltaic power generation, and then takes a real project as a case to introduce the whole design process such as model selection, configuration, model construction, system simulation, etc. of PEDF building photovoltaic system, analyze the photovoltaic output power curve and load forecast curve, obtain the self-consumption rate of photovoltaic power generation, so as to realize the evaluation of PEDF building photovoltaic system and prepare for the subsequent planning of energy storage configuration and PEDF control strategy. This paper can be used as a reference for counterparts in the design of PEDF building photovoltaic systems.

Author Keywords: the self-consumption rate of photovoltaic Deliverypower generation

articleTitle: A Secondary Compensation Control Strategy Based on Energy Storage Battery SoC
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The energy storage is an essential component in a microgrid; it not only can suppress the power fluctuation but also is a necessary guarantee for the standalone and stable operation of the microgrid. The essential controls need to be applied to the energy storage converter to equalize the output current, reduce the output voltage deviation and equalize the state of charge (SoC) of each energy storage. In this paper, a DC microgrid with energy storage unit is studied, and a virtual voltage drop equalizer and a voltage compensator are added to reduce the influence of line impedance on current equalizatio n and reduce voltage deviation based on SoC-based variable coefficient droop control. The virtual voltage drop equalizer and the voltage compensator are designed by analyzing the SoC-based variable coefficient droop control deficiencies. A DC microgrid model containing batteries, PV cells and loads is built in MATLAB/Simulink, and the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme is demonstrated by comparing it with the SoC-based variable coefficient droop control.

articleTitle: Hybrid Generalized Short Circuit Ratio Considering the Flexible DC
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The static voltage stability of hybrid multi-infeed high voltage direct current (HMIDC) system composed of voltage source converter based HVDC (VSC-HVDC) and line commutated converter based HVDC (LCC-HVDC) is ought to be considered. In addition, generalized short circuit ratio (gSCR) is the index of static voltage stability only based on the traditional multi-infeed high voltage direct current (MIDC) system. To combine HMIDC system and gSCR, this paper provides a new definition hybrid generalized short circuit ratio (hgSCR) to describe the static voltage stability of HMIDC system and gives approximate derivation method and precise derivation method of hgSCR by Schur complement, modal perturbation method and Taylor expansion. In addition, this paper also analyzes the influence of Taylor expansion and grid impedance scale on hgSCR.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Topological Structure for Mountainous Wind Farm Collection System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In wind farm projects, the investment cost of the collection system is high, and optimizing the topological structure of the collection system can save a significant amount of cost. This paper addresses the optimization problem of the collection system in mountainous wind farms and proposes a feasible optimization method, including methods for acquiring geographical information data and establishing topographic maps, subdomain partitioning considering terrain and cable load flow impact, three-dimensional shortest path search method, and cost-optimal collection cable connection method. Case studies demonstrate that for mountainous wind farm projects with significant terrain influences, this method exhibits good optimization performance.

articleTitle: Two-layer Optimal Dispatch of Distribution Networks with Distributed Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the energy transition and the development of renewable energy, distributed generation (DG) connected to the distribution network has an important impact on the power quality and economic efficiency of the distribution network, in order to cope with the network loss and voltage crossing problem of the distribution network containing DG. A two-layer optimal dispatching model of the distribution network considering distributed resources is proposed: firstly, the DG optimal dispatching stage, according to the electricity price and DG operation cost, should achieve the source-load coordinated optimal operation; the lower layer is the reactive power optimization stage, considering the reactive power output characteristics of DG, taking the distribution network voltage constraint and distribution network loss as the optimization target, using particle swarm algorithm to achieve the optimization target by optimizing DG and reactive power compensation device. Simulations based on the modified IEEE33 node system show that the proposed two-layer optimal dispatching model can effectively improve the power quality of the distribution network and reduce operating costs.

articleTitle: The operation optimization method of distribution grid considering the access of multi-types adjustable loads
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, the construction of new power system has transformed the traditional regulation and control mode of "source with load" to "source-load interaction". Considering the regulation and control ability of multi-types adjustable loads, it is of great practical significance to promote the participation of multi-types adjustable loads in the market, improve the operation efficiency of power system and promote the absorption of new energy. In this paper, the models of multi-types adjustable loads are firstly established to study their regulatory ability. Secondly, an optimal operation model considering multi-types adjustable loads access to distribution grid is established, and the model transformation is solved. Finally, the accuracy of the proposed model is verified by case analysis.

articleTitle: Self-healing distribution automation terminal based on IEC61850 protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The distribution automation terminal is the key link to realize intelligent power distribution, which is of great significance for improving the reliability rate of power supply. This paper designs and develops a self-healing distribution automation terminal based on IEC61850 protocol, including two parts: comprehensive protection measurement and control unit and public measurement and control communication unit, which adopts the high-speed network communication mode of general object-oriented substation event (GOOSE), which is a fast self-healing distribution automation terminal, which has the function of quickly cutting faults without causing power outages in non-fault areas.

articleTitle: Incremental Learning for Appliance Identification Based on V-I Trajectory Signature
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Assessments of energy consumption behavior play a crucial role in enabling utilities to design effective demand reduction programs. Understanding the electrical activity within homes is essential for evaluating community load energy consumption behavior. Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) is a valuable tool for identifying appliance activity. Deep neural networks have demonstrated remarkable success in learning tasks for NILM. However, these deep learning models usually have an obvious shortcoming, which is to forget the known appliance knowledge while continuously acquiring new appliance information. In this paper, we highlight two challenges associated with incremental learning with appliances: representation bias and classifier bias.To address these problems, we propose a simple and innovative approach that leverages explicit appliance class augmentation and implicit semantic augmentation. Experimental results using publicly available datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Dynamic data modeling based on Kalman state estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the process of conventional historical data-driven modeling, when the initial state of the system at the starting point of the selected modeling data is unsteady, the model of the system cannot be accurately obtained. In addition, for many control systems, due to the mismatch between the control system performance and the controlled object or the frequent change of the control system setpoint, the system is in an unstable state for a long time, and it is difficult to manually screen the steady-state data. To solve this problem, a dynamic historical data modeling method based on Kalman filter is proposed. The dynamic data is divided into three sections. The first section is used for Kalman state estimation, the second section is used for model identification, and the third section is used for model verification. The results show that the model identification accuracy of this modeling method is high by using dynamic data, and the effectiveness of this method is proved.

articleTitle: Optimized scheduling of electric water heaters under consideration of water-using time elasticity
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electric Water Heater (EWH) losds account for a large proportion in the Thermostatically Controlled Loads (TCLs), which have a significant impact on demand response (DR). Due to the traditional optimization methods for EWHs primarily focusing on electricity consumption, they do not fully consider the flexibility potential of EWH load. This paper proposes a new optimization method that considers the flexibility of water-using time, enhancing the ability to achieve peak shaving. Based on water-using activity shifting potential of EWHs, a new EWH thermodynamic model is constructed, and an optimal scheduling model for EWHs is established for conducting a case study on aggregated EWHs. The results show that the proposed optimization method in this paper can significantly enhance the load-shifting potential of EWHs and reduce electricity costs. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated.

articleTitle: Frequency Emergency Control Strategy using Energy Storage based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Energy storage has the potential to take part in the frequency regulation in the power grid because of its flexible control function, and there are more and more studies focusing on it. The frequency response of energy storage is continuous and instantaneous, which can increase the stability and security of power grid and can be used to the second and third defense lines. However, the current research on energy storage participating in frequency control is still limited: most studies mainly focus on energy storage participating in primary and secondary frequency regulation, and few studies on emergency control involve over-frequency generator tripping. Therefore, based on model predictive control and moving horizon estimation, a control strategy of energy storage participating in frequency regulation is proposed. This paper considers the constraints of energy storage, energy storage is played as much as possible to reduce the quantity of tripping generators in the frequency regulation. The real-time frequency deviation of power system can be predicted by the moving horizon estimation in order to calculate the optimal energy output of energy storage system. Finally, the validity of the strategy used in this paper and its superiority over the conventional strategy are proved by some case studies.

articleTitle: A Vulnerability Modeling Method for Photovoltaic Generators Under Typhoons Disaster Based on Bayesian Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The failure of photovoltaic under typhoon conditions plays an important role in studying the influence of typhoon on power grid, so it is necessary to quantify the failure probability of PV under typhoon in order to prepare for power grid emergency. To achieve a more precise quantification of the PV failure probability curve, this paper proposes a PV vulnerability model under typhoon conditions based on Bayesian theory. This model combines on-site PV disaster data, enhancing the accuracy of the failure probability estimation. On this basis, using Monte Carlo Markov(MCM) algorithm to solve the posterior distribution in Bayes theory avoids the complicated numerical integration operation and improves the efficiency of solving the posterior distribution. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by Matlab simulation results.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Secondary Air Adjustment System for Energy Saving and Nitrogen Reduction in Secondary Reheat Units
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A secondary air adjustment system for energy saving and nitrogen reduction in secondary reheat units is proposed, including a secondary reheat unit power measurement module, a secondary air intake module, a flue gas extraction module, a flue gas extraction transmission module, a secondary air-flue gas mixing module, a secondary air intake measurement module, a flue gas extraction temperature measurement module, a superheater temperature and pressure measurement module, a reheater temperature and pressure measurement module, a denitrification SCR temperature measurement The data acquisition and control device is used to control the opening or closing of the secondary air inlet module, flue gas extraction module, flue gas extraction transmission module and secondary air-flue gas mixing module respectively according to the collected data. The system provided by the present invention selects different secondary air adjustment methods according to different operating conditions of the unit, improves the steam temperature of the secondary reheat outlet and the flue gas temperature of the denitrification SCR inlet, and realizes energy-saving and nitrogen-reducing operation of the secondary reheat unit.

articleTitle: A Harmonic Mitigation Method Based on the PV and ESS Collaborative Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The rapid development of new power systems has placed new demands on the quality of power supply to the grid. A large number of new energy systems connected to the distribution networks, such as photovoltaic (PV) and energy storage systems (ESS), can be used to suppress harmonics in the distribution networks because their grid-connected inverters are similar to the topology of power quality control devices. In this paper, an optimization model is proposed for the harmonic mitigation of multiple harmonic sources (HSs) using PV-ESS inverters in synergy, in the scenario where the degree of the grid-wide harmonic distortion is known. With the optimal harmonic level of the whole network as the objective function, and the power flows, bus voltages, total harmonic distortions of voltage, inverter capacities and harmonic mitigation costs as constraints, the PV and ESS in the distribution network are jointly controlled to suppress the harmonics of the whole network, which could also reduce the mitigation costs. The validity and economics of the proposed method have been analyzed in the case studies using a modified IEEE 13 bus test feeder.

articleTitle: Optimal Participation of Electric Vehicle Aggregators in Real-Time Energy Market
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) aggregator acts as a middleman between EVs and power company, participating in multiple electricity markets to pursue profit. This paper aims to research the coordinated optimization bidding model of several EV aggregators in RT energy market. First, the cooperation among several EV aggregators can achieve better schedules under the current penalty mechanism for extra power deviation. Second, a more economic bidding strategy can be further realized by peak shifting and valley filling. Finally, the contrastive analysis of EV aggregators’ schedules in the proposed model and other models is carried out. The results show EVs power schedule in the proposed model realizes the balance of the above two cooperation objectives.

articleTitle: BEB-Net: Boundary Extraction Based Semantic Segmentation Network for Indoor Scenes in Smart Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Point cloud segmentation can help power inspection robots to recognize and detect power equipment. Due to the complexity of indoor power point cloud scenes, the segmentation effect of the boundary is often not accurate enough. To address this problem, this paper proposes a semantic segmentation method for indoor scenes that fully utilizes the multidimensional information of the original point cloud (BEB-Net). Compared with existing deep learning methods, BEB-Net pays more attention to the boundary information features of the original point cloud. The explicit feature representation of the initial point cloud can be enhanced by calculating the local feature variance of the point cloud while using the geometric information of the input point cloud as independent features. The method maintains point cloud feature better and reduces the loss of information during the coding process. In addition, BEB-Net, based on inverted residual scaling blocks, can demonstrate better performance in the S3DIS indoor scenes dataset, with an mIoU of 69%. At the same time, there has been some improvement in the boundary segmentation effect in indoor scenes.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Arc Detection Method Based on Multivariate Criterion
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of misjudgment according to the detection of single fault arc characteristics, in this paper, the Matlab/Simulink platform was used to build a fault arc circuit simulation model for linear, nonlinear and mixed loads, according to the zero-break time and fault characteristics of high-frequency harmonics of fault arc current obtained by simulation results, a fault arc detection method based on zero-break time scale coefficient based on zero-break feature and multivariate criterion based on DB3 wavelet decomposition detail component scale coefficient was proposed. The simulation results show that the proposed method is effective for identifying linear loads, nonlinear loads and partial mixed loads recommended in GB14287.4.

articleTitle: Analysis, Design, and Control of Interlinking Dual Capacitive Filter Inverters in Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The power quality problem represented by harmonic problem seriously affects the normal operation of microgrid. In order to reduce the operation and maintenance cost of microgrid and improve the flexibility of inverters, this paper proposes an inverter topology based on multiple parallel capacitive coupling structures. Through the design parameters, a dual capacitive filter inverter (DCFI) can filter most harmonics without using additional power quality enhancement equipment. In addition, in order to make full use of the inverter capacity, an adaptive power sharing method is proposed. Through case study and simulation test, the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the harmonic THD and optimize the capacity requirement of inverter.

articleTitle: Research on coupling design and intelligent operation of power flow system in green factory
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Efficient and comprehensive energy utilization in the industrial sector plays a pivotal role in addressing global climate and environmental challenges. To achieve this, we propose the development of an integrated intelligent power flow system for green and low-carbon factories. This system encompasses a range of components including power equipment, test benches, rooftop PV power generation equipment, external power grids, battery energy storage, load equipment, and a power flow brain platform. By implementing this power flow system and employing intelligent operation methods, we aim to increase photovoltaic absorption rate. In a typical manufacturing factory, the implementation of these measures resulted in a significant 4.12% increase in photovoltaic absorption rate. Furthermore, this approach offers the potential to enhance energy utilization efficiency, strengthen microgrid safety within the plant, and enable flexible energy consumption for discrete production, reduce energy consumption intensity and carbon emissions from energy and power equipment plants, thereby accomplishing green and low-carbon intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Combined Wind and Photovoltaic Power Forecasting Based on Attention-BiLSTM Multitask Learning for Renewable Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the renewable energy system with renewable energy as the main body, the random fluctuation of a high proportion of renewable energy intensifies the instability of the power system after grid connection. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a combined forecasting model of wind and photovoltaic power based on Attention-BiLSTM hybrid model and Progressive Layered Extraction (PLE) multitask learning method. Meteorological and historical power data are used as input, and measured power data are used as the forecasting target. The model can reflect the spatio-temporal correlation between wind and photovoltaic power, and extract the nonlinear coupling information between them to improve the forecasting accuracy. The proposed method is validated using real power generation data. The analysis results show that the proposed model can not only improve the power forecasting accuracy, but also obtain the forecasting results of wind and photovoltaic power at the same time, which reduces the workload and has certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Low-Voltage Management for Distribution Network Based on Parallel Flexible DC System: The Fujian Experience
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper takes the distribution network in Fujian province in china as an example, and summarize the reasons for low-voltage problem in distribution network firstly. Then compare the traditional technical measures for low-voltage management in Fujian distribution network. Furthermore, a parallel voltage regulating scheme based on flexible DC technology is proposed to address the issue of low-voltage at the end of distribution network, which is caused by long power transmission line and seasonal overload. Finally, a practical engineering application case and economic analysis are presented.

articleTitle: Detection Method of Partial Discharge of Motor Stator Bar based on Optical Fiber Transmission Ultrasonic Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Large generators and motors are the main rotating equipment in the power industry. Their reliability plays a decisive role in the normal production and operation of relevant enterprises. The decline or even damage of the insulation level of the motor stator winding is still one of the main threats to the operation safety of large generators and motors. Therefore, it is necessary to detect the partial discharge that represents the insulation level of the motor stator bar. In this paper, a new method of partial detection of motor stator bars based on optical fiber transmission ultrasonic measurement is proposed, which can accurately locate the partial discharge fault of motor stator winding..

articleTitle: Uncertainty Quantification and Sensitivity Analysis of High-altitude Electromagnetic Pulse Response of Buried Pipelines Based on the Stochastic Collocation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: High-altitude electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) can induce current and voltage on buried oil and gas pipelines, which may pose a threat to the pipeline's safe operation. In order to fully consider the simultaneous change of input variables on the HEMP response, an uncertainty quantification model of the induced current based on the stochastic collocation (SC) method is proposed. Taking the elevation angle, the azimuth angle, and the field source azimuth angle as input variables, the uncertainty quantification of the response current of buried pipelines has been carried out. To improve the efficiency of uncertainty quantification, the sensitivities of the response current to input variables have been analyzed using the SC and Sobol global sensitivity indexes. The dimension of the input variables was decreased based on the sensitivity ranking, and the accuracy of the computed results after dimensionality reduction was checked through comparison. The uncertainty analysis methods and relevant conclusions can provide a reference for the electromagnetic pulse protection of the buried pipelines.

articleTitle: Effect of Load Ratio Parameter on Electric Spring Performance for Critical Bus Voltage Stabilization
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The electric spring (ES) is a flexible power electronic device utilized in power system to enhance voltage stability through reactive power compensation. When connected in series with a non-critical load (NCL), ES and NCL forms a smart load (SL), which is then connected in parallel with the critical load (CL). By adjusting the output voltage and the active power of NCL through reactive power compensation, ES stabilizes the voltage of CL. In addition, an advantage of ES is its ability to dynamically adapt to the fluctuating generation of renewable energy, without the need for prior load demand determination. This feature makes ES suitable for widespread application at various nodes in the power grid, effectively accommodating unpredictable renewable energy generation. However, existing research has primarily focused on voltage and frequency regulation of ES, with limited consideration given to the associated NCL and CL. Therefore, this paper aims to analyze the impact of the load ratio (CL to NCL) on the performance of ES in voltage stabilization. Mathematical model of ES is derived for analysis, then simulations are conducted using MATLAB/Simulink to validate the voltage control of ES under different load ratios.

articleTitle: Vibration Signal Analysis of a Reciprocating Air Compressor under Different Mechanical Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Vibration signals are very sensible to the mechanical condition of reciprocating compressors. To make better understanding of vibration symptoms under different mechanical faults some typical faults were simulated including loosen foot bolts, broken piston rings, broken suction valves, and broken discharge valves on a wp135 reciprocating compressor. Vibration signals were analyzed in time domain and frequency domain respectively. It is discovered that time domain analysis of the vibration signals can detect the general condition of the compressor, but cannot identify specific faults. Different fault has different symptoms on the spectrum of vibration signal, so typical mechanical faults of the reciprocating air compressor can be diagnosed with the analysis of vibration signals in frequency domain.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Cost and Benefit Evaluation of Carbon Reduction Technologies for Power Transmission and Transformation Projects Based on Hierarchical Analysis and Entropy Power Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the goal of "double carbon", it is imperative for power transmission and transformation projects to develop in the direction of energy saving and carbon reduction. In order to grasp the intrinsic relationship between carbon reduction and cost and benefit of power transmission and transformation projects, a cost-benefit evaluation index system for power transmission and transformation projects is established, and the influence weight of each carbon reduction technology on cost and benefit is calculated by using hierarchical analysis and entropy weighting method, and then 1000 sampling points are selected for each technical solution for sensitivity analysis, so as to establish a comprehensive evaluation system for power transmission and transformation projects. The final conclusion is that the highest weight in the first criterion layer is the "adoption of new transformers" technology, and the highest weight in the second criterion layer is the "transformer load loss", etc.

articleTitle: Improved droop control strategy for resistive inverters connected in parallel
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: An improved droop control strategy is designed to address the inherent limitations of the conventional droop control method such as poor external characteristics of system output voltage and low power distribution accuracy. This control method is a three-loop structure with power loop, current inner loop and voltage outer loop nested with each other. The power outer loop calculates active power and reactive power in real time to ensure good power sharing of the system; the current inner loop adopts filtered inductor current feedback to improve the dynamic performance and tracking effect of the main circuit current of each inverter; Voltage outer loop ensures high-quality output voltage external characteristics. In addition, a voltage feedforward link and an integration link are introduced at the active power-voltage loop to reduce the output voltage droop while making the power distribution independent of the different equivalent output impedances of each inverter; the virtual positive resistance is added to further improve the power distribution accuracy. The conventional droop control principle of parallel inverter in distributed power generation system is analyzed, the inverter parallel equivalent model is established. The simulation verifies the effectiveness of the control.

articleTitle: Research on Soft Switching Optimization Control Strategy for ANPC Half-bridge DAB under Wide Voltage Range
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to improve the operating efficiency of the ANPC half-bridge DAB, this paper proposes an optimized control strategy based on soft switching trajectory. First of all, by analyzing the ANPC half-bridge DAB device current to realize the control variable constraints of soft switching, and then determined the soft switching area of DAB in the PV. In order to achieve soft switching of the device in the wide voltage range and the full power range, a control variable adjustment trajectory is formulated, and a soft switching optimization control strategy containing mode selection is obtained. Simulation analysis shows that when the input voltage of the DAB is higher than the output voltage, the DAB device can achieve soft switching within the full power range. And when the input voltage of the DAB is lower than the output voltage and the transmission power of the DAB is higher, the device can also achieve soft switching. The simulation verifies the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Correlation between Weather Parameters and DC total Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The total electric field in HVDC (High-Voltage Direct Current) transmission projects is closely related to corona discharge on the conductors and greatly influenced by the surrounding environmental conditions. Currently, there is no comprehensive theoretical analysis method to fully understand the complex coupled effects of various weather parameters on DC electric field. In this paper, a long-term monitoring point was established beneath a ±800 kV bipolar HVDC transmission line in China, and continuous monitoring was conducted for one year to obtain statistical results of the ground-level electric field and weather parameters. Three methods, namely the Spearman correlation coefficient, the Elastic Net Regression model, and the SHAP values based on the XGBoost model, were employed to analyze the most significant weather parameters affecting the ground-level electric field beneath the poles. The research findings contribute to a better understanding of the impact of weather parameters on the total electric field.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: HVDC Transient Reactive Power-Voltage Characteristics and Impact of Control System Parameters During Commutation Failure and Recovery
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increase of high voltage direct current (HVDC) power receiving scale in load center, the reduction of main reactive power sources such as local generators pose a serious threat to the transient voltage security of receiving-end power grid. To solve this problem, this paper first put forward the HVDC receiving-side reactive power-voltage equations during steady-state and transients. Then the transient reactive power-voltage characteristics of the DC receiving terminal during commutation failure and recovery are analyzed respectively. we studied the impact of the HVDC control system parameters on transient reactive power characteristic. Finally, on the basis of the above research, the DC control parameters are optimized with the aim of suppressing the number of commutation failures and voltage stability. Through the actual power grid calculation example, it is verified that the proposed improvement scheme has a significant effect on improving the transient voltage stability of the receiving end power grid.

articleTitle: Analysis of Advantages of Frequency Modulation and Voltage Regulation for Doubly-fed Pumped Storage Units
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Variable speed pumped storage units (VSPSU)have the advantages of strong speed adaptability and flexible power regulation, and is the development direction of future pumped storage units. The frequency and voltage regulation capacity of VSPSU is compared and analyzed in this paper. Firstly, the electromechanical transient process of DFVSPSU is analyzed, and a mathematical model of the doubly-fed motor, pump-turbine, and speed control system is established. Based on this, a theoretical analysis of the ability of VSPSU to improve frequency and voltage regulation is carried out. Finally, a VSPSU model is built based on Simulink platform, and the frequency and voltage regulation capabilities of VSPSUs are compared and analyzed. The results show that VSPSU has better ability of frequency and voltage regulation, which can effectively improve the operating stability of the system.

articleTitle: An Optimized Configuration Method for MESV Connected to VPP
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To improve the power supply reliability and flexibility of the grid, this paper uses the Virtual Power Plant (VPP) technology to virtualise the grid and the multiple groups of storage and Mobile Energy Storage Vehicle (MESV) in the region into a geographically dispersed but uniformly dispatchable and manageable power plant. By comparing its differences with conventional operation, the VPP optimal dispatching strategy is designed. Based on a mathematical model with the objective function of the VPP's economic return and the lowest grid losses, grid operation constraints and MESV operation constraints, the optimal allocation scheme is obtained by calculating the output of each VPP component in each time period through a genetic algorithm. The results show that the optimal allocation model can verify the applicability of the proposed optimization strategy.

articleTitle: Identification Method Based on Improved Hierarchical Multi-innovation Stochastic Gradient Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: An improved hierarchical multi-innovation stochastic gradient algorithm was proposed for the parameter identification problem of input nonlinear closed-loop control autoregressive systems. In the existing literature, a hierarchical multi-innovation stochastic gradient algorithm was used to identify model parameters, but there are some problems such as slow convergence speed and low identification accuracy. In order to deal with these issues, the paper proposed an algorithm that combines the hierarchical multi-innovation stochastic gradient algorithm with momentum methods. Among them, the momentum method can help the stochastic gradient accelerate and suppress the oscillation in the related direction. Simulation results showed that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on the Energy-carbon Flow in the Source-grid-load of Enterprises with Coal-fired Self-owned Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to help high-energy-consuming enterprises with coal-fired self-owned power plants improve their energy conservation and carbon reduction efforts, this paper analyzes the circulation relationships of energy flow, carbon material flow, and carbon emission flow in the process of energy production and use at the enterprises. By analyzing the typical energy structure and consumption of these enterprises, the energy-carbon flow analysis model and Sankey structure diagram of such enterprises are constructed, and the relevant methods for calculating the energy flow and carbon flow data are proposed. Finally, using an aluminum electrolysis enterprise as an example, its energy-carbon flow model and Sankey diagram are created. By looking at the image and comparing the carbon emission intensity data, suggestions are provided for energy conservation and carbon reduction.

articleTitle: Carbon Footprint Tracking Based on Non-intrusive Load Monitoring Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the growing concern for environmental sustainability and the need to mitigate climate change, accurately tracking carbon footprints has become crucial. This paper explores the use of NILM technology for carbon footprint tracking at the household level. A carbon footprint tracking model is proposed based on NILM technology. On this basis, the relationship between carbon footprint and NILM technology is explored. An example is designed to verify the validity of NILM technology in calculating carbon footprint. The simulation results show that the NILM technology can be used to track the carbon footprint at the household. Finally, the paper is summarized.

articleTitle: Operation optimization of electric heating system based on interaction between green certificate carbon trading and source charge
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the effective implementation of the "dual carbon" project, many new types of energy have emerged. Integrated energy systems can integrate multiple heterogeneous energy flows such as electricity, heat, gas, and cold, and collaborate with energy suppliers to further reduce carbon emissions during system operation. This article first integrates the user side and energy suppliers to propose a source load interaction mode, which is divided into multiple different modes based on user needs; Then, during the system scheduling operation, mechanisms such as green certification and tiered carbon emissions are added. Through these two operating mechanisms, the emissions of atmospheric pollutants generated by each unit during output can be effectively reduced; Finally, take the minimum cost of system operation, the sum of the green certificate, and Carbon emission trading cost as the minimum goal of the system. Use a linear solver to solve it and set up three different scenarios for simulation verification. The results show that the proposed green card Carbon emission trading source load interaction model can effectively reduce the operating costs of the system and the pollutant emissions of units.

articleTitle: Granularity Analysis and Optimum Design of Secondary Network in Heating System for Solar Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the lack of research on promoting solar energy absorption by analyzing the structure of heating systems at present. Based on the granularity analysis method, the optimal structure of the secondary network of different heating systems is generated. According to the structure and mode of the solar energy access system, the solar energy absorption rate of the scheme under different granularity is optimized, and the heat storage configuration capacity required to achieve complete solar energy absorption is optimized. Compared with the existing scheme, the solar energy absorption rate increases by 8.01%, and the technical and economic efficiency will increase under the appropriate granularity.

articleTitle: Comprehensive benefit evaluation method for photovoltaic power generation projects based on cloud model
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Engineering projects exert a profound influence on diverse facets of society, encompassing individuals’ livelihoods, the broader economy, and the environment. Assessing the benefits of projects is crucial in governmental decision-making processes and in determining investments in social capital. This paper introduces a cloud-based method for evaluating the comprehensive benefits of engineering projects, specifically focusing on photovoltaic power generation projects. First, the paper constructs a comprehensive benefit evaluation system tailored to photovoltaic power generation projects. Next, it calculates the weights of the indicators within the evaluation system. By merging the subjective weights derived from the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) with the objective weights gathered from grey relational analysis (GRA), the method yields a more scientifically sound combined weight. Finally, the combined weight is assimilated into the cloud model, leading to the creation of a comprehensive evaluation benefit cloud model tailored to the projects. The effectiveness of the proposed methodology is substantiated through a real-world example of a photovoltaic power generation project.

articleTitle: Multi-region energy scheduling method based on evolutionary game
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the access of new energy equipment on the user side, how to promote the local consumption of new energy becomes critical. Aiming at the problem of multi-region power sharing, this paper proposes a multi-region energy sharing operation model based on evolutionary game. Firstly, the operator sets the intra-regional electricity price according to the supply and demand balance of each region; the user adjusts its own electricity consumption and regional selection probability based on the evolutionary game model according to the inter-regional trading electricity price and transmission cost information. Second, considering the different interests of different subjects, this paper establishes a benefit-cost model for operators and users, and takes the maximization of the interests of both parties and the minimization of the interaction with the grid power as the objective function, to derive the pricing strategy of the operators, the configuration and charging strategy of the shared energy storage and the final benefits of each subject.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimal Dispatch of Active Distribution Network Considering Carbon-electricity Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To promote the low-carbon and economic operation of the distribution network, introducing the carbon trading mechanism into the active distribution network dispatch plays a positive role in achieving carbon reduction. Therefore, a distributed optimal dispatching model considering carbon-electricity trading is established. First, the carbon transaction cost calculation method is defined on the supply side, and electric vehicles on the demand side are granted carbon quotas to obtain benefits, so as to exploiting the carbon reduction potential on both sides of the power grid supply and demand. Based on this, a large number of distributed energy sources in active distribution network are researched to participate in the frequency regulation auxiliary service market and carbon trading market, and an integrated carbon-electricity trading framework is constructed. An active distribution network low-carbon economic optimization dispatch model is established, and a consensus algorithm is applied to solve. The impact of carbon trading price and frequency modulation reserve ratio coefficient on dispatching results are analyzed by simulation, and the proposed dispatching method is proved to be able to achieve low-carbon and economic optimization operation.

articleTitle: Power Electronics Impedance Enhancement Based on a Supplementary Damping Control of Virtual Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Compared with power systems using conventional synchronous machines, the renewable power systems have a tendency to decrease the inertial characteristics and their stability problems are increasing. The grid-forming control technologies can provide virtual inertia to support the grid. In this article, the voltage-source converters are analyzed with Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control strategy. By building a small-signal model and analysing the active power control loop, the virtual inertia of the VSG can be obtained. The role and influence of the voltage-current loop inside the VSG control approach are further analysed. According the negative damping mechanism that causes the instability, an additional damping control principle that injects positive damping into the system is designed. Finally, the system and the designed additional damping controller are formulated in the simulation software, and a grid fault is applied to the system to verify the effectiveness of the designed additional damping controller. The results show that the supplementary damping has the desired performance in VSG control to improve the synchronous stability.

articleTitle: High-Voltage Nanosecond Pulse Generator Based on DSRD Series Components
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Drift step recovery diode (DSRD) has the advantages of fast switching speed, high repetition rate, and high operating current. In this paper, a circuit based on DSRD series components with a saturable pulse transformer for realizing high-voltage nanosecond output pulse is studied. According to the operating requirements of DSRD, a pump circuit is designed, which consists of a DC input voltage source, one MOSFET and a pulse transformer with boost and saturation characteristics. The circuit is simulated by PSpice software, which verifies the feasibility of the circuit. Based on the simulation analysis, the circuit experiment is implemented. The experimental results show that under the condition of an input DC voltage of 600V, the pulse amplitude on a 1kΩ resistor load is 10kV, with the rise time of approximately 18ns.

articleTitle: A day-ahead electricity price forecasting algorithm considered with multidimensional factors
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In light of the increasing number of participating members in the electricity market, the surge in the volume of electricity trading data and the rising demand for accuracy in electricity price forecasting, this paper proposes to construct a day-ahead electricity price forecasting method that considers multi-dimensional electricity price influencing factors. Firstly, the factors influencing the formation of electricity prices are analysed and the factors with high correlation are filtered out using the correlation coefficient method; secondly, the filtered factors and historical electricity prices are simultaneously used as inputs to the LSTM model to forecast the day-ahead electricity prices for the coming day; finally, the historical data of the PJM market is used to verify the prediction accuracy of the proposed model. The results show that the day-ahead electricity price forecasting model can be effectively applied to the actual electricity market, and also show that the short-term electricity price forecasting accuracy can be effectively improved by taking into account the electricity price influencing factors.

articleTitle: High-capacity Multi-level Emergency Load Shedding Technology for Electrolytic Aluminum Load
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The gradual expansion of the power grid scale has led to increasingly prominent security and stability problems of the grid, and higher requirements for load-side control resources. Electrolytic aluminum load has the advantages of large controllable capacity and simple control methods, but due to its large individual capacity, it is difficult to respond to the existing stability control strategy of the power grid. Therefore, it is important to study the emergency load shedding technology of electrolytic aluminum load with large capacity and multiple levels. In this paper, according to the basic characteristics of electrolytic aluminum load, its equivalent circuit and topology are established, and the power-current coupling characteristics of electrolytic aluminum load are analyzed. Based on its topology, a graded excision method is proposed and the corresponding active excision amount is calculated. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by field tests.

articleTitle: Harmonic Compensation Analysis of Grid-Connected System Having Photovoltaic and Energy Storage Integrated with Parallel Active Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The growing popularity of non-linear loads and distributed generation can create power quality problems in the grid system. In order to ensure stable system operation, the question of how to improve the power quality is unavoidable. In this paper, a PV energy storage integrated parallel active filter is analyzed to compensate for grid current harmonics in the presence of grid current contamination by nonlinear loads. The maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm of PV and the method of coordinating with the power output of the storage battery are investigated. The integration of power quality improvement and clean energy is achieved. Finally, the system is simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK to verify the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: An Online OCV Calibration-Based Adaptive SOC Estimation Approach for Lithium Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
