Through this filter, the harmonic is extracted and compensated, and the total harmonic distortion is reduced to values which are far less than the limits defined in IEEE519 Standards. Finally, the system is simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK to verify the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: High power density two-phase interleaved boost converter based on coupled inductor
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The boost converter plays an important role in electrical vehicles, which could boost the low voltage of the power battery to a high voltage level to the electric drive system, realizing high voltage drive. However, the input current of the boost converter is high, and the size of the inductor is large, which reduce the power density of the converter. To improve power density of the converter, a coupled inductor is adopted. The magnetic simulation of inductors is conducted by Ansys Maxwell. The theoretical analysis of the converter is performed and a mathematical model is established. A 20-kW simulation model is built with two different inductors. Simulation results show that for the same total input current ripple and input power, the coupled inductor has higher power density and smaller current ripple than the uncoupled one, which verifies the theoretical analysis and feasibility of the design.

articleTitle: A Novel Dual AUV Wireless Charging System Based on Underwater Hybrid Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes a new dual AUV wireless charging system based on a hybrid energy source of fuel cell system (FCS) and lithium battery system (LBS). This system fully utilizes the advantages of wireless power transmission (WPT) technology and integrates the closed hydrogen oxygen fuel cell (CHOFC) system in underwater applications. It is effectively improve the charging efficiency and charging frequency of AUVs. The system adopts hybrid power generation and energy storage system composed of CHOFC system and LBS on the power generation side. By utilizing DC networking technology, parallel power supply has been achieved for FCS and LBS. Considering the voltage of the battery system carried by the AUVs and the design complexity of the WPT system, the DC bus of the system adopts the low voltage level. The WPT structure based on cylindrical coupling coil is proposed for two sets of WPT systems. It is take into account the difficulty of AUV acquisition and the efficiency of AUV energy supply. Both the WPT systems adopt the magnetic coupling resonance architecture to improve energy transmission power and efficiency. The architecture of the FCS and LBS on the power generation side of the proposed system is introduced and analyzed. And the low-voltage DC bus control method and power converter topology structure is designed. The electromagnetic characteristics and coupling coefficient of the cylindrical coupling coil structure are studied. The simulation and experimental platform is built to test and analyze the proposed system.

articleTitle: A data-driven fault diagnosis method for photovoltaic modules
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The existing fault diagnosis of photovoltaic modules mainly focuses on a single fault, while in actual operation, the impact of climate and environmental conditions often leads to multiple faults occurring simultaneously. In response to the above issues, a data-driven composite fault diagnosis method for photovoltaic modules is proposed in this paper. The simulation model of Photovoltaic system is built, and the fault characteristic parameters of photovoltaic modules under different states are extracted according to the output characteristic curves under the three states of normal, single fault and composite fault. The composite fault diagnosis model of photovoltaic modules based on hybrid kernel Extreme learning machine is established. The parameters of hybrid kernel Extreme learning machine are optimized by using adaptive strategy to improve sparrow search algorithm, The accuracy of diagnosis model of hybrid kernel Extreme learning machine is improved. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through a simulation example of the actual operation data of a photovoltaic power plant. The simulation results show that this method can accurately diagnose single and composite faults of photovoltaic modules, and has certain engineering application prospects.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Economic Optimization Dispatching of Medium and Low Voltage Distribution Systems Based on Carbon Emission Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The low-carbon and flexible characteristics of large-scale distributed energy resources will provide new opportunities for interactive support in the medium and low voltage distribution systems. Currently research on low-carbon dispatching in distribution systems mainly focuses on single voltage levels, without considering the interactive support ability between cross voltage levels. Therefore, this paper proposes a low-carbon optimization dispatching method for the medium and low voltage distribution systems based on carbon emissions. This method first equates the low voltage station area to a virtual battery, and introduce carbon emission flow theory to calculate the carbon emission intensity of virtual battery Secondly, a two-layer low-carbon dispatching model for the medium and low voltage distribution systems is constructed and solved by using a alternating direction method of multiplies; Finally, an improved the medium and low voltage distribution systems is applied for simulation verification, and the results show that the proposed method can enhance the interactive support ability of the medium and low voltage systems and reduce system operating costs and carbon emissions.

Author Keywords: medium and low voltage distribution systems

articleTitle: A Protection Scheme for Flexible Low Frequency AC System Power Collecting Line of Offshore Wind Farm Based on Transient High Frequency Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Flexible low-frequency AC (FLAC) technology uses frequencies of 20Hz or 16.7Hz to transmit power electricity, demonstrating significant advantages in terms of economy and transmission capacity, and has broad prospects for application in offshore wind power transmission systems. In the FLAC system of offshore wind power, the two ends of the collection line are connected to wind power and low-frequency conversion equipment, and the fault characteristics exhibit typical weak feedback characteristics, which can easily lead to the failure of traditional protection principles based on power frequency. To address this issue, this paper proposes a new protection scheme for power collecting line based on transient high-frequency energy. When a fault occurs, the fault component of voltage and current is first extracted, then the high-frequency component is extracted to calculate the transient high-frequency energy, thus achieving the discrimination of internal fault and external fault. A simulation model of FLAC system is established on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform. The simulation results show that this scheme can accurately identify faults and has good resistance to fault resistance. The protection scheme is helpful to ensure the safe and reliable operation of FLAC power transmission system.

articleTitle: Aggregation-based Self-dispatch of the Virtual Power Plant with Massive Controllable Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: There are massive small size distributed batteries that possess great potential value to provide energy and regulation services in modern power system operation. To confront the curse of dimensionality caused by a large population of batteries, a polytope-based aggregation approach considering the uncertainty of batteries’ initial energy is proposed in this article, which can formulate the maximum inner approximate feasible region and equivalent cost parameters comprehensively. Furthermore, an aggregation-based energy management approach of the virtual power plant composed of massive controllable batteries is proposed. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed approach are verified through numerical simulations, and the proposed aggregation method can yield a comprehensive energy and regulation capacity dispatch plan with computation efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Detection of Hazardous Sources in the Vicinity of Transmission Lines Based on Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The stable operation of the power system depends on the construction results of transmission lines. To ensure the stable operation of the power system, the detection technology of potential hazardous factors in the vicinity of transmission lines has become a research focus for professionals in the power industry. However, accurately detecting small targets with multiple scales and dense characteristics, containing dozens of pixels, from high-resolution images captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) remains challenging. To address this issue, this paper proposes a cascaded multimodal fusion detector named HSVT-YOLO based on the YOLOv7 algorithm for detecting hazardous sources in the vicinity of transmission lines. The approach integrates multimodal data and utilizes symmetrical compact multimodal fusion techniques to extract complementary information from various data sources, enhancing the ability to detect small targets in high-resolution images and achieving high-resolution detection of objects with multiple scales. Additionally, an efficient cascaded zoom-in detector is employed, where the detector itself is re-utilized for density-guided training and inference. Experimental results on a self-built dataset of overhead transmission lines demonstrate that the detection accuracy of the HSVT-YOLO algorithm is improved by 18.4%, the recall rate is improved by 10.67%, and the mean Average Precision (mAP) is increased by 8.76% compared to the original YOLOv7 model, indicating a significant performance improvement of the proposed model. This advancement is beneficial for the practical application of the hazardous source detection algorithm.

articleTitle: Control strategy and simulation analysis of wind-solar-storage integrated coupling hydrogen production system
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To realize the national energy strategy goal of carbon neutrality and carbon peaking, hydrogen production from wind power and photovoltaic green energy is an important technical way to achieve the dual-carbon goal. Given the random and strong fluctuation of wind power and photovoltaic power, the hydrogen production system of electrolytic water is unstable and the effect of hydrogen production is unsatisfactory. Based on the establishment of a wind power, photovoltaic, and energy storage coupled hydrogen production system, a control strategy based on DC bus voltage stabilization is adopted for the purpose of improving the quality of power generation, smoothing hydrogen production, and enhancing the stability of the system, which can ensure the stability of the bus voltage and the smoothness of the hydrogen production in spite of the perturbation conditions; By using MATLAB/SIMULINK simulation platform to build a wind-solar-storage integrated coupling hydrogen production system, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy and improve the stability of the system.

articleTitle: A Multivariate Load Forecasting Method Based on ESAM-MTL Model
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Long-term dependencies between long time series data of multivariate loads make errors in multivariate load forecasting. Specifically, based on the self-attention mechanism, the efficient self-attention mechanism (ESAM) is proposed in this paper. Compared with the traditional self-attention mechanism, ESAM has lower spatiotemporal complexity and solves the problems of long training time and memory overflow to some extent. Then, by sharing information among multiple load prediction tasks using the Multi-Task Learning (MTL) architecture a multivariate load forecasting model based on ESAM-MTL was established. Case analyses use two datasets for multivariate load forecasting to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fast Power Point Tracking of Two-Stage Photovoltaic System based on Polynomial Approximation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With a higher solar power penetration level, more advanced power control functionalities are integrated into grid codes for photovoltaic (PV) systems, such as frequency support. The fast power tracking point (FPPT) technique enables PV systems to respond to the power command in a desired time. In this paper, a new FPPT algorithm for two-stage PV systems based on polynomial approximation is proposed. By mathematic analysis on the right-side power-voltage (P-V) characteristic of PV panels, a suitable polynomial approximation is used to derive the preset value of PV panel voltage reference so as to improve the tracking speed. In final, case studies using EMTP-RV simulator are carried out, simulation results validate the proposed algorithm in terms of fast dynamic and high accuracy compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: Influence of Permeability on Voltage Stability of PV Inverters through LCC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: According to China’s carbon peak and carbon neutrality strategy, the utilization of high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission for renewable energy transfer has become a focal point for large scale renewable energy development and utilization. As the sending end power grid of HVDC weakens gradually, there may be voltage stability issues, the voltage of the photovoltaic (PV) inverter is too low to operate normally. This article first provides definitions for the differences in short circuit ratios (SCR) at the three interfaces of the three ports network composed of a photovoltaic power station, LCC-HVDC and the AC grid. Next, the critical short circuit ratio (CSCR) expression for the PV inverter point of connection is derived. Finally, based on MATLAB simulation, the accuracy of the CSCR expression is verified.

articleTitle: Price Risk Assessment of Electricity Markets Considering the Uncertainties of Natural Gas Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The large-scale introduction of natural gas units makes the power system and natural gas system more closely coupled, which also results in unsafe and unreliable factors during the operation of the power system. Therefore, based on the interaction mechanism between gas source supply and power market operation, the power market operation risk assessment method considering the uncertainty of natural gas supply is proposed. This method can realize the real-time assessment and analysis of the power market operation risk under different natural gas power generation levels. Firstly, a model of the natural gas system is proposed to convert the influence of the natural gas system into the output of the gas unit. Secondly, the electricity price risk assessment index system considering the uncertainty of natural gas supply including average node price, node price peak, and active load reduction is proposed. Finally, a case study consisting of an IEEE 30-bus system and a 20-bus Belgian gas network is conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method using the Monte Carlo stochastic simulation method.

articleTitle: Short-term wind power prediction based on singular spectrum analysis and modified ConvBiGRU
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The strong fluctuation of wind power, which leads to the failure of existing methods to availably capture the fluctuation characteristics of wind power, is a significant feature in wind power prediction (WPP). Therefore, the short-term WPP method on the basis of singular spectrum analysis (SSA) and deep learning (DL) is proposed. Firstly, SSA is used to process the raw wind power to reduce the interference of its volatility. Secondly, convolutional neural network (CNN) and bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BiGRU) are used to mine the temporal correlations of wind power data from local and global perspective, respectively. Then, the feature extraction of important time points is optimized through the temporal attention mechanism (TAM). Finally, the result of short-term WPP is obtained by using the fully connected layer. An example analysis based on the actual operation data of Jiangsu wind farm shows that the proposed model has better prediction performance than other selected single and combined models, and its root mean square error, mean absolute error and coefficient of determination are 1.913 MW, 1.417 MW and 98.74%, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on True-type Test Technology of Intelligent Circuit Breakers and Intelligent Integrated Terminals in Distribution Networks under Different Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the proposal of the dual carbon goal and the rapid development of new power systems, the distribution network is an important part of the power grid, and the operation of the distribution network has also been greatly challenged. The most prominent problems are fault handling and topology identification. In order to solve the above problems, new equipment such as intelligent circuit breakers and intelligent integrated terminals have been developed, but the functions of the new equipment have yet to be verified. Conduct real system-level, turnkey pilot tests to verify the functionality of new equipment. This article designs and builds a low-voltage side true-type test platform for distribution networks, and proposes test plans for intelligent circuit breakers and intelligent integrated terminals under different faults. The functions of intelligent circuit breakers and intelligent integrated terminals are effectively verified through the low-voltage side true-type test platform for distribution networks, providing guarantees for the safe and stable operation of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Design of Cascade Power Electronic Transformer Based Flexible Interconnection System for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With large number of grid-connected distribution photovoltaics, charging piles, the traditional distribution network faces challenges in power quality and power supply capacity. This paper proposes a flexible interconnection scheme based on cascade power electronic transformer for distribution network. The comparison of traditional power transformer and power electronic transformer is presented firstly. Then, the design of cascade power electronic transformer based flexible interconnection system is illustrated, including topology, control, and system scheme. Finally, experimental validation is provided.

articleTitle: Virtual Inertia Enhancement of DC Microgrid Based on Adaptive Motor Load Control
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To enhance the dynamic stability and security of voltage and improve the inertial response of the DC microgrid after disturbances, this paper proposes a model predictive control (MPC) based method for regulating the speed of motor load, effectively utilizing controllable load resources without the need for additional energy storage devices. Firstly, a linear discrete model of the DC microgrid with motor load is established to predict the future trends of various system state variables. Secondly, a controller is designed with the objective of restraining the rate of DC voltage variation, and constraints are imposed on the rate of change of motor speed and their maximum response range. At each sampling time, the optimal speed adjustment is computed to achieve active response of the motor load. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are validated through MATLAB/Simulink simulation under typical operating conditions.

articleTitle: Decentralized Control Strategy for Modular Three-phase Inverters with AC/DC Power Decoupling
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, a quad active bridge converter for modular photovoltaic inverters is analyzed, which is able to realize the AC/DC power decoupling in the magnetic circuit without increasing the size of the transformer. Besides, a ripple-suppression control strategy is proposed to suppress the voltage ripples caused by the unavoidable parasitic circuit resistance and leakage inductance, so that the bus capacitance can be minimized. Meanwhile, on the basis of this modular structure, a decentralized control system architecture is presented to constitute a decentralized controller for the series-stacked system using the inherent synchronization and power-sharing capabilities of the coupled nonlinear oscillator. The effectiveness of the control strategy was verified through simulation and experiments.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Trigger Switch Scheme for DC Controllable Lightning Arrester
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: During the AC side fault crossing process of the Baihetan to Jiangsu ± 800 kV hybrid DC transmission project, controllable lightning arresters need to be installed to limit the absorption of redundant energy by overvoltage on the flexible busbar. In order to achieve 1 ms rapid input of controllable lightning arresters, it is necessary to develop a high-voltage DC trigger switch. According to the engineering requirements, a topology structure of trigger switch using trigger gap parallel fast mechanical switch was designed, and a fast trigger strategy is developed to clarify the design scheme and key technical parameters of trigger gap and fast mechanical switch. After verification of the trigger switch debugging waveform in the application of the Baijiang Project, the response speed and key technical indicators of the trigger switch fully meet the requirements of the Baijiang Project.

articleTitle: A Multiple-Complex Coefficient-Filter-Based PLL-Less Power Quality Control Method for Photovoltaic Generation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In response to the complex control structure and poor dynamic performance of traditional reactive power compensation and harmonic suppression methods in photovoltaic (PV) generation systems, this paper proposes a multiple complex-coefficient filter (MCCF)-based phase-locked loop (PLL)-less power quality control method. Based on MCCF, the fundamental and harmonic components of the load current are quickly and accurately extracted, and current reference values are generated using the instantaneous power theory of the three-phase system in a stationary reference frame. The zero steady-state error tracking of the fundamental and harmonic currents is achieved through a proportional multiple resonance (PMR) controller. Finally, simulation testing was conducted on the traditional control and the proposed control method using Matlab/Simulink software. The simulation results verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Stackelberg Game Model for Optimal Dispatching of Electricity Consumption for Community Microgrid Considering Demand Response Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Community microgrid is a kind of new power system that acts as an intermediary between community consumers and the grid, playing an important role in realising distributed autonomy and improving the power supply level. To achieve optimal power dispatch in community microgrid, this paper establishes a Stackelberg game model with the community microgrid operator (CMO) as the leader and the consumers aggregator as the follower, and combines the internal pricing method with the demand response mechanism. The paper uses a combination of genetic algorithm and solver to solve the Stackelberg game model to maximise the interests of all parties. Simulation results show that the model can secure the interests of each game subject, balance power supply and demand, and promote peak shaving and valley filling of electrical loads.

articleTitle: Evaluation method for transient reactive power voltage regulation capability of photovoltaic power stations considering power grid status
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to the volatility and randomness of photovoltaic (PV) output, the integration of large-scale PV into the grid has increasingly stressed the stable operation of power systems. Evaluating the regulation capacity of PV power generation contributes to enhancing the absorption capability of PV stations and the overall security and stability of the power system. The assessment of regulation capacity for PV stations mainly involves transient active-power-frequency regulation capacity and transient reactive-power-voltage regulation capacity. The impact of PV power generation systems on grid voltage and their reactive power support capability has been a recent focus and challenge. The integration of PV power generation systems into the grid has a certain impact on the voltage of load nodes, the extent of which depends on factors such as the output of renewable energy sources, connection points, line lengths, and load capacities. Considering the safe and stable operation of PV power generation systems, it is necessary for them to participate in voltage regulation control and make full use of the reactive power regulation capability of grid-connected inverters to provide reactive power support to the grid.

articleTitle: Eco-driving Intelligent Systems and Algorithms: A Patent Review
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The transportation industry remains a significant contributor to greenhouse gas emissions, highlighting the requirement for intelligent systems to enhance vehicle energy efficiency. The intellectual property rights of developed systems should be protected by patents. However, there is no patent overview of eco-driving intelligent systems. Unlike a scientific article, a patent documentation indicates both novelty and commercialization potential of an inventor. To address this research gap, this paper provides a patent overview of eco-driving intelligent systems and algorithms. 424 patents in the Google Patent database are analyzed. The patent analysis results show that the top three Cooperative Patent Classifications are: Y02T - climate change mitigation technologies related to transportation (50.7%), B60W - Conjoint control of vehicle subunits of different types or different functions (34.4%) and B60L - Propulsion of electrically-propelled vehicles (20.2%). 219 patents were filed after 2016 when deep learning became popular and can be categorized into five groups: vehicle energy management, smart driving, ecological and sustainable driving, fuel consumption reduction, and driving behavior optimization. Furthermore, all 219 patents involve the physical components of the intelligent system and/or novel machine learning/deep learning algorithms. Moreover, over 70% of them are granted by the China National Intellectual Property Administration.

articleTitle: A Transient Voltage Stability Preventive Control Strategy for DC Receiving-end Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increase of DC feed power and the decrease of the number of synchronous machines, receiving-end power system takes a serious threat to the transient voltage stability. Therefore, a transient voltage stability preventive control strategy for DC receiving-end power system is proposed in this paper. The whole method is decomposed into three sub-problems: transient voltage stability assessment, sensitivity computation and optimal control. A transient voltage stability index suitable for the sensitivity method is used to construct the transient voltage stability constraints. The accuracy and efficiency of the solution algorithm are improved by limiting the effective control interval of sensitivity and selection of the initial control set. The method has been applied in a provincial power grid in southern China. The results verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch of A Virtual Power Plant with Wind-photovoltaic-storage Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the goal of maximizing economic benefits, the forecast of new energy output and load output in the next 24 hours is carried out, and five dispatching schemes with different combinations of wind, solar, energy storage and demand response are discussed, taking into account the changes in electricity prices on the power grid side at different times. By using particle swarm arithmetic to compare the load coefficient and resident comfort under different dispatching schemes, the power supply composition map and power supply cost under various conditions are obtained, and the calculation results show that both wind, solar storage and demand response participate in the economic dispatch of virtual power plants, which has more obvious effects in reducing the operating costs of virtual power plants, and plays a good role in peak shaving and valley filling.

Author Keywords: economic scheduling of virtual power plant

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method for Electrical Equipment With Imbalanced SCADA Data Based on SMOTE Oversampling and Domain Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The SCADA-driven fault diagnosis algorithm has been extensively researched and applied. However, the highly imbalanced distribution between normal and fault data poses significant challenges in establishing high-performance fault diagnosis models. To achieve accurate fault classification on imbalanced data, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis algorithm framework that combines the SMOTE oversampling method with domain adaptive transfer learning. Firstly, the sliding window sampling technique is used to transform data into two-dimensional spatiotemporal window data. Subsequently, SMOTE oversampling is applied, preserving and enriching the complete temporal fault features. To address the issue of noise introduced by the oversampling algorithm, domain adaptive transfer learning is introduced to extract invariant features between the original and oversampled data, effectively filtering out noise introduced by the oversampling. Experimental results from a real SCADA data demonstrate that the proposed method achieves model training on highly imbalanced data, accurately identifies various fault types, and precisely discerns the corresponding time windows of fault occurrences. The diagnostic performance significantly outperforms models obtained using commonly used oversampling methods applied to handle data imbalance.

articleTitle: Optimization Scheduling and Adequacy Evaluation of Cascade Hydropower Stations Considering the Extreme Weather
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of clean energy, the importance of developing cascade hydropower has grown. However, extreme drought conditions can have a detrimental impact on the optimal scheduling of cascade hydropower. Thus, this paper aims to address the influence of extreme weather by establishing a budget uncertainty set for natural water flow and load. The objective of this study is to maximize the load matching degree of cascade hydropower stations. To achieve this, an optimal operation model for cascade hydropower stations is proposed based on mixed integer linear programming (MILP). The model utilizes piecewise linearization and triangular interpolation techniques. Furthermore, an index system for generation adequacy considering both power supply and load perspectives. Sequential Monte Carlo simulation is employed for simulation purposes. The computational results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively satisfies the demand for priority loads during extreme drought conditions. Moreover, the method exhibits higher power generation adequacy compared to the independent operation of cascade hydropower stations.

articleTitle: Research on Influence Factors in MMC-HVDC Short-Circuit Current Based on Improved Calculation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The short-circuit current in MMC-HVDC power grids increases rapidly and is hard to cut off. And there are many factors that affect the development of short-circuit current. Therefore, it is necessary to research the impact mechanism of short-circuit current in DC power grids. An improved calculation method is proposed for short-circuit current based on the transient energy exchange process after a fault. Based on the improved calculation method of short-circuit current, the influence of electrical parameters such as DC line reactance and resistance, bridge arm effect reactance and resistance, and submodule capacitance on short-circuit power is studied. And the mechanism of different grounding methods on short-circuit current is investigated. The two-terminal MMC-HVDC transmission model is built in PSCAD/EMTDC. The results indicate that the DC inductance has the strongest influence on the short-circuit current, the resistance has less influence, and different grounding modes have obvious impact on the short-circuit current. Moreover, the improved calculation method can accurately describe the evolution of the short-circuit current after a fault, providing an important basis for DC protection setting and system planning and design.

articleTitle: Prediction of SDN Heterogeneous Network Traffic Based on Improved LSTM with Self-attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As heterogeneous network system becomes more and more complex and diversified, it brings the non-stationary and high burst characteristics of network traffic data, leading to difficulties in scheduling network resources. To address this issue, a traffic prediction method for heterogeneous networks based on software-defined networking (SDN) is proposed. First, the SDN-based heterogeneous network measurement and control system (HN-MCS) is investigated, where a network traffic measurement scheme is designed and deployed to achieve real-time monitoring and acquisition of traffic data. Second, the traffic prediction model based on long short-term memory (LSTM) with self-attention mechanism is constructed to enhance the accuracy and reliability of the predicted traffic data. Finally, compared with the prediction models based on support vector regression (SVR), LSTM and bi-directional LSTM (Bi-LSTM), the experimental results confirm that the proposed model can more effectively predict the network traffic and have higher prediction accuracy.

Author Keywords: Heterogeneous network measurement and control systems (HN-MCS)

articleTitle: Economic assessment of a methane production approach integrated with the carbon capture of a coal power plant
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high carbon emissions from coal-fired power plants and to clean up coal power, carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) technology needs to be applied on coal-fired power plants. To study its feasibility and economics, this paper proposes three different CCUS time transformation scenarios for 2023, 2025 and 2030 based on the operational data of a typical 660MW thermal power unit, and It is found that Option 1 requires an investment of 2.904 billion Yuan, which translates into an increase in generation cost of about 0.12088 yuan/kWh, Option 2 requires an investment of 2.323 billion Yuan, which translates into an increase in generation cost of about 0.100583 yuan/kWh, and Option 3 requires an investment of 1.724 billion Yuan, which translates into an increase in generation cost of about 0.07159 yuan/kWh. In response to the problem of high cost of the CCUS renovation scheme, a technical route combining CCUS and methane dry reforming is proposed to use the captured CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> for synthesis gas, and it is found that the expenditure and revenue of 1t CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> due to the consumption of natural gas to make synthesis gas are 1520.7 yuan and 3247.2 yuan respectively, and the comprehensive carbon capture system analysis shows that Option 3 can achieve zero cost decarbonization.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of a pattern-matching control strategy designed for the hybrid power system used in fuel cell vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the promotion of carbon reduction target in new energy vehicles, fuel cell hybrid vehicles driven by proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFC) as the main power source are developing rapidly. In this paper, a novel power allocation rule, named pattern-matching control strategy is proposed for the hybrid power system of a fuel cell vehicle (FCV) with PEMFC and auxiliary lithium battery. To investigate the impacts of the designed strategy on the FCV, both the operation characteristics and economic performance of the power system are analyzed under NEDC (New European Driving Cycle) condition. The results show that comparing to the normally used power-following control strategy, the terminal SOC of the lithium battery in the FCV by using the proposed pattern-matching control strategy is 5.36% lower, which indicates a higher utilization of regenerative braking power and reduces the power requirement of the fuel cell. The hydrogen consumption of the vehicle with the proposed strategy is 3.73% less than that of the normal one and the overall energy efficiency increases by 3.88%.

articleTitle: FTL-EDGE: A Feature Federation Transfer Learning Algorithm For Single Microgrid Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous development of power system and the advancement of intelligence, Microgrid Cluster (MGC) has attracted wide attention as an emerging energy supply and management model. The problem of cooperative and optimal operation of microgrid clusters under privacy protection arises for microgrids belonging to different interest entities. The optimal integration of resources within a single microgrid (MG) is also of positive significance for the overall microgrid cluster. Edge computing, as a distributed computing model, provides an effective data processing and decision support capability for MG. However, the current MG "end-edge-cloud" architecture ignores the privacy of information transfer and communication efficiency between different devices. Therefore, this paper proposes a feature federation transfer learning algorithm FTL-EDGE for single microgrid edge computing, where each device in the microgrid requests the central server to download the basic model in the edge gateway, and the new device model can be converted into a target domain model with limited device-specific data using transfer learning techniques. Different devices in the microgrid train their own target domain models locally and upload features to the cloud. The cloud aggregates the domain model features of each device, performs scenario derivation and global policy search, and sends the policies to each device. The experimental results show that this method achieves resource cost optimization under a single microgrid and improves the overall economic efficiency of the microgrid and reduces the communication overhead compared with the methods of independent operation and deep reinforcement learning.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Photovoltaic Energy Storage DC Technology In Municipal Stormwater Detention Tank System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to effectively promote the goals of China's dual carbon strategy, accomplish energy conservation and carbon reduction in municipal infrastructure, and harness the potential of renewable energy sources, this paper presents a novel direct current (DC) power supply system for municipal stormwater detention tank (SDT) based on photovoltaic energy storage DC technology. The paper provides the fundamental design principles and methods of this system. In this study, an analysis is initially conducted on the current state, operational characteristics, energy consumption features of the power supply systems for municipal SDT, as well as the advantages of applying photovoltaic energy storage DC technology in municipal infrastructure systems. Furthermore, taking into consideration the operational characteristics specific to municipal SDT, we propose a robust DC power supply system integrating photovoltaic and energy storage technologies. In addition, we present the design methodology for this system, encompassing crucial aspects such as system architecture design, voltage level determination, and capacity matching calculations, among others. This system facilitates direct utilization of photovoltaic energy to power the variable frequency load of the SDT, eliminating the need for conversion and rectification processes. Consequently, it significantly enhances both the utilization rate of renewable energy and the overall system efficiency. Moreover, this approach also amplifies the safety of system operation. Furthermore, in response to the operational requirements of municipal SDT, a meticulously crafted operational control strategy was devised for the system. Ultimately, through the construction of a physical DC power supply and consumption system, comprehensive testing and verification were conducted to assess the effectiveness and reliability of the system designed in this paper and its corresponding operational control strategy.

Author Keywords: Renewable Energy Supply and Consumption System

articleTitle: Market equilibrium analysis under the coupling of carbon market, energy usage right market and electricity market
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With China’s policy of dual control of energy consumption and carbon emission, the profitability of power generation enterprises in the market is not only affected by the fluctuation of the electricity market environment, but also restricted by the usage right of energy and the emission rights of Carbon. In order to simulate the impact of this restriction on power generation enterprises in China’s electricity market, this paper established a market equilibrium model under the coupling of "Energy Usage Rights"market, "Carbon Emission Rights" market and electricity market. The mathematical model of power producers' participation in coupling market was proposed in this paper, and the behaviour of each kinds of generators was analyzed. Moreover, Co-evolutionary algorithm is used to solve the Nash equilibrium under the coupling of the three markets. The results of coupling trading mechanism and single power market equilibrium are compared, the impact of power-carbon-energy coupling trading mechanism on power generators is analyzed, and the coupled trading mechanism has advantages in conroling of energy consumption

articleTitle: Virtual Contribution Theory-Based Bidirectional Loss Allocation Method for Active Distributed Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Loss allocation plays a pivotal role in power transmission and distribution services as it is integral to the reconciliation process between generator-user settlements. The advent of distributed generation over the recent years has introduced bidirectional power flow along transformers and mainlines in conventional distribution networks, complicating the calculation of power losses and the rectification of transactions between generators and users. In this study, we introduce the Virtual Contribution Theory, constructing a virtual contribution matrix to elucidate how generators and loads utilize and occupy distribution networks. By integrating this theory with Power Flow Tracing, we present a novel bidirectional loss allocation approach rooted in the Virtual Contribution Theory, designed to account for power losses in active distribution networks. This method offers significant advantages over traditional loss allocation methodologies by mitigating various shortcomings such as complex calculation processes, low solution efficiency, and limitations in bidirectional power flow computations. Moreover, it enables fair allocation of power losses between generators and loads in the retail electricity market. To validate the effectiveness and feasibility of our proposed approach, we carried out tests on IEEE 33 and IEEE 69 systems.

articleTitle: Wind Direction Numerical Simulation and Application Based on Wind Direction Vector Correlation and Two-dimensional Spatial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A wind direction numerical simulation algorithm based on wind vector correlation and two-dimensional spatial neural networks is proposed to achieve accurate numerical simulation of the target unit wind direction using the measured wind directions of wind turbine network. The study firstly proposes a calculation method combining wind direction vector and included angle vector, which provides a new perspective for solving the "circular characteristic" problem of wind direction data. Secondly, the wind direction data between wind turbines is verified to possess strong correlation according to kernel canonical correlation analysis(KCCA). Then, two-dimensional spatial back propagation neural network(BP) and recurrent neural network(RNN) are adopted to establish the wind direction vector numerical models, which are trained by SCADA wind direction data of wind farms in different terrains respectively. The results show that the numerical simulation error angle of the wind direction in the offshore and plain areas is only 1.1°~2.6°, and the abnormal identification of wind direction measurement is realized effectively.

articleTitle: A chance-constrained dispatch for distribution networks to improve flexibility
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: After a high level of distributed photovoltaic (PV) is integrated into the distribution networks, the traditional dispatch of capacitors and switches can hardly deal with the strong uncertainty of PV power. Therefore, this paper proposes a chance-constrained dispatch method for distribution networks to improve flexibility using a variety of flexibility resources. Firstly, based on typical scenes, a multi-objective chance-constrained dispatch model including economy and flexibility is established. Secondly, a method based on the selection of clustered scene into typical scene set is proposed to find a solution satisfying the chance-constrained formulations. The efficiency and accuracy for the chance-constrained formulations are improved. Finally, the alternating solution method based on the improved Seagull optimization algorithm (SOA) combined with the improved Minty algorithm is proposed to not only reduce the solution space but also helping for finding an optimal or near optimal solution. The simulation of the actual power distribution system in Jinan area is to verify the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed model comparing with the existing methods.

articleTitle: A Review of Titanium-based Lithium-ion Sieve
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The increasing popularity of lithium-ion batteries has resulted in a surge in demand for the element worldwide. However, since lithium reserves continue to dwindle, there is a pressing need to investigate and implement new methods for extracting lithium from liquid lithium sources such brine and seawater. Lithium-ion sieve adsorption (LIS) is widely regarded as the most promising approach for extracting liquid lithium due to its low energy requirements and minimal impact on the surrounding ecosystem. The titanium oxide lithium ion sieve utilized in this approach has a stable structure, a low dissolution loss rate, and is reusable—all of which contribute to the method’s advantageous qualities. This work summarizes the current state of knowledge regarding the chemical composition, preparation method, modification technology, and molding process of lithium-titanium oxide (LTO) materials.

articleTitle: Scalable dissipative analysis for multi-wind turbine combined with common battery energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper deals with dissipative analysis for the scenario that multiple wind turbine (WT) combined with a common battery energy storage system (BESS) in a scalable way. We require that when a new WT is added to the existing system, the dissipativity of the entire system only needs to be verified for the newly added sub-WT system, without the need for overall re-verification. We solve this requirement in three steps: First, we model the multi-WT combined with a common BESS by integrating the analytical frameworks of multi-equilibrium switched system theory and interconnected system theory. Then, we provide the sufficient conditions for the dissipation of single WT combined with single BESS. Lastly, we use these conditions combined with the scalability theory to provide the scalable dissipative conditions at the subsystem-level. We show that the dissipative analysis of the system including the new WT subsystem can be achieved through local validation alone, thereby reducing the computational difficulty. Finally, a numerical simulation example is presented to validate the accuracy of the obtained results.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis Technology Combining Machine Learning and Causal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A machine learning and causal analysis based online rapid assessment method for transient security and stability of power grids is proposed to address the rapid expansion of power grid scale and the increasing time consumption of online security analysis. Based on the expanded power grid operation mode samples, key feature quantities reflecting the transient safety and stability characteristics of the power grid are extracted by comprehensively utilizing machine learning and quantitative analysis results. Using a clustering method that takes into account the security and stability mode of the power grid, obtain the benchmark method for clustering. On this basis, historical operation mode clusters that match the current real-time mode are identified through operation mode matching, achieving online rapid assessment of transient security and stability of the power grid. The correctness and feasibility of the proposed method were verified based on the actual power grid.

Author Keywords: Rapid assessment method for transient security and stability

articleTitle: High Voltage Ride Through Strategy for Full DC Wind Power Generation System Through DC Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The onshore full DC wind power generation system can effectively address the challenges of resonance and reactive power transmission in large-scale wind power AC convergence. However, the full DC wind power generation system transmitted through High-voltage direct current still carries the risk of high-voltage tripped from the grid. To handle this problem, the expression of the transient voltage at the wind power grid connection point after DC blocking is established. And the output power variation characteristics of the Grid connected inverter (GCI) are analyzed, the DC bus overvoltage mechanism is clarified. Secondly, based on the active and reactive power regulation capability of the DC/DC converter and the GCI, a coordinated control strategy for high-voltage ride-through is proposed, which focused on two perspectives: reducing the voltage at the grid connection point and mitigating the active power imbalance. Finally, a simulation model is constructed using the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform to verify the accuracy of the mechanism analysis and the effectiveness of the suppression strategy.

articleTitle: Research on lightning strike warning of overhead transmission lines by integrating PMU data
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Lightning strike tripping accidents on power transmission lines have occurred repeatedly, causing serious economic losses. To find out the precise location of lightning strikes in transmission lines and to provide early warning of lightning strike tripping phenomena are of great significance to transmission line operation monitoring. The traditional lightning strike warning has a certain lack of accuracy. This paper innovatively proposes Monte Carlo method of transmission line lightning strike warning incorporating PMU data. This method first completes the filtering and noise reduction of PMU data to derive real-time changes in line parameter values. Then, on this basis, it deduces whether the line is tripped and achieves accurate fault location and determines whether the tripping phenomenon is related to the weather based on real-time falling lightning point data. Finally, the improved Fuzzy C-mean clustering algorithm (IFCM) is used to obtain the center of mass of cloud clusters and the density of falling lightning points, combined with the Monte Carlo method to determine the probability value of lightning strikes on transmission lines within a short period of time. Simulation results show that the proposed method can find out the probability value of lightning strike under the limited data conditions and realize the graded lightning strike warning according to the derived probability value, which can guarantee the safety of transmission lines to the maximum extent.

articleTitle: Extreme Scenarios of High Percentage of Renewable Energy Connected to Power System: A Review on System Power and Electricity Balance Aspect
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The intensification of global climate change has brought about more and more extreme weather events, which, combined with the stochastic and volatile nature of renewable energy sources, have caused serious impacts on the power system, and consequently, preserving the supply and promoting the consumption have become two major problems in the power system in terms of the balance of power. Based on this, the extreme scenarios in the high proportion of renewable energy connected to the power system are studied. Firstly, the difference and connection between extreme scenarios and extreme events and the worst scenarios are clarified, the definition and characteristics of extreme scenarios are given, classification methods and identification methods of extreme scenarios are analyzed; subsequently, the generation methods of extreme scenarios are studied for the small-sample characteristics of extreme scenarios; furthermore, the application of extreme scenarios in the scheduling of the power system, flow analysis, and planning is summarized; Finally, countermeasures for extreme scenarios are proposed, and the direction of subsequent research on extreme scenarios is pointed out, which provides ideas for the subsequent construction of a flexible and reliable power system with balanced supply and demand.

articleTitle: A Quantile Intervals Prediction Based Power-voltage Control Method with Storage Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: After the large-scale integration of new energy into the power grid, the rapid changes in the output of new energy stations have led to increased system voltage fluctuations, making it difficult to coordinate and control multiple types of reactive power sources. After adopting traditional deterministic reactive voltage control, the random changes in the output of the new energy station and loads in the system may lead to exceeding voltage limits. So considering the prediction error of new energy and load in the system, the predictive quantile interval method is proposed to carry out the dynamic reactive power and voltage control of the wind, solar, hydro, thermal, and storage power system in typical scheme considering active power control of energy storage, so as to minimize the active power loss and voltage deviations of the system, and solve it by branch and bound method; in order to suppress fluctuations in new energy and loads, nodes with wind farms, photovoltaic power stations and loads are equipped with a certain capacity of energy storage, and their supporting inverter devices provide reactive power compensation; so power and energy constraints of energy storage are considered in the dynamic reactive power optimization control; special consideration is given to the climbing constraints of synchronous units and the frequency regulation effect of hydro and thermal units in actual regulation in the control model. The control effect of the proposed method is verified in IEEE 118 bus system, which greatly reduces the degree of voltage out of limit and the occurrence rate of voltage out of limit under various random scheme, and effectively responds to the random change of new energy and load.

articleTitle: Research on The Security of Power Cyber-Physical System Considering Communication Network Failure
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Advanced sensing technology and information communication technology make the interaction between information layer and physical layer in power system more and more complex. It also creates the conditions for the propagation of the fault, this paper presents an approach to evaluate the safety of the power cyber-physical system, which takes into account the failure of the communication network. Firstly, in order to quickly judge the direction of fault propagation, based on the power cyber-physical system model, the dynamic partition model of power cyber-physical system based on improved genetic algorithm is studied. Then, we study the cascade failure process among the regions, and the system stability state is used as the criterion to determine the fault propagation cut-off boundary. Finally, the security evaluation index system of power cyber-physical system is proposed to evaluate the security under fault cascading propagation. The effectiveness of this model is proved by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Day-ahead optimization strategy considering demand response in power-based virtual power plant
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the surge in electricity load in many parts of the country, the value of virtual power plants for regulating electricity load is becoming more and more apparent. Therefore, this paper proposes a day-ahead optimal dispatching strategy considering load demand response mechanism with a multi-energy microgrid system as the research object. Based on source-load data and time-of-use tariff data, the price-based demand response mechanism is used to guide users to actively participate in load adjustment, and the day-ahead optimal scheduling model is developed to enhance the precision of each applicable cost optimization objective., and the power variance of each distributed power source is used as the objective function to establish the optimal scheduling model. The model is solved by calling the Cplex solver using YALMIP, and the optimal power curve and operating cost values of each distributed power source at different stages are obtained. The simulation shows that the optimization strategy proposed in this paper improves the economy of microgrid energy system operation.

articleTitle: Carbon Footprint Analysis of Processes in Typical Steel Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As an industry with high energy consumption and significant pollution, the steel industry is one of the industries with the largest carbon emissions. This paper analyzes the carbon footprint of steel enterprises, considering its calculation boundary, calculation methods and emission factors, and establishes an input-output model based on the life cycle method and input-output method to analyze the carbon footprint of steel enterprise; Taking the actual production data of a steel enterprise as an example, the carbon footprint analysis is carried out. The results show that the carbon footprint of the steelmaking process accounts for 37.29% of the carbon footprint of the entire iron and steel enterprise, followed by 28.12% of the sintering process; From the perspective of various greenhouse gas emissions, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions have the largest carbon footprint, accounting for 90.57% of the total carbon footprint, while CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O emissions are relatively small, accounting for 0.18% and 9.25% of the total carbon footprint respectively. Through the carbon footprint analysis in this paper, a set of energy-saving and carbon-reduction measures can be established to optimize each process, which using blast furnace gas, electricity and pellets rationally can be used to reduce the use of coke and anthracite. By collecting and utilizing greenhouse gases such as CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O, the sustainable development of steel enterprises can be realized.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamic Threshold Multivariate State Estimation of Condenser Based on Marine Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The static threshold analysis of condenser running states only based on running parameters can lead to missed detections and false alarms of abnormal states caused by variations under the marine environment. This study proposes a condenser running state analytical method based on the dynamic threshold multivariate state estimation approach related to the marine environment. Firstly, dynamic threshold for running parameters is formed based on the thresholds obtained from different marine environmental samples under time-series data. These thresholds are derived by applying an improved Gaussian Mixture Model to conduct multi-sample clustering of running parameters, in combination with evaluation criteria functions. Secondly, the condenser’s running state is determined by comparing the running parameter values with the dynamic threshold. An improved Multivariate State Estimation Technique is applied to estimate the condenser’s running parameters values using a distinguished state matrix related to marine environments. Additionally, the condenser’s running state are identified through the sliding window similarity assessment. Finally, through validation with time-series data of the condenser, it is demonstrated that the proposed method can accurately distinguish the running environments of the condenser and correctly evaluate its running states.

articleTitle: Dispatching Strategy Based on Energy Storage Loss and Data-Driven for Urban Integrated PV and Energy Storage Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: PES-CS is an asset-heavy project. A single scheduling strategy cannot be applied to all scenarios that are built in different locations and have different daily charging peaks. This paper proposes an urban PES-CS scheduling strategy based on energy storage loss and data-driven. Through analyzing historical data and formulating a scheduling strategy based on user charging and discharging preferences, reduces the energy storage loss of PES-CS in daily operation, and extends the energy storage usage time. First, a model of system revenue and energy storage loss is established according to the operating characteristics of the system. Second, a PES-CS operation scheduling strategy targeting decreased energy storage loss is proposed by analyzing historical operating data. Finally, using the accurate PES-CS historical operation data for simulation verification. The simulation results show that the proposed dispatching strategy not only can effectively reduce the pressure of PES-CS on the power grid during the peak power period, but also reduce the degradation cost of energy storage and improve the economic benefits of PES-CS.

articleTitle: Carbon emission evaluation and potential assessment of energy saving and carbon reduction for iron and steel enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to quantitatively evaluate the carbon emission level and the potential of energy saving and carbon reduction of iron and steel enterprises, a set of index system framework and energy saving and carbon reduction potential evaluation model for the steel and iron enterprise are constructed. The improved fuzzy analytic hierarchy process(FAHP) is adopted to comprehensively evaluate the carbon emission level of a steel enterprise. With the data of the enterprise in 2016 as the base year, the current situation of the carbon emission level of the enterprise in 2021 and the trend of the future development level in 2025 were obtained through comparative analysis. The evaluation results show that, compared with the base year, the carbon emission level in 2021 and 2025 has a year-on-year growth rate of 229.21% and 275.7%, respectively. In the evaluation results, the comprehensive energy consumption per ton of steel has the biggest impact on the carbon emission level of the enterprise. According to the energy saving and carbon reduction potential assessment model based on gray prediction, the energy saving rate per unit output and carbon reduction rate per unit output in 2025 compared with the base year are 10.38% and 17.59% respectively.

Author Keywords: energy saving and carbon reduction potential

articleTitle: Research Progress and Case Analysis of Suspended Particulate Matter Distribution Control in Integrated Transportation Hubs
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the context of promoting green development in urban and rural areas, this study comprehensively examines the research progress and technical frameworks for controlling the distribution of suspended particulate matter in street canyons within integrated transportation hubs. Through the analysis of typical case studies, it provides in-depth insights into street canyon spatial optimization measures in different integrated transportation hubs. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed technical framework are validated, thereby offering valuable references for controlling the distribution of suspended particulate matter in street canyons within integrated transportation hubs.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Flexible Loads for New Building Clusters Considering Potential Games
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: New building clusters are an important terminal form for the development and construction of new power systems. However, due to the wide variety of electricity loads and significant differences in electricity usage habits among building clusters, it is of great significance to utilize new building clusters to regulate controllable loads to ensure the safety and reliability of the distribution network. Therefore, a two-stage robust optimization method is proposed for a new building cluster aggregator to consider the uncertainty of new energy output and user satisfaction with electricity consumption, in order to achieve cluster regulation of flexible loads. The rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method were demonstrated through numerical examples, indicating that the proposed model and method are beneficial for improving the resilience of new building clusters, power grids, and aggregators to resist uncertainty risks.

articleTitle: Research on Topology Construction and Switching Control Strategy of Wind Power Multi-terminal, Low-frequency Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the situation of global energy transformation and vigorous development of new energy, the proportion of offshore wind power in the amount of power generation from new energy resources has been increasing, and the research on offshore wind power related technologies has become increasingly important. For large-scale development of offshore wind power, on one hand, it is necessary to improve the grid connection reliability of the wind power itself. On the other hand, it is also necessary to develop new technical roads to improve the transmission efficiency, make full use of the transmission capacity of existing transmission lines or relieve the pressure on the construction of offshore transmission channels. Therefore, this paper will focus on offshore wind power, carrying out relevant research on offshore wind power and multi-terminal, low-frequency transmission technology based on modular multilevel matrix converter (M3C). This paper proposes feasible topologies and a switching control strategy for the multi-terminal, low-frequency transmission system, which achieve coordinated control among multiple M3Cs. A simulation model of the wind power multi-terminal, low-frequency transmission system is built on PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform to verify correctness and effectiveness of the topology and the control strategy.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy System Considering Carbon-Green Certificate Trading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the background of the carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, the inability of the power system to absorb renewable energy is a growing problem because of the high proportion of renewable energy connected to power grid. In order to increase the use of renewable energy sources in integrated energy system (IES) and promote the development of low-carbon economy, this paper proposes a day-ahead optimal scheduling method for IES, taking into account carbon trading and green certificate trading. Firstly, the operation theory of carbon trading and green certificate trading is investigated, and the risk cost is introduced to deal with the uncertainty of wind and solar output. Then, taking the wind-solar-thermal power generation system as the core, an IES optimal scheduling framework based on the carbon-green certificate trading mechanism is built to complete the carbon quota constraints and renewable energy consumption responsibilities. Finally, considering the unit power constraints, ramp constraints, start-stop constraints, power flow constraints, equipment operation and maintenance cost of IES, the IES optimization scheduling model considering carbon- green certificate trading mechanism was constructed, aiming to minimize the total system cost. The results indicate that this method can increase the dissipation level of IES renewable energy, which is economical and low-carbon.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Real-time Approach for Robust Optimal Power Flow in Three-Phase Unbalanced Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The challenges of growing uncertainties associated with renewable energy generation and flexible loads become pressing nowadays. To effectively address them and enhance intelligent capabilities for various levels of dynamics, power distribution systems are undergoing an development with advanced real-time monitoring and optimization functions. In this paper, we propose a learning-based approach aimed at solving the optimal power flow (OPF) problem in three-phase unbalanced distribution systems. A deep neural network model is developed and applied to learn the mapping relationship between system loading and optimal power generation settings. Then the model is trained by adding linear constraints to find a near-optimal and feasible solution. This method can provide a reference for the power settings of distributed generators (DGs) and phase-changing soft open point (PC-SOP). Compared with traditional methods, this method has a faster solution speed, making it possible to realize near real-time optimization.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Compensation of 10kV A-Line by MCR Reactive Power Compensation Device under MFAC Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper delves into the compensation principle and mathematical modeling of the Magnetic-Valve Controllable Reactor (MCR) reactive power compensation device. It further investigates the device's response attributes under two distinct control strategies: Proportional Integral (PI) control and Model Free Adaptive Control (MFAC). A comparative analysis is drawn between these two control strategies, examining their stability, stability margin, and steady-state output error. The performance of the MCR reactive power compensation device deployed on a 10kV AC bus under both control strategies is discussed. The paper underscores the viability of the MFAC control strategy for the MCR reactive power compensation device. Furthermore, the device's ability to counter sudden reactive power shortages, as per the 10kV A-Line analysis model, is explored.

articleTitle: Spatial Correlation-Based Ultra-Short-Term Power Generation Prediction of Grid-connected Distributed PV in Counties
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to the lack of historical power generation data and the unavailability of accurate numerical weather forecasts, a large proportion of distributed PV plants cannot make ultra-short-term forecasts of their power data using existing mature technologies. A spatial correlation-based ultra-short-term power prediction method for distributed PV in the county is proposed. Firstly, spatial correlation analysis is performed for distributed and centralized power plants in the same meteorological environment, and based on clustering, all distributed power plants in the region with correlation coefficients reaching a threshold value with their respective centralized power plants are equated to one virtual centralized power plant; then the ultra-short-term power prediction data of the centralized power plants are obtained by the long short-term memory neural network (LSTM) prediction method. Finally, the virtual centralized power plant power prediction data is obtained by curve fitting from the centralized power plant prediction data, and the ultra-short-term power prediction data of all distributed power plants in the region is obtained by summing up all the virtual centralized power plant prediction data in the region. Taking a photovoltaic power station in Teng County, Wuzhou City, Guangxi Province as an example, the effectiveness of this method is verified, and it has certain practical significance for the construction and grid connection of photovoltaic power stations in the future.

articleTitle: A Multi-consensus Distributed Economic Dispatch Strategy for Integrated Energy System with Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) plays an important role in improving the efficiency and economic benefits of modern power grid by combining various types of energy supply devices (usually electricity and thermal). With distributed devices widely integrated into current power system, these devices bring new challenges of rapid intense power mismatch. Energy storage system (ESS) provides significant benefits to power system by compensating the power-deviations. However, the nonlinear operating characteristic of ESS causes tasks of high displacement cost of ESS and complex operation degradation cost. This paper presents a two-layer multi-consensus based EDP model of IES with energy storage (ES) and formulates its nonlinear operating cost function of each device. Then, a multi-consensus distributed algorithm is proposed to achieve a reasonable optimal economic dispatch result by maintaining the convergence of increment-cost of each device. The proposed algorithm considers the operation safety in a short time scale, as well as economic benefits and operating reliability in long time scale. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is illustrated through simulation studies on a IES system which consists of a 39-bus power system and a 32-node thermal system.

articleTitle: Optimization Operation Model of Integrated Energy System in Expressway Service Area with P2G
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
