abstract: Under the background of carbon peaking, carbon neutrality and integrated development of transportation and energy, and in view of the current situation of high emission and high energy consumption in expressway service area (ESA), an optimization operation model of integrated energy system (IES) including gas turbine, wind, photovoltaic, energy storage system and hydrogen is established with the lowest system operation cost and energy purchase cost as the objective function, which introduces power to gas and fuel cell to achieve bidirectional coupling of electricity and hydrogen. Then this paper takes a large expressway service area in the northwest of China as an example and sets different scenarios for example analysis. The simulation results show that the total operation cost of the system is greatly reduced and the utilization rate of renewable energy is effectively increased, which indicate that the proposed model can improve the system operation economy, green and low carbon development, and diverse interactivity while meeting the energy requirements of electricity and hydrogen in expressway service area. It has significant application value in promoting sustainable development in the fields of transportation, energy and power.

articleTitle: H∞ Filtering Method for WSNs with Privacy Protection under FDI Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For wireless sensor networks (WSNs) under false data injection (FDI) attacks, the study focuses on the design problem of an elastic H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> filter under privacy protection. In this paper, a privacy protection strategy is investigated to encrypt the information at the next moment while protecting the initial data of the system. Secondly, the wireless sensors are distributed in various positions of the target to be perceived, and there will be several groups distributed in space. The attacker simultaneously attacks the system and the communication links of several sensors. Based on privacy protection, an elastic distributed network is designed, where the purpose of the estimator is to obtain an approximation of the genuine condition information of the system. By introducing the Krein space state model, the distributed estimator is able to estimate the actual state at each moment as accurately as possible. Additionally, by setting up weighted matrix parameters, an alert can be generated for the next FDI attack. Finally, comparative experiments are conducted with systems lacking privacy protection methods to validate the efficacy of the approach for designing distributed estimators.

articleTitle: Energy management strategy for hybrid energy storage considering battery fatigue life in cascade utilization
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Power batteries are about to usher in an upsurge of decommissioning in the replacement. Utilizing them as energy storage cascades in new energy power stabilization can alleviate the recovery pressure and environmental pollution problems, and at the same time improve the problem of poor economics in the energy storage industry. To make better use of the battery life cycle, this paper proposes a hybrid energy storage energy management strategy that considers the battery fatigue life of cascade utilization. First, the fatigue life of decommissioned power battery materials was analyzed, and a life estimation model was established. Then, the hybrid energy storage technology was used to reduce the capacity and power of the energy storage system configuration. The double battery control technology was combined to reduce the battery life attenuation. Optimize the power smoothing window of moving average(MA) algorithm considering the battery life and the imbalanced state caused by double battery control. Finally, a simulation was carried out on the MATLAB/Simulink platform. The results show that the strategy in this paper can reduce the life attenuation of decommissioned power batteries while ensuring that the wind power meets the grid-connected requirements.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Carbon Emission Factors of Power Supply in Regional Grids Model Using Proportional Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate carbon emissions accounting within power supply regions is crucial for enterprises managing carbon emissions and achieving the "dual carbon" goal. This study introduces a model for power exchange within provincial grids, focusing on the 500kV level. A novel carbon emission factor calculation method is proposed to address uncertainties in power generation types and their carbon footprints. The method determines on-grid/off-grid power in other regions based on proportional distribution. It adheres to conservation principles and inter-provincial power equilibrium. A strategy for allocating power generation types in exchanges is presented. Distinct models are constructed for total and specific power generation within the province. Case studies demonstrate the practical efficacy of the model.

articleTitle: Anti-Power Supply Disturbance Optimization Design and Self-Correction Measurement Method of TMR Current Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The tunnel magnetoresistance current sensor is susceptible to power supply disturbances, resulting in a decrease in measurement accuracy or even failure. In this paper, the influence of power supply voltage change on tunnel magnetoresistance current sensor is studied, and a self-correction measurement method of power supply disturbance based on voltage feedback is proposed to suppress the interference effect of power supply disturbance. A self-correction measurement method of power supply disturbance based on voltage feedback and its self-correction sensor model are proposed. By synchronous sampling of power supply voltage signal and sensor monitoring signal, and using self-correction algorithm for synchronous signal processing, the interference suppression problem of power supply voltage disturbance is solved. A voltage feedback tunnel magnetoresistance current sensor prototype was developed and an experimental platform was built for experimental verification. The experimental results show that when the power supply only contains ripple, the measurement error of the sensor without self-correction measurement method is less than 1%, while the measurement error after self-correction measurement method is about 0.11%, which effectively suppresses the interference of ripple. In the range of ±10% change of working power supply, the measurement error before correction is about 9.55%, while the measurement error after correction is less than 0.49%, which effectively suppresses the interference effect of power supply voltage disturbance on the measurement results, and proves the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed optimization method.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Interval Prediction Method Based on Deep Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Wind power forecast is of great importance to the grid planning and dispatching. In view of the fact that traditional wind power prediction is mostly point prediction, the results generally have different degrees of error, and the wind speed signal used is mostly the wind speed signal at one point, ignoring the relativity of different place, resulting in insufficient forecast accuracy. This paper proposes a new forecast method on the basis of deep convolution neural network(DCNN). This method combines the DCNN and short-term memory network(STMN), uses the DCNN to gain the long-term wind speed spatial distribution characteristics, and uses the STMN model to obtain the short-term time series characteristics, which can simultaneously gain the forecast limits of the wind power considering the wind speed at multiple points, and can efficiently describe the incertitude of wind energy output. By comparing and analyzing with other methods, it can be seen that the design proposed in this paper can obtain better prediction precision and shorter response time, which can predict the intervals of wind power more excellent, and at the same time provide decision-making support for long-term reliable operations of the grid connection of wind energy.

articleTitle: Equilibrium Analysis of the Electricity Market Considering Strategic Bidding by Coalition of Renewable Energy and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Large-scale grid connection of renewable energy and the reformation of electric power system promote renewable energy to compete in the electricity market, while the bid deviations caused by the volatility of renewable energy make it inferior in the electricity market competition. Shared energy storage can improve the limitations such as low resource utilization in the traditional business models for energy storage and has broad development prospects in renewable energy absorption. First, an electricity market framework is presented, in which wind power producers, photovoltaic (PV) power producers and energy storage form a coalition to participate in the bidding competition in the mode of cooperative and sharing. Second, a multi-period stochastic equilibrium model of the electricity market is established. In addition, the strategic behavior of wind, PV and energy storage and the market equilibrium outcomes are studied. The Shapley value method is used to allocate profits from the coalition. Finally, the simulations show that wind, PV and energy storage compete in the market in cooperative and sharing mode can effectively reduce the bid deviations and boost profits of renewable energy producers and energy storage.

articleTitle: Optimal Electricity Dispatch Strategy for Urban Residential Quarter Considering Nearby Battery Swapping Station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid popularization of EVs (Electric vehicles), the uncoordinated charging and swapping behavior of residential EVs may increase more power load during the peak period of the original urban power grid, affecting the stability of the power grid. Therefore, based on the high potential for scheduling the charging and discharging operations of EVs and batteries of battery swapping stations in residential quarters, this paper proposes an optimal dispatch strategy for urban residential quarters considering nearby battery swapping stations. First, the paper establishes a two-stage optimal electricity dispatch model that takes models of residential PV, the V2G (vehicle to grid) function of EVs, and the nearby battery swapping station into account. Second, to compare the total electricity cost and peak-valley difference before and after optimization, the paper also establishes a model for simulating uncoordinated charging and provides evaluation indices for comparison. Finally, based on specific data from a residential quarter in Shanghai and a nearby NIO battery swapping station, the effectiveness of the optimal electricity dispatch strategy is verified, and a specific scheduling plan is provided.

articleTitle: Wind-CSP collaborative optimization method based on source-load multivariate correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to alleviate the prominent contradiction between new energy and thermal power in the process of optimized operation of the new power system, under the premise of comprehensively considering the correlation of wind power-photovoltaic heat-electric load, we construct the wind power-photovoltaic heat synergistic optimized operation model based on the source-load multivariate correlation, and validate the model's effectiveness by taking the improved IEEE39 node as an arithmetic example, so as to provide the theoretical support for the economic and safe operation of the new power system containing wind power, CSP, and thermal power.

articleTitle: A method for evaluating the adjustable capacity of electrolytic copper load based on modeling of power regulation characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous growth of new energy installed capacity, the problem of deterioration of grid source-side flexibility is becoming more and more prominent, and there is an urgent need to develop load-side flexible regulation resources. Electrolytic copper load, as a typical electrolytic heat storage type high energy consumption load, has good demand response characteristics, but there is no power regulation characteristic model and adjustable capacity assessment method for this load, which limits the possibility of electrolytic copper load to participate in the interactive control of the power grid. According to the production process and load topology of copper electrolysis, this paper establishes the equivalent circuit and active-voltage external characteristic model of copper electrolysis load, analyzes the response characteristics of copper electrolysis load under three power regulation methods, and proposes the quantitative calculation method of adjustable capacity of copper electrolysis load. Finally, the relevant parameters of the electrolytic copper load model are obtained by the least-squares identification method combined with the field measurement data, and the theoretical values of the simulation model are basically consistent with the field measurement values when using the model proposed in this paper for the power control of the electrolytic copper load through the combination of the RTDS simulation model and the field test, which fully proves the accuracy and validity of the model and the method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: A Risk Decision Method for Online Emergency Control Adapting to Strong Uncertainty Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Problems of emergency control strategy failure and mismatch will be caused by varying operation modes of new power system and large deviation of control measures. Therefore, an online decision method for emergency control considering strategy adaptability risk is proposed. Models which quantitatively evaluation uncertainty of power grid operation mode and control measures implementation are constructed. Adaptability of emergency control strategy to changes of power grid operation mode and control measures implementation in future period is quantitatively evaluated. An emergency control decision model considering strategy adaptability risk constraints is constructed. Based on convex and concave coefficient of emergency control target, emergency control strategies are enumerated and simulated to realize rapid decision of emergency control. It is shown that considering strategy adaptability risk in emergency control decision-making is helpful for strategy to adapt to uncertainty changes of power grid operation mode and control measures implementation. The correctness of the proposed method is verified by an actual power grid case.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration Method for Dynamic Reactive Power Compensation in AC/DC Receiving-end Systems Considering Reactive Power Support of Local Synchronous Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In regions characterized by relatively rapid economic development, where available sites for configuring dynamic reactive power compensation devices are limited, and substantial investment costs are involved, a solution is needed. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a bi-level optimization model that accounts for the contribution of synchronous generators to dynamic reactive power compensation in AC/DC receiving-end systems. In this model, the local synchronous generators are used as a kind of dynamic reactive power source, which can offer their transient reactive power support during system faults to minimize the additional demand for dynamic reactive power compensation devices. And the Dynamic and Static Comprehensive Load Rate is proposed to identify vulnerable voltage nodes as installation candidates. On this basis, the objective function of the upper-layer optimization model is maximum the comprehensive assessment index on behalf of transient reactive power support by generators, which optimizes the initial operational state of generators to enhance their reactive power support capability for vulnerable voltage nodes. In the lower-layer optimization model, the improved Voltage-reactive Trajectory Sensitivity Index is utilized as the objective function to determine the optimal installation nodes and compensation capacity. Finally, an improved 22-node system with dual feeders is taken as a case study, which validated the effectiveness and economic viability of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A PV Power Prediction Method Based On Optimized VMD and Combination Prediction Model Selection Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Solar energy, as a low-carbon, environmentally friendly, and efficient renewable energy source, has received extensive attention in the past few decades. However, the irregularity of sunlight and weather conditions make it challenging to integrate photovoltaic (PV) power into smart grids on a large scale. Therefore, obtaining reliable and effective PV power prediction results is crucial for the management and dispatch of new energy sources. In this study, a PV power ensemble forecasting system (PVEFS) combining improved data decomposition techniques and optimal combination prediction model selection strategy is proposed to accurately predict the volatility and irregularity of PV power. Firstly, the PV power sequence is decomposed into multiple intrinsic mode function (IMF) components using optimized variational mode decomposition (OVMD), and these components are used as inputs for multiple predictors. Subsequently, each predictor optimizes its initial parameters based on the IPSO using the input data and combines them into multiple combination prediction models based on the entropy weighting method to predict the IMF components. The optimal combination prediction model is selected for each IMF component based on comprehensive error evaluation indicators (CEEI). Finally, the selected combination models for each IMF component are trained, and the final prediction results are obtained by reconstructing the modes. Experimental results demonstrate that PVEFS achieves higher prediction accuracy for PV power.

articleTitle: A New Coordinative Control Strategy for Renewable Generation and STATCOM during Imbalanced Voltage Sags
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper presents a new coordinative control strategy for the renewable generation and STATCOM to improve the low voltage ride through (LVRT) capability, reduce voltage imbalance and limit fault current simultaneously during the imbalanced voltage sags, which are marked as the most important control objectives of inverter-interfaced renewable generation (IIRG) and STATCOM during imbalanced voltage sag condition. The proposed method coordinates the control of both renewable generation and STATCOM to achieve better voltage support capability than the single equipment during the imbalanced voltage sag, especially during the severe unbalanced voltage drop scenarios. The advanced voltage support algorithm, which utilizes both positive and negative sequence components, is firstly proposed to maximum voltage support capability of both renewable generation and STATCOM. Then, the voltage balance control algorithm and current limitation are designed individually. In order to optimize such three control objectives in different voltage conditions, the classification algorithm of voltage sag is then designed. Finally, the optimized coordination control of renewable generation and STATCOM is then proposed in each voltage conditions. Finally, case studies and evaluations based on MATLAB/Simulink are carried out to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Configuration Method for Distribution Network Resilience Enhancement Using Two-Stage Game Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to cope with the impact of extreme weather on distribution network, a two-stage multi-objective game optimization-based method of energy storage configuration for distribution network resilience enhancement is proposed in this paper. First, typical scenarios are generated based on N-k contingency as well as distributed photovoltaic (DPV) output characteristics, and evaluation indexes of resilience and economy are established. Then a two-stage multi-objective optimal configuration model is proposed, considering the operating state and resilience demand of distribution network before and after the power supply transfer. Finally, the model is solved by multi-objective particle swarm (MOPSO) and Nash game. Simulation results on the modified IEEE33-node model demonstrate that the proposed method can achieve good equilibrium solution between resilience and economy.

articleTitle: 2-D Images Combination and Expanded-Channel ResNet Based Power Quality Disturbance Recognition Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the widespread access to multiple energy systems, different degrees of power quality disturbance (PQD) have emerged in the power system, significantly impacting all stages of power generation, transmission, and consumption. Accurately identifying PQD lays the foundation for the safe operation and regulation of power quality within the power system. However, in traditional PQD recognition schemes, limited image feature information and insufficient algorithm recognition capacity are identified as key problems. To address these issues, a novel PQD recognition approach based on 2-D image combination and Expanded-Channel ResNet (ECRN) is proposed. Considering the insufficient time-frequency domain feature information, this article effectively combines Stockwell transform (ST) with Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) to construct multi-channel PQD image that contain sufficient time-frequency domain feature information. In terms of the recognition algorithm, to better extract features from the disturbance images, this paper improves the traditional ResNet structure by expanding its channel and creates ECRN to achieve automatic and adaptive feature extraction from multi-channel images. The PQD recognition method is simulated and compared with state-of-the-art recognition approaches. The results demonstrate that the proposed method has good anti-noise performance and can more accurately extract PQD feature information to achieve higher recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Flexibility Resources Aggregation and Disaggregation Method Considering Renewable Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the pressure of new energy consumption increases, load side resources serve as economic regulation resources to provide flexible regulation capabilities for the power grid. To reduce the scheduling, computing, and management burden of ubiquitous access of distributed resources, the load side resource aggregation provide an interface for grid collaborative scheduling. By using the aggregation equivalence method based on the zonotope to characterize the time-varying scheduling parameters of resources, an aggregation method is proposed to construct an approximate objective function considering the demand of new energy consumption inside and outside the cluster. The aggregation loss is divided into periods with lower demand for new energy consumption, thereby improving the effective accuracy of the aggregation method. In the disaggregation process, design new energy consumption factors to maximize the consumption of new energy within cluster. Finally, through practical example verification, the aggregation efficiency of clusters covering multiple types of resources such as source, load, and storage was verified. The results showed that the improved aggregation and disaggregation methods effectively improved the regulatory efficiency of load side resource participation in assisting new energy consumption.

articleTitle: Topology Identification of Distribution Network Considering Radial Bus Connection Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The existing topology identification schemes of distribution networks usually require comprehensive system parameters or data difficult to acquire; or the schemes may lead to an inaccurate topology such as looped or split topologies. The inaccurate topology information will lead to misleading control signals, making the distribution network easy to cross the stability boundary and collapse. To solve these issues, this paper explores a novel topology identification scheme of distribution networks based on historical voltage data. First, the distribution network model and the correlation of nodal voltages is analyzed. The nodal voltage correlation problem is then transformed to a lasso problem, whose solution provides neighbor sets of individual buses. Second, to get the accurate bus connection, a novel update strategy of neighbor set considering the local structural characteristics of the distribution network is proposed. Third, to identify the distribution network topology that conforms to the radial structure, an improved OR rule for branch recovery is proposed. The improved OR rule is used to recover the branch based on the updated neighbor set, which can effectively avoid the closed-loop or split situation of the identified topology. Finally, experimental results confirm the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Grid adequacy evaluation method considering the influence of new energy transmission channel transmission capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing installed capacity of new energy, there are problems such as blocked power flow of transmission channel and decreased power supply of local grid during the period of new energy major. In this paper, a grid adequacy evaluation method considering the influence of new energy transmission channel transmission capacity is proposed. Considering the sensitivity of the active power of the transmission channel, the active power output of the sending generator and the spare capacity of generators, the linear programming calculation model of the transmission power of the power transmission channel is established. Meanwhile maximum transmission capacity range of the power transmission channel is obtained. Based on the current operation mode of the power grid and short-term/ultra-short-term planning data, the adequacy indicators of the sending and receiving power grids in the current and future periods are established. An example based on actual grid shows that the proposed method can effectively reflect the transmission capacity of transmission section and the sufficiency degree of local grid.

articleTitle: Electric Network Stimulation-Response Relationship and Its Characteristics under Time-Varying Amplitude and Frequency
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The process of equipment-regulated time-varying amplitude and frequency (A/F) internal voltage generating power via an often inductive network plays a critical role in determining the dynamic behavior of a power system. Although in traditional power system analysis, the results of "quasi-steady state" assumptions are often reasonable due to the network's time constant often being fast enough compared to the equipment-controlled internal voltage dynamics, the present increasing integration of converter-interfaced equipment with its inherent fast A/F dynamics of internal voltage raises concerns about the original inherent relationship of the network and its characteristics that could potentially impact the system dynamics. However, even the necessary A/F relation between such a voltage and its generated current over an inductive component is unable to be obtained, along with the corresponding interpretation as the oscillatory integration problem in mathematics. To address the demands, this paper first presents the system closed-loop regulation mechanism and points out the physical reality of different equipment time-varying A/F in the system dynamics. It then illustrates a generalized method to establish explicit expressions for the original inherent stimulation-response relationship of the network and provides a typical example. Several observations are obtained, especially regarding the physical mechanism of the terminal active/reactive power generation in relation to the time-varying A/F of the internal voltage, and its potential impact on the evolution of system dynamics. In addition, this paper identifies differences in the system's dynamic behaviors that may arise from commonly used static network relationships, even for electromechanical timescale dynamics. This work aims to lay the foundation for further understanding of the physics and analytics of the network under the equipment-regulated time-varying A/F.

articleTitle: Economic Evaluation of Build-in ESS Technology for PV Plant in Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The development of energy storage technologies may significantly improve the economic benefits and resource utilization of renewable generation, and effectively mitigate the impact of high penetration of renewable energy on power system. An economic evaluation method based on cost-benefit analysis is proposed in this paper to select the most economically viable energy storage technology for the renewable generation plant. The method involves constructing an integrated dual-layer mathematical model of a PV power plant with build-in ESS, assessing the economic viability of different energy storage technologies considering technical characteristics of energy storage. The outer model is designed to simulate the clearing and operation of the power spot market, while the inner model optimizes the chronological operation of the PV-ESS plant. A case study is performed for a specific 500MW PV power plant in a power spot market to compare the economy of 4 types of energy storage technologies. The proposed economic evaluation method offers valuable insights to generation companies for seeking sustainable and efficient energy solutions.

articleTitle: Multi-Target Pedestrian Tracking Using Radar and Visual Detection Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Pedestrian Multi-object Tracking (MOT) is crucial in surveillance, autonomous driving, and pedestrian density detection. An important challenge in MOT is detecting environmental disturbances like bad weather, occlusion, or tracking failures due to distance. Current methods rely on machine vision, extracting features and establishing trackers. However, these methods solely depend on image data, limiting detection accuracy in unstable conditions. To address this, a method is proposed that combines millimeter wave radar and camera sensors. The radar provides anti-interference, range, and depth measurements, while the camera offers target recognition and orientation. In dealing with the detection relationship between the two sensors, the distance measure in the logarithmic domain is used for matching. In terms of detection results and tracking, the utilization rate of detection results is improved by using the method of secondary matching. This fusion method reduces computational burden and improves stability by complementing missing data from any sensor. The MMW radar and camera fusion tracking algorithm is validated using an experimental platform, demonstrating significant performance enhancements compared to single-sensor tracking.

articleTitle: Robust economic dispatching algorithm of uncertain microgrid based on tie-line power tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: For microgrid with new energy and load uncertainty, this paper develops an algorithm for tie-line power tracking of power distribution network and microgrid economic performance optimization. In the day-ahead planning stage, the worst-case scenario of the uncertain microgrid is searched, and the day-ahead optimal solution is computed by the column constraint generation algorithm in the form of interaction of master-subproblem solving. In the Intra-day Scheduling Phase, the real-time measurement data of new energy and load are utilized to fulfill the secondary adjustments on the basis of the day-ahead optimal solution. Thus, it can not only effectively track the power command of the tie-line with power distribution network, but also achieve good economic performance and robustness. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a simulation case.

articleTitle: Influence Mechanism of PLL on Active/Reactive Voltage Excitation and AC current Amplitude/Frequency Response Relationship of LCC-HVDC station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With increasing penetration rate of renewable energy in the weak power grid, the large-scale application of Line Commutated Converter based High Voltage Direct Current (LCC-HVDC) Transmission has led to dynamic issues threatening the stable operation of the system, such as overvoltage at the sending end and wide-range oscillations. Within these dynamic issues, the converter station regulates the direct current via AC-DC conversion, thereby affecting the amplitude of the AC current, meanwhile the firing angle command and phase-locked loop (PLL) position establish the frequency of the AC current. This implies that the converter station no longer serves solely as a load for power transmission but follows the mechanism to regulate active and reactive power by adjusting the amplitude/frequency of the output AC current. Especially the PLL control approach is vital in understanding this operational mechanism in the weak power grid. However, current research primarily focuses on mathematically describing the converter station based on physical connection relationships, neglecting the necessity to comprehend the operational mechanism to understand how devices influence the stable functioning of the system. Actually, the relationship between the output AC current's amplitude/frequency and power excitation represents a generalized description of the converter station's operational mechanism. Consequently, researchers fail to establish the influence mechanism of the PLL approach on this excitation-response relationship. Therefore, this paper reveals the operational mechanism of the converter station in adjusting the output AC current's amplitude/frequency based on active/reactive voltage (representing the meaning of active/reactive power) as well as the excitation-response relationship. Then, it focuses on the process where active/reactive voltage regulates the frequency of the AC current through phase-locked error, clarifying the influence mechanism of PLL on AC current frequency regulation. Finally, the simulation is added to further explain the influence mechanism of PLL.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Switched Event-Triggered Load Frequency Control in Multi-area Power Systems With Stochastic Actuator Failures
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Stochastic actuator failures caused by such as spring aging or hydraulic leakage may result in random switches among different operating modes of the load frequency control (LFC) system, posing a serious challenge to the frequency stability of multi-area power systems. Thereby, an asynchronous switched adaptive event-triggered LFC strategy is investigated in this paper. A series of operating scenarios are firstly preset according to the actuator failure severities. Then the event-triggered control (ETC) parameters containing controller and event-triggered detector (ETD) which corresponds to each faulty scenario are designed to stabilize the LFC system with a low network bandwidth occupancy. Fully considering that the controller and ETD cannot be simultaneously adjusted due to the existence of communication network, design constraints and update criteria of ETC parameters are strictly derived to guarantee exponential stability when the LFC system switches among different faulty scenarios. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method has been verified by conducting a series of simulations.

articleTitle: Design of Driving Strategy and Protection Circuit Based on IGBT in MMC Sub-Module
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As new energy sources play an increasingly important role in the energy supply system and control the development of power semiconductor devices, a wide variety of power semiconductor devices have become an integral part of industrial, consumer and scientific research. Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has the characteristics of small switching loss and low output voltage harmonic distortion wind, so the IGBT combination of MMC sub-module has a bright future in new energy applications. Because of the excellent switching characteristics of IGBTs, they are becoming dominant in high-power applications. In this paper, the driving circuit of each sub-module of MMC is studied, focusing on the IGBT driving strategy and protection circuit, and finally the driving mechanism and protection circuit are experimentally verified.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Port Clusters Integrated Energy System Considering Shared Energy Storage and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the aim of promoting green port construction and enhancing energy efficiency within port areas, this paper presents an optimized operation strategy for port clusters Integrated energy system based on the differences in port load behaviors and their flexibility characteristics. Firstly, by integrating the concept of "sharing economy" with energy storage, a centralized investment approach is adopted to share stored electrical energy among various ports. Simultaneously, a demand response model is constructed considering the flexible load characteristics of different ports, facilitating flexible time shifting of electricity and improving the consumption capability of local renewable energy. Furthermore, taking advantage of the multi-energy coupling in port areas, an optimization model for coordinating the power output of energy devices within the port area and external grid electricity purchase is established, considering both economic and environmental objectives. Using a specific port area in China as a case study, the results validate that the proposed strategy can enhance energy efficiency, reduce operational costs and peak power supply pressure from the grid for port clusters, while also taking into account the environmental sustainability of the system operation.

articleTitle: Review on Evaluation of Power Communication Network, Dispatching Automation System and Distribution Automation System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The secondary system such as power communication network, dispatching automation system and distribution automation system of the power system has achieved rapid development, which has played an irreplaceable role in improving the level of automation, interaction, and informatization of the power system. Therefore, the progress of research was comprehensively evaluated from three aspects: power communication network, power system dispatching automation system, and distribution automation system. The research results in the comprehensive evaluation of power communication networks mainly focus on quality evaluation and risk assessment. Most of the research on dispatching automation systems focuses on intelligent device development and advanced application theory research. The comprehensive operation evaluation of the distribution automation system also mainly focuses on the two aspects of system operation evaluation and system economic evaluation. Finally, the construction of the secondary system of the power system has achieved some fruitful results, and the direction of secondary system development in the future is pointed out.

articleTitle: Design of Online Verification and Optimization Decision System for Emergency Disposal of Power Grid Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To effectively reduce the impact of complex and severe faults on the power grid, an online verification and optimization decision-making system for emergency disposal of power grid faults has been designed. Firstly, standardize the modeling of traditional fault emergency disposal and extract the typical structure, constituent elements, and organizational approach of fault emergency disposal. A general description method for fault emergency disposal has been established to achieve structured and modular processing of data. Then, based on the actual fault handling process of the power grid and the priority of handling multiple types of safety and stability issues, the effectiveness of adjustment measures, disposal speed of control measures, control costs, and other constraints are comprehensively considered. Calculate specific control measures, control areas, and control quantities based on the stage of fault disposal. Translate rough handling points into specific control measures and suggestions to achieve online verification and optimization decision-making for fault emergency disposal. Finally, the practicality of the system is verified through an example in the article.

articleTitle: Resilience Enhancement of Urban Energy Systems through Coordinated Operation of Electric Buses
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Increasing frequency of the occurrence of high impact and low probability (HILP) contingencies has posed significant threats to the power system. In this context, resilience enhancement of the power system has drawn wide attention across the world. Electric buses which are characterised by fixed operation mode, both temporally and spatially, have natural advantages in providing resilience for the power system. Additionally, since electric buses are dispatched in a centralised manner, their control cost is much lower than private EVs. In this paper, alternative control/coordination strategies aimed at enhancing the resilience of energy supply in urban areas are investigated by optimizing the use of V2G provision by EBs in order to respond to major events that interrupt the connection to large-scale remote generation sources. A novel dispatch rescheduling approach is proposed considering the trade-off of both the requirement of supply security and transport service fulfilment under disruptive events. Through a series of case studies, we demonstrate that public EBs have significant potential to provide resilience enhancement to the urban energy system based on appropriate control strategy, particularly by mitigating the curtailment of essential load during disruptive events.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of HVDC Converter Stations for AC-DC Mixed Power Grid with High Penetration of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: High voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission is the best option to deliver generated power especially from renewable energy, e.g. wind and solar farms that are far away from the load center. However, one of the key challenges in designing the HVDC integrated into the receiving end AC power grid is to optimize the location for HVDC converter stations of different capacities. Optimizing the location of HVDC converter stations has significant impact on the system short circuit capacity, voltage stability and multi-infeed short circuit ratio (MISCR). The optimal sizing and placement problem of HVDC converter stations is formulated as a complex multi-criteria decision making which considers economical efficiency, power system stability, and the power flow distribution of the grid. A case study based on the IEEE 39-bus system with high penetration of renewable energy is performed to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The ranking of the optimal locations is done by combining grey relational theory and technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS). The results demonstrate that the proposed method can locate optimal sites for HVDC stations at different capacities.

articleTitle: Study on Predicting and Warning of the Wet Flue Gas Desulfurization System Slurry Poisoning Based on Improved K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To address the problems of increased load of the wet flue gas desulfurization (WFGD) system, decreased WFGD efficiency, and shortened equipment service life caused by slurry poisoning, this paper proposes the optimal clustering center selection strategy based on k-means clustering and the differential threshold method. This paper constructs a normal operation space of the WFGD system, and to achieve real-time early warning of slurry poisoning faults in the WFGD system. With the combination if mathematical abstraction and mathematical analysis of business experience, our experimental results show that the warning duration of the model is 88.75% within 4 hours before the slurry poisoning fault occurs, and 98.32% when the slurry poisoning fault occurs. No alarm was generated for a stable time after the slurry poisoning fault was repaired. The constructed health state space of the WFGD system can effectively cover the health state of the system and has a good prediction ability for slurry poisoning failure.

articleTitle: Comparative Evaluation of Thermoelectric Decoupling Potential and Economy of Multi-type Small Capacity Thermal Power Units In Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In our country, There are various types of multi-type small capacity thermal power units in virtual power plants. To explore the potential of thermoelectric decoupling of small-scale thermal power units, this article uses different technological paths to transform multiple small-scale thermal power units for thermoelectric decoupling. While meeting the coupling conditions of small-scale thermal power units, the thermoelectric decoupling results of different small-scale thermal power units are compared and analyzed with the economics of different transformation methods, and improve the efficiency of energy management by transforming the unit. The selected case unit is used as the calculation object, and the thermal and electric parameters of the selected unit are used. The EBSILON Professional software is used for simulation and analysis, and the load space of multiple units is evaluated and compared. According to the calculation results, water-cooled back-pressure units have a larger potential for thermoelectric decoupling among different units and have obvious advantages over other units. Water-cooled back-pressure units can also obtain the maximum heat load for extraction steam heating. As the extraction steam heat load changes, the potential for thermoelectric decoupling of water-cooled condensing units changes smoothly and is the easiest to control. The heat pumps transformation methods for water-cooled condensing steam turbine units, air-cooled condensing steam turbine units and water-cooled back-pressure turbine units have the best economics.

articleTitle: Enhancing Flexibility in Integrated Energy Systems in a Low-Carbon Context: Status and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Integrated energy system (IES) is becoming increasingly crucial to enhance flexibility in the transition towards a low-carbon and clean energy system. This paper investigates the definition of flexibility and analyzes the challenges of the power system in the context of low-carbon transition. Subsequently, the definition of flexibility in IES is derived based on that of the power system. Afterward, modeling approaches for improving flexibility in IES are discussed. Finally the flexibility identification and assessment in IES, the flexible scheduling and operation of IES, and the flexibility market mechanism for IES are reviewed to investigate the flexibility-improving measures for IES. This review paper aims to provide an overview of the current state of research on the enhancement of flexibility in IES under a low-carbon background and presents prospects in this area.

articleTitle: Planning of Park Integrated Energy System with Peer-to-peer Trading Cooperation under Electricity-carbon-green Certificate Market
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of blockchain and information technology, peer-to-peer (P2P) trading has become a new market mechanism for rapid development between park integrated energy systems (PIES). In the context of the electricity-carbon-green certificate market, P2P trading will have a significant impact on PIES distributed resource planning. This paper proposes a PIES distributed resource planning model considering the electricity-carbon-green card market under P2P transactions, carries out cooperative games under the Nash bargaining theory, and applies the alternating direction multiplier method(ADMM) to seek the game equilibrium to realize the sharing economy. The example demonstrates the effectiveness of the model and the improvement of new energy consumption and cost-effectiveness.

articleTitle: Portfolio Trading Strategies for Integrated Generators in the Electricity Mid to Long-term and Spot Markets
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To balance the stable power quality of traditional energy generation with the scale economy advantage of high penetration of wind and PV generation, this paper focuses on integrated generators, firstly identifies the dependency of Renewable Portfolio Standard and tradable green certificate, the decision constraints of which on the power market portfolio trading strategy of integrated generators is clarified. Based on the technical characteristics of power generation, a decision framework is proposed that relies on the complementarity of thermal, wind, and PV units to meet the planned generation, and then allocates the power assets into multiple sub-markets of mid to long-term and spot. Combining the expected return, variance, and utility function model of the modern portfolio theory (MPT), it determines the multi-energy portfolio and multi-market allocation ratio of the integrated generator. Finally, we verify the feasibility of the portfolio model by case study. The influence of wind and PV power generation correlation and thermal power cost fluctuation on the portfolio trading strategy is also explored.

Author Keywords: mid to long-term and spot markets

articleTitle: Dual-Hysteresis Control of Bi-directional Noninverting Buck–Boost Converter for Wide Voltage Range in Energy Interconnected Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The energy interconnection system (INS) connects multiple power systems to enable energy transfer among power Systems. By connecting two renewable energy systems with Bidirectional converters, the energy transfer of the systems can be realized. Bidirectional non-inverting buck-boost (BNBB) converter is widely used in this application. Energy interconnection system based on BNBB can not only achieve efficient energy transfer, but also achieve a wide range of input and output voltage conversion. Firstly, an energy interconnection system based on BNBB is presented, which can realize efficient energy transfer of power systems in a wide voltage range caused by long cables. Secondly, a Dual-Hysteresis Modulation (DHM) and a control strategy is proposed for BNBB, which enables BNBB to operate in buck mode, buck-boost mode, boost mode and filter mode according to the port voltage relationship and control signal. These four modes increase the overall efficiency of the converter. With the control strategy, the disturbance rejection while mode switching is optimized by hysteresis design and continuous voltage ratio. Finally, a prototype with an input of 80V ~ 120V and an output of 80 ~ 150V @ 1500W is fabricated to demonstrate the DHM and its corresponding control strategy. The experimental results have verified that the proposed control method can achieve smooth mode switching.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Model Construction for ISC Faults in Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries have garnered widespread popularity in recent years due to their high energy density and strong cycling performance. However, with the continued advancement of their specific energy, the issue of internal short-circuit faults has emerged as a primary safety concern, leading to significant personal injuries and economic losses for users. Despite the urgency of the matter, current studies on internal short-circuit faults suffer from inadequate fault modeling schemes. To address this need, our paper endeavors to establish a total parameter estimation model in order to accurately ascertain the kinetic and transfer properties of lithium-ion batteries. Additionally, we have constructed an electrochemical-thermal coupling 3D model to simulate the electro-thermal behavior of batteries experiencing internal short-circuit faults, which will enable us to extract the electrothermal characteristics and fault features of batteries throughout the evolution of said faults.

articleTitle: Digital Power Grid Technology Maturity Assessment Based on the Delphi Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Digital grid technology plays an important role in the transition from the traditional grid to the digital power grid. In order to study its development status and future application, this paper adopts the Delphi method for technology maturity assessment. Firstly, the maturity assessment index system of digital power grid technology is constructed from the three aspects of performance, economy and society; secondly, the Delphi method is used to construct the corresponding maturity model, and the technology maturity is divided into the technology research and development stage, the pilot validation stage, the engineering application stage, the maturity application stage, and the lagging phase-out stage; ultimately, the maturity level of digital power grid technology is derived, and its future application is given as a suggestion, which provides a valuable reference for the development of digital power grid.

articleTitle: Research on energy management of multi-charging station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electric vehicle charging station can coordinate the scheduling of photovoltaic power generation units, lithium battery energy storage units, and electric vehicle charging loads to improve the utilization rate of renewable energy. This paper takes the group of optical storage stations as the research object, and based on historical data, the photovoltaic power prediction based on random forest and the load power prediction of electric vehicles based on BP neural network are realized. At the same time, this paper establishes a static energy management model, determines the objective function and budget conditions, studies the energy transactions between optical storage stations, and substitutes the predicted data into the energy management model. The linear programming algorithm is used to optimize the load index of each charging station, reduce the operating cost and improve the economy. Based on the historical data of three optical charging stations, simulation analysis shows that the energy management strategy proposed in this paper can effectively optimize the load index of each optical charging station and improve economic benefits.

articleTitle: Value of CCUS Technology to the Modern Power System and Policy Framework Design
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing global energy demand and the on-going climate change, efficient utilization of fossil energy and reduction of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions have become important research areas. This study aims to outline the potential value of carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) technology in building a new type of power system. CCUS (carbon capture, utilization and storage technology) is a key emission reduction technology under the carbon neutrality target, which is crucial to the transformation of China's coal-based energy structure. This study analyzes the technological development of each link in the CCUS industry chain, compares the level of CCUS technology, commercial applications and support policies at home and abroad, analyzes the value of CCUS for building a new power system, discusses a reasonable development path for coal power in China considering CCUS technology, and finally puts forward relevant recommendations.

articleTitle: State Vector Evaluation of Energy Storage Plants Considering Battery Loss Characteristics Under Different Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The inclusion of energy storage plants in the power system has become a major development direction in the future, and a reasonable evaluation of the state of energy storage plants can effectively promote their safe and stable operation. In order to achieve accurate evaluation and global observation of the state of energy storage power plants, a state vector evaluation method for energy storage power plants considering the loss characteristics of batteries under different operating conditions is proposed. Firstly, considering the operational efficiency and health state evaluation needs of energy storage power plants, a state evaluation system of energy storage power plants containing the dimensions of reliable energy supply, system health and environmental protection benefits is constructed. Considering the different characteristics of state evaluation, the reference value idea is introduced to improve the evaluation value transformation process. The TOPSIS evaluation model is used to determine the positive and negative correlations of the state of the energy storage plant, so as to obtain the state vector. Meanwhile, the problem of dynamic evaluation and global observation is solved by using the time weight vector and time dimension. Finally, the scientificity of the proposed evaluation method and the validity of the state evaluation are verified through arithmetic examples.

articleTitle: Stochastic Optimal Scheduling of Photovoltaic-Energy Storage Charging Station Based on WGAN-GP Scenario Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: To address the optimal scheduling of photovoltaic-energy storage charging station (PV-ES CS) under the background of the new power system construction, a stochastic optimization strategy based on the Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) scenario generation is proposed. This work comprehensively considers the randomness of photovoltaic (PV) power and electric vehicles (EV) charging load, as well as the influence of carbon trading and demand response mechanisms on carbon emissions and operating costs. First, the WGAN-GP network is utilized to generate scenarios of PV output and charging load, followed by scenario reduction using the Density Peak Clustering (DPC) algorithm. Second, the ladder-type carbon trading and demand response mechanisms are introduced to reduce carbon emissions and promote PV consumption. Finally, a stochastic optimal dispatching model with the objective of maximizing the revenue of the PV-ES CS is constructed, considering carbon emission cost, grid electricity purchase cost, PV curtailment cost, and demand response cost. A case study using the actual parameters of a domestic PV-ES CS is conducted to validate the effectiveness of the scenario generation algorithm and the proposed optimal scheduling strategy. Results of case study demonstrate that the ladder-type carbon trading and demand response mechanisms can further limit carbon emissions and promote PV consumption.

articleTitle: An IDM-Based Two-Stage Robust Balance Analysis Model for High-proportion Renewable Energy Integration through HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the circumstance of the new-type power system, uncertainties on both sides of supply and demand lead to prominent characteristics of supply-demand probabilistic matching and multi-regional complementarity, which greatly increased the balance risk during system operation. In this regard, this paper proposes a short-term electric power balance analysis model for a renewable energy power base transmitted through a high-voltage direct current (HVDC) system. First, a detailed cascade hydropower system (CHS) and HVDC model are constructed , and different linearization techniques are applied to linearize different nonlinear constraints, reducing computational complexity. Second, to effectively capture the uncertainty of renewable energy, an Imprecise Dirichlet model (IDM) based method for constructing uncertainty sets is designed, greatly reducing the conservation of the robust optimization. Finally, a two-stage robust optimization model with mixed-integer recourse is established to analyze the potentially unbalanced state by minimizing the operational and curtailment costs. The proposed two-stage robust optimization model is a solved column-and-constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm by using customized nested. The result of the numerical verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Topology Identification of Low-Voltage Distribution Networks Considering Hidden Errors
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate topology information is the key to supporting these requirements of coordinated operation of source-load-storage resource in low voltage distribution network (LVDN). The comprehensive coverage of smart meters provides a data basis for low-voltage topology identification (LVTI). However, due to electricity theft, PLC crosstalk, interruption of communication, the measurement data will be distorted, which will seriously affect the performance of LVTI methods. Thus, this paper defines the hidden errors and proposes a LVTI method based on layer-by-layer stepwise regression. Firstly, a multi-linear regression model for LVTI based on the energy conservation principle is established. Secondly, the significance factor according to F-test was proposed to modify the identification results considering hidden errors. Thirdly, the regression model and significance threshold parameters were iteratively updated layer by layer to improve the recall rate of the final identification results. Finally, the test system simulation of 63 users and practical application results show that the proposed method can ensure more than 90% of the precision rate under the influence of hidden errors, which has significant engineering application value.

articleTitle: Load Adjustable Potential Assessment Considering Load Flexible Control and Air Conditioner Load Response in Extremely Hot Weather
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper presents a solution to achieve the purpose of reducing the load on the grid during extreme hot weather for the purpose of solving the current challenges of supply-demand imbalance during extreme weather. These challenges encompass load shifting for business and industry, and rigid loads to safeguard people's electricity consumption. In order to solve this type of problems, this paper proposes a load management method for adjustable potential assessment, which utilizes residential regulation, tapping load potential, and load flexible control measures to achieve the purpose of regulating conformity, and establishes a relevant model as well as a regulation scheme under this framework. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy in extreme weather for the purpose of grid load reduction.

articleTitle: Development and application of on-line analysis and optimal control system for short-circuit current of AC-DC hybrid power network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the power grid and the increasingly close connection between the power grids, the power grid is facing the problem of excessive short-circuit current. In order to detect the risk of short-circuit current exceeding the standard in time and provide control measures to reduce short-circuit current, an on-line analysis and optimization control system of short-circuit current is designed and developed to improve the accuracy of short-circuit current calculation and give control measures to reduce short-circuit current to meet the requirements of power grid security and stability. In this paper, the overall architecture, software/ hardware design and implementation of the developed system are described. The key technologies of system application such as model parameter quality improvement technology, branch short-circuit current calculation technology and short-circuit current intelligent assistant decision-making technology are discussed. By analyzing the results of practical application cases, the results prove the effectiveness and feasibility of the system. The present system has been applied online in China Southern Power Grid.

articleTitle: Research on optimal scheduling of integrated energy system based on coordinated control of flexible load
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The paper mainly studies the flexible load coordinated control and optimal scheduling technology in the integrated energy system to make full use of the virtual energy storage effect, reduce the demand for actual energy storage devices, and thus reduce the system construction cost. The main research contents are as follows: Firstly, the integrated energy system model with flexible load is studied in depth. This involves analyzing the operation principle of each piece of equipment in the integrated energy system of electro-thermal coupling and establishing the corresponding mathematical model. Secondly, the reliability improvement of integrated energy systems with flexible loads is explored. To this end, we perform state estimation of the integrated energy system and establish a supply and demand state measurement model and a fault state identification model for the electronic system and the thermal subsystem to determine whether the integrated energy system needs load reduction. Finally, we focus on the optimal scheduling of integrated energy systems with flexible loads. In this part, we use multi-agent technology to establish a flexible load cooperative control model and cluster the dispersed flexible loads. This includes the design of the upper agent control model, which uses the non-cooperative game strategy, and the lower load group control model considering the load rebound. Through the above research, we aim to achieve efficient utilization of flexible loads in integrated energy systems, reduce system construction costs, and improve the reliability of the entire system. This will provide important theoretical and practical support for the optimal operation and management of integrated energy systems.

articleTitle: A Market-based Generation Expansion Planning Model with Carbon Emission Reduction Target
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of energy low-carbon transition, China is faced with a rather severe dilemma of renewable energies (RES). It is the topic which attracts much attention to promote the sustainable development of RES with market-oriented tools in current research. Compared with the subsidized mechanisms such as renewable exchanging certificate (REC), renewable portfolio standard (RPS) and so on, this paper focuses on adopting the access of renewable energies through competitive markets, and proposes a market-based generation expansion planning model with based on renewable capacity equivalent, generation resources competition equally, and centralized market clearing. Besides, the proposed methodology takes the energy structure and carbon emission constraints into account, which can realize the development of renewable energies with optimal economic efficiency, reflect the capacity value of various energies, take the effective distribution of interests into consideration, as well as stimulate the participation of market participants. The practicality of the proposed mechanism is illustrated by the modified IEEE-39 system, which can provide a reference for policy-makers to satisfy the requirements of macro-control, energy transition and market price signal in process of the system reform.

articleTitle: Dual-channel Dynamical Event-Triggered Load Frequency Control under Attack for Wind Power Systems with Multiple Time-varying Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to stabilize a multi-time-delay interconnected wind power system, a dual-channel dynamic event-triggered load frequency control scheme is proposed, considering network attacks in this paper. Firstly, this paper designs load frequency control of wind power system incorporating the effect of time-varying delay both in the states and control input. Secondly, in order to reduce the occupancy of communication bandwidth, a novel transmission scheme with two asynchronous event triggers network channels has been designed. Further, a malicious bounded time-delay deception attack model is proposed to enhance the security. By constructing a discrete-type Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional, stability criteria with H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> performance index are established. Finally, numerical examples are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: The Optimization Clearing Model and Algorithm Research of Electric Heat Storage Participates in Electricity Spot Market to Improve Renewable Energy Absorption Capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the construction of new power system and electricity market, the adjustable resources and market entities in the power system are constantly enriched, which puts forward higher requirements for system flexibility and market mechanism. Energy storage is an important means to improve the system regulation capacity, and low-cost, low-constraint electric heat storage technology is the best way to solve the problem of surplus renewable energy consumption and winter heating pollution. Therefore, this paper analyzes the operation characteristics of electric heat storage, proposes a method and mechanism to participate in the electricity spot market, and establishes an optimized clearing model including renewable energy consumption, electric heat storage load, cross-sectional constraint and node electricity price, on this basis, optimizes the operation mode of electric heat storage, improves the renewable energy absorption capacity, and reduces the overall operating cost and energy efficiency of the system. An example verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Dueling double deep Q Cooperative Control Algorithm for Distributed Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The access of large-scale renewable energy and flexible load under the double carbon target has led to an increasing proportion of new energy in the power system. Due to the unpredictable and sporadic nature of modern energy sources, large-scale grid connection will lead to frequency fluctuations in the power grid. Thus, it poses significant difficulties for the power system's efficient, reliable, and safe operation. In this paper, in order to increase the control effectiveness of cooperative systems, a new double-depth Q-network learning algorithm for distributed power grids is proposed. The algorithm splits using Q-values into the worth of states and the advantage of actions, which enables the intelligences to learn and update these two parts independently, which not only improves the efficiency and stability of Q learning, but also decreases the quantity of actions that should be evaluated, thus enhancing the effectiveness and performance within the algorithm. The results of modeling the IEE standard two-region load frequency control model reveal that the suggested algorithm performs better dynamically than the conventional approach and converges quickly.

articleTitle: The Optimal Location Algorithm of SAPFs in Distribution Network Based on Harmonic State Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of high-proportion renewable energy systems, the number of distributed nonlinear loads has been increasing, which causes a growing harmonic problem in the distribution network. In this situation, the traditional point-to-point harmonic compensation method is inefficient, since it needs to configure plenty of control equipment. This article presents a multi-objective optimal location algorithm of multiple shunt active power filters (SAPFs), considering that some harmonic sources are unknown in the distribution network. Firstly, based on the measurement equations, the least-square method is used to estimate the unmeasured power quality data, so as to improve the accuracy of the multi-bus harmonic mitigation model. Secondly, a multi-objective genetic algorithm is proposed for determining the Pareto-optimal set of the equipment layout to suppress multi-bus harmonic distortion. Finally, a standard IEEE-18 buses simulation model with 6 nonlinear loads is built to verify the proposed optimal location strategy. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can ensure that harmonic distortion indexes of each bus meet the recommended standards with few devices and total capacity.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Output Voltage Stabilization of DAB Converter Based on LADRC with Reduced-Order Model
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: One of the essential requirements for high-performance dual active bridge (DAB) converters is to obtain the constant output voltage rapidly and accurately under different disturbances. To improve the disturbance rejection ability of DAB converters, this paper adopts an output voltage control method based on linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC). Firstly, based on the reduced-order modeling method, the small signal transfer function of the DAB converter is derived and compared with the transfer function obtained by the swept-frequency method in the frequency domain. Then, the linear extended state observer (LESO) and the linear state error feedback (LSEF) control law are designed to estimate and compensate for the value of state variables and total disturbance. Finally, the simulation results in PLECS demonstrate that the LADRC method can maintain the output voltage stability more effectively than the PI controller.

articleTitle: A New Control Strategy for VSG on Improving Voltage Support Ability for Power Network with High Penetrated Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the gradual depletion of fossil energy and other non-renewable energy sources, research on renewable energy sources such as photovoltaic, wind power and biomass energy is deepening. This paper proposes a voltage control method for regional power grids based on virtual synchronous generator (VSG), and a simulation analysis is carried out on the proposed strategy to verify the effectiveness of VSGs in supporting regional power grid voltage. The results indicate that the proposed VSG-based voltage regulation method can not only better suppress the fluctuation of renewable energy output and reduce the impact on regional grid voltage, but also compensate the shortcomings of the grid-connected inverter with non-damping and low inertia.

articleTitle: Energy Flow Analysis and Optimization of Tahe No.1 Union Station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The Tahe No. 1 Union station has undergone many transformations, and the existing energy flow direction is unreasonable. In order to improve the efficiency of energy utilization within the Union Station, the energy flow diagram of Tahe No. 1 Union Station was firstly analyzed, and it was found that there were weak links in heat loss and heat energy consumption at the separator equipment. Afterwards, the existing heat exchange network was analyzed using the problem table method in the pinch technology, and it was found that there were two hot streams that violated the principle of pinch technology, and energy-saving transformation was carried out on them, the energy-saving potential could reach 54.7%.
