After analysis, it was found that if there is a heat exchange process in the system, it can be pinch technology to find out what is not right in the system and to modify it. The pinch point analysis technique is therefore a highly applicable energy saving technique.

articleTitle: Stochastic Economic Dispatch of High Renewable Penetration Power System with Solar Thermal Power
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Solar thermal power can employ its thermal storage system to regulate its power generation capacity, so it can play an important role in high percentage of renewable power generation. Mathematical model is firstly established in this paper for modeling solar power plant. Then, a three-stage stochastic dispatching model with solar thermal power plants is constructed. The first stage is based on day-ahead forecasts to optimize start-up and shutdown state of all units. The second stage then optimizes the power generation of all units in real-time. The third stage is based on the prediction for the next few days to optimize the thermal storage level to achieve the multi-day coordinated operation. The IEEE-118 system was modified for carrying out case studies. Our results verify the validity of the three-stage dispatch model, which has the superiority over some two-stage dispatch methods in terms of the total generation cost and renewable energy abandonment.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of Considering Dynamic Thermal Rating on Distributed PV Acceptance Capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, the large number of distributed PV connections has brought many challenges to the distribution network, such as voltage overruns, line/transformer overloads and harmonic pollution. This paper proposes a method to improve the distributed PV acceptance capacity of the distribution network taking into account the dynamic thermal rating(DTR) constraint, fully considering the influence of meteorological factors on the line thermal rating, with a view to improving the distributed PV acceptance capacity of the distribution network without changing the existing infrastructure configuration of the distribution network. This paper firstly establishes a distributed PV capacity assessment model based on the IEEE standard thermal balance equation for overhead lines, taking into account the DTR constraints. Then, considering the non-convexity of the model, a second-order cone relaxation(SOCR) technique is used to convert it into an easily solvable convex optimisation problem in order to obtain the global optimal solution of the model efficiently and accurately. Finally, based on the actual weather and load data, the results show that the proposed method can improve the distributed PV acceptance capacity of the distribution network by 11.79%, while effectively preventing line overload under extreme conditions, which has good application and engineering value.

articleTitle: Modeling Analysis and Measurement of Power Frequency Overvoltage Distribution of Long-Distance Transmission Cable
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of urban power transmission and distribution scale, long-distance transmission cable lines are widely used. Compared with short distance cable lines, long distance cable lines have more overvoltage problems; At the same time, the existing over-voltage standards and protection measures for long-distance overhead lines are not applicable to long-distance cable lines, so it is of great significance to analyze the power frequency overvoltage distribution law of long-distance cable lines and conduct real-time monitoring. Firstly, a typical 220kV cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cable simulation model is established based on PSCAD simulation software. Then, the power frequency overvoltage distribution characteristics of long-distance cable lines are studied and analyzed. Finally, on-site tests are carried out using a non-contact measurement device. The results show that the power frequency overvoltage caused by single-phase ground fault is high; The power frequency overvoltage can be reduced by reducing the cable section or laying the cable in trefoil shape; There is a positive correlation between the cable length and the sheath induced voltage. The on-site test further proves that the simulation model is accurate and the non-contact overvoltage measurement device is feasible.

articleTitle: Decoupling Control Strategy for Input-series-output-parallel Dual Active Bridge Converter Based on Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Distributed control strategy is essential to the input-series-output-parallel (ISOP) dual active bridge (DAB) converter. However, the coupling disturbances are not considered in previous distributed-control strategies. They are potential risks of the converter This paper proposes a decoupling strategy based on active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) for the ISOP DAB converters. The linear extended state observers are used in the voltage control loops to reject the coupling disturbances. The closed-loop analysis shows that the impacts of the observed disturbances are eliminated and the control loops are decoupled. Meanwhile, the center controller is indispensable and ISOP-system stability and flexibility are improved. Finally, experimental results based on a dual-module ISOP DAB converter are presented to verify that the proposed strategy has significant inhibition of voltage oscillation.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration of coupling equipment for electric-gas integrated energy system considering the influence of voltage sag
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As the most serious and frequent power quality problem, voltage sag significantly impacts the electricity-gas integrated energy system (EG-IES) through sensitive coupling equipment. In order to reduce the economic loss of the EG-IES system caused by voltage sags, this paper proposes an optimal configuration method for the EG-IES coupling equipment. The paper first analyzes voltage sag impacts in the normal operation of EG-IES through coupling equipment. Then, tolerance characteristic curves of the compressor and gas turbine are presented, and an economic loss model caused by voltage sag is established. Finally, an optimal configuration model is established considering the cost of coupled equipment and voltage sag loss. The method is applied to the EG-IES composed of IEEE14 nodes and gas network 11 nodes, proving that the method can effectively reduce the loss of EG-IES caused by voltage sags while considering the equipment installation cost.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Power Generation Guality of Marine Main Engine Electric Dynamometer System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to solve a series of power quality problems such as harmonics, three-phase voltage and current imbalance when the marine main engine electric dynamometer system is integrated into the grid as a distributed energy source. A design method of LCL filter grid-connected inverter with dual three-phase space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) power balance joint control combining the marine main engine electric dynamometer speed loop and capacitor current feedforward control is proposed, and the proper parameters are designed to realize the ideal functions of the system. Through the simulation test of the energy feedback system of the whole marine main engine, the optimization effect of the total harmonic distortion rate of the grid-connected current based on this design method can be detected. Compared with other control modes, it is reduced from 2.18% and 1.6% to 1.03%, which effectively optimizes the quality of the feedback power generated by the marine main engine electric dynamometer system.

articleTitle: A Study on the Carbon Trading Systems And Demand Side Carbon Emissions Obligation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Building and improving the carbon emissions trading market is an important way to achieve the "double carbon" goal. Although the power industry, as a high-energy-consuming industry, is closely related to the construction of the carbon market, it is difficult to effectively connect the two markets due to differences. This article first introduces the construction of carbon trading markets in China and the EU, and conducts a comparative analysis of the two situations. Then, the calculation method of user-side carbon emission responsibility is studied. This article summarizes the characteristics of different calculation methods of carbon emission obligations on the demand side, and provides a basis for the subsequent construction of electricity and carbon markets.

articleTitle: The Impact of the COVID-19 Pandemic on Economy and Electricity Consumption in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This work describes the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on economy and electricity consumption in Thailand during 2020-2021. The economic indicators are gross domestic product, producer price index, and consumer price index. The electricity indicators are energy consumption, peak demand, load factor, and on-peak energy ratio. In addition, carbon dioxide emissions from electricity sector are also observed. The datasets are collected on a monthly/quarterly basis in accordance with the four waves of outbreaks in Thailand. The impact is assessed by comparing with historical data in 2017-2019. It is found that the first and second waves have significantly negative impact, while the impact of the third and fourth waves is less noticeable. In all four waves, there is a substantial variation in hourly profile of electricity consumption, which can be seen from load factor and on-peak energy ratio.

articleTitle: Optimal decision method of load aggregator in virtual power plant mode
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The potential of demand-side resource adjustment is huge. In order to achieve the dual-carbon goal, it is necessary to fully dispatch demand-side resources. This paper mainly summarizes the related technologies of load aggregator in virtual power plant mode. Firstly, the evaluation method of load aggregator's adjustable potential for users is introduced, including different evaluation indexes. Secondly, the typical flexible load models are summarized and compared, and the load aggregation is divided into two categories: probabilistic simulation and model-based calculation. Finally, the bidding and incentive strategies of aggregator market and their related decision models are introduced.

articleTitle: Inter-turn Short Circuit Fault Detection of a Novel PMSM with Fault Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Previously, a new type of PMSM with automatic fault tolerance for inter-turn short circuit faults was designed by this research group. When the motor fails, the short circuit current can be effectively suppressed and the output torque can be kept stable. A method for detecting interturn short circuit fault by injecting low frequency signal into existing coil is presented in this paper. Compared with the detection method proposed before, this method makes the structure of the motor simpler, does not need to set additional coils, and can find the fault location and judge the number of short turns more quickly.In this paper, the special structure and fault tolerance principle of motor are introduced, the theory of short circuit current in fault is derived, a low-frequency signal is injected into the existing stator winding and the relevant theoretical derivation about low-frequency short-circuit current is also deduced. Finally, finite element simulation of different short circuit turns is carried out by ANSYS.

articleTitle: A Transient Voltage Support Strategy Based on Medium Voltage Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Converter During Commutation Failure in the LCC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The transient overvoltage caused by commutation failure in the LCC-HVDC system is a key factor limiting the DC transmission capacity. During the commutation failure period, the voltage of the sending AC grid exhibits a characteristic of "first decrease then rise", and the time to transition from low voltage to high voltage is relatively short. The existing photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected converters have the characteristics of long equivalent electrical distance from the grid, small capacity, and weak reactive power support ability, making it difficult to effectively support transient voltage. This article proposes a method of using medium voltage PV grid-connected converters to support the transient voltage caused by commutation failure in the LCC-HVDC system, which actively responds to voltage changes through a grid-forming control strategy and can instantly adjust the reactive power output of the converter. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively support the transient voltage and reduce the amplitude of transient overvoltage.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Prediction of Maximum Carrying Capacity of Key Transmission Sections for Photovoltaic Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern industry and the increasingly serious environmental problems, people's demand for new energy is also increasing. However, the instability and intermittency of new energy due to its own characteristics and its high dependence on the power generation environment make it highly complex under different climatic conditions. The sufficient carrying capacity of the transmission line is the key to ensuring the stability of the power grid. Therefore, it is particularly important to predict the carrying capacity of the identified key transmission sections in the power grid. The maximum transmission power of the transmission section is one of the important indicators to measure the transmission capacity of the section. Because the neural network has a good fitting ability, it is a very effective method to predict the power of the power system by using the neural network. This paper will use the GA-BPNN neural network to predict the output power of photovoltaic power plants based on the maximum bearing capacity of key transmission sections. The results show that it can make relatively accurate power prediction for photovoltaic power generation, so as to fully predict the maximum carrying capacity of key transmission sections.

articleTitle: Intelligent Structural Calculation and Control Design of The Intelligent Crossing Frame
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the expansion and upgrading of modern industrial scale, the electricity consumption is also constantly increasing. This requires continuous expansion of the construction scale of power infrastructure. Among them, the construction of power lines is crucial, and during the process of power construction, there will inevitably be obstacles that need to be crossed, such as road bridges or live wires. When bypassing these obstacles to construct the power lines, the crossing frame plays an important role. This article presents an intelligent crossing frame structure designed to deal with special environmental conditions in power line construction. The intelligent crossing frame consists of three parts: the mechanical system is responsible for performing necessary crossing actions, the power system provides power for the mechanical system, and the measurement and control system ensures the safe monitoring and intelligent control of the crossing frame.

articleTitle: Improved Detection of Defects in Dialyzers Using Enhanced FCOS Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Dialyzers are essential medical devices that serve as a substitute for renal function by filtering toxins and waste products from the bloodstream, thereby significantly impacting the health and well-being of patients with kidney disease. During the production process of dialyzers, four common defects may occur: clogging, impurities, double-layered membranes, and bubbles. Currently, there is a lack of efficient methods to detect these defects in the production process of dialyzers. The current approach relies on manual observation of the end face of the blood dialyzer using magnifying lenses to identify any defects. However, the detection of small targets, such as clogging and impurities, through manual inspection is inefficient. In this paper, we propose a new technique to enhance the capability of the FCOS network by incorporating an attention mechanism to enhance the extracted features. Additionally, we employ a cut-diagram training strategy to train the improved network. Our improved method outperforms other state-of-the-art models on our dataset of dialyzer defects, achieving 42.5% in average precision. This represents a 2.3% improvement compared to the FCOS network in AP, validating the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on Magnetic Field Interference Characteristics of Difference Magneto-optical Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Magneto-optical current transformer has the defect of poor anti-interference ability. In this paper, the interference characteristics of differential magneto-optical current transformer are studied based on the background of interphase magnetic field interference in three-phase power system. By establishing the magnetic field interference model, the anti-magnetic field interference characteristics of the differential magneto-optical current transformer are studied. The research shows that there is a zero magnetic field interference point in the difference magneto-optical current transformer and the zero-interference angle presents a specific distribution law. When the transmission light path of the difference magneto-optical current transformer degenerates to a square arrangement, the value of magnetic field interference has nothing to do with the distance of interference current. Moreover, the square structure makes it have zero-interference angle at a specific angle. The analysis shows that when the interference current deviates from zero-interference angle, the differential magneto-optical current transformer has fault tolerance within a certain range of distance and angle. And it can still meet the requirements of measurement accuracy under the influence of interference current. The simulation results are consistent with the theoretical analysis, which proves the correctness of the theoretical analysis. This research can provide a useful idea for the design of anti-phase magnetic field interference for the application of differential magneto-optical current transformer in power system.

articleTitle: Distributed Fixed-Time Secondary Control for DC Microgrid with Less Information Exchange
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: DC microgrids are a feasible grid system to host multiple distributed generators (DGs). In terms of the control and coordination of hosted DGs, it is required that the integrated secondary control scheme of DC microgrids can achieve fast dynamics. To fulfill this target, a novel fixed-time secondary control scheme is put forward in this paper to achieve a concurrent DC bus voltage regulation and current sharing among DGs within a fixed time. Notably, the proposed method only needs to transmit one variable to the neighboring DGs, which can considerably reduce the communication traffic compared to the existing latest method. Moreover, this control scheme need not sample the DC bus voltage, benefiting an easier implementation and improved system reliability. The stability of the proposed scheme is theoretically proved. The results of studied cases are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Control Strategy for Frequency Support Based on Modular Multilevel Matrix Converter with Emulation Inertia
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Stabilized active power from an offshore wind farm is transmitted to the grid through a modular multilevel matrix converter (M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C), in which the M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C neutron module capacitor operates in a constant voltage state. In this paper, a control strategy based on the M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C to provide frequency support is proposed, which simulates the inertia by releasing the energy in the sub-module capacitance in the M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C. A frequency-voltage model is established through the linear coupling relationship between frequency and sub-module capacitor voltage. When the system frequency fluctuates, the sub-module capacitors in the M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C can absorb or release the energy to simulate the inertia to provide frequency support for the system. Finally, the offshore wind power delivery model based on M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>C with simulation inertia is built in MATLAB/Simulink, and its results are analyzed and evaluated under load variation.

articleTitle: Preferred scoring method for medium and low voltage distribution network infrastructure projects based on improved hierarchical analysis method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The investment and construction of medium and low-voltage distribution network infrastructure projects is an important part of regional power grid investment and construction. Using scientific and reasonable optimization methods, it is proposed that the investment order of medium and low-voltage distribution network infrastructure projects has important project accurate investment value. In view of the characteristics of medium and low-voltage distribution network infrastructure projects, this paper proposes a preferred scoring method. First of all, the four aspects of project economic benefits, construction urgency, implementation effect and power supply reliability are considered, and the project optimization comprehensive scoring index system is established; Secondly, the Delphi method is used to judge the concentration and dispersion of expert research opinions, the consistency research results of experts are obtained, and the hierarchical analysis method is used to calculate the comprehensive weight; Finally, the comprehensive preferred scoring results of the project are obtained by weighting the index system. The results of an example show that the optimization scoring method takes into account both the urgency of project construction and investment benefits, and verifies the scientificity, rationality, and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A novel hybrid data-driven PV output prediction method based on error correction
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the background of dual carbon, China's installed photovoltaic (PV) capacity has been consistently increasing, and prediction of PV output is of great significance to the safe operation of the power grid. In this paper, seven algorithms are selected to build data-driven sub-models and merged through multivariate linear regression to obtain a hybrid data-driven model. Then, a novel hybrid data-driven PV output prediction model is developed based on weather conditions and adjacent PV outputs. Finally, an error correction model based on mechanism modeling and similar day statistical modeling is built, and a new hybrid data-driven PV output prediction method based on error correction is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Expansion Planning Considering Prosumer Participation in Ancillary Service Market
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the context of the novel power system, a large number of distributed new energy sources are continuously being connected. Therefore, it is necessary to seek a distribution network expansion planning method that coordinates the integration of distributed new energy sources and economic costs. Firstly, considering the distinct characteristics of diverse elastic resources available to prosumers, a transaction model is proposed, enabling prosumers to actively engage in the peak-shaving ancillary services market. This model takes into consideration their profit-oriented behavior and seeks to optimize their participation. Secondly, a dual-layer model for distribution network expansion planning is formulated, aiming to minimize investment costs while using the net load formed by ancillary service market as the boundary. Finally, an improved IEEE 33-bus distribution system was tested to prove the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel DC Control Optimization Strategy for Supporting Transient Voltage of HVDC Sending End System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the transient voltage problem caused by the fault occurred in the sending end AC system. This paper analyzes the interaction of reactive power between AC and DC systems, and the dominant factors affecting transient voltage was identified. Considering the fault severity, the expression of transient voltage of converter bus is established in this paper. Based on this, the expression of DC current command value is derived, and the DC control optimization strategy is proposed to support the transient voltage. Finally, a test model is built based on the CIGRE HVDC benchmark model in the PSCAD/EMTDC, and the validity of the proposed strategy is verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Addressing Power Supply by Complementary Hydro-Wind-Solar-Gas-Storage Multi-Energy System: The Wenshan Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: As one of Yunnan’s ethnic minority autonomous prefectures, Wenshan is in the southeast of Yunnan Province and has introduced massive electrolytic aluminum factories, resulting in continuously growing energy demand in the past five years. Moreover, it is foreseeable that the electricity growth in Wenshan will be at a high level during the 14th Five-Year-Plan period. However, the power supply of Wenshan highly depends on the main grid due to the lack of large stable resources. To support energy demand that bolsters social and economic development, and improve the electric self-sufficiency level of Wenshan, this paper analyzes the local energy demand and resources potential based on supply-demand balance, then proposes to further develop resources to build complementary hydro-wind-solar-gas-storage multi-energy system based on new energy potential in Wenshan, to improve the self-sufficiency level and reduce the main grid dependence. In addition to the proposed complementary wind-solar-hydro system in Malipo, Maguan and Funing counties, the wind-solar-storage system in Xichou, Yanshan and Guangnan counties, and the wind-solar-gas system in Wenshan City and Qiubei County, this paper also suggests to further strengthen the support of the main grid and therefore improve the power supply guarantee level according to the planning of high-voltage transmission projects.

articleTitle: Research and Development of BPA-DIgSILENT Power Grid Model Conversion Software
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: DIgSILENT/PowerFactory has a rich component library, flexible modeling capabilities, and powerful power system analysis functions widely used worldwide. BPA software is commonly used in dispatch and planning departments, but problems exist, such as poor modeling flexibility. To automatically import the power grid model of BPA into DIgSILENT/PowerFactory, this paper analyzes the static component and dynamic controller models in BPA and DIgSLENT, provides the corresponding relationship between the data conversion of two simulation software, and uses DSL language to build the mainstream controller model of BPA in DIgSILENT. We studied the DGS file provided by DIgSILENT and the Python language API interface. We designed a conversion software for automatically importing BPA power grid models into DSILENT using Python language. Finally, taking the Maozhanyang area power grid of the Southern Power Grid as an example, the component parameters, power flow calculation results, and transient analysis results of two simulation software were compared to verify that the conversion software met the design requirements.

articleTitle: A New Coordinate Transformation Matrix Based on the Traditional Symmetric Component Method under the Condition of Motor Turn-to-turn Short Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A new model of axial permanent magnet synchronous fault-tolerant motor with in phase coil compensation can automatically realize fault-tolerant operation without special control strategies under the condition of single-phase turn to turn short circuit. Externally, its end voltage, three-phase current and torque have not changed significantly, and its value can be ignored, but its inductance matrix has changed. Based on the above situation, it is necessary to find a new coordinate transformation, in order to ensure that the new motor can still work under single-phase inter turn short circuit conditions and increase speed according to the corresponding requirements, so that the inductance of the motor can be decoupled under the new coordinates. From the perspective of simplifying the motor equation, a new coordinate transformation based on the traditional symmetrical component method is proposed. The mathematical model of the motor is established in the new coordinate system, and the rationality of the coordinate transformation is proved from theoretical and simulation results.

Author Keywords: A new model of axial permanent magnet synchronous fault-tolerant motor with the same coil compensation
single phase inter turn short circuit

articleTitle: Research on optimal control strategy of compound heating system based on model prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The solar-air source heat pump hybrid heating system operates in a complex and dynamic environment, with strong interconnections among internal modules. It exhibits nonlinearity, strong coupling, and significant time delays. Current methods, such as temperature difference control, are unable to achieve overall system energy efficiency improvement. Therefore, this paper proposes a Model Predictive Control (MPC) strategy for the hybrid heating system, specifically for temperature control. The mathematical model of the system is established and validated. The objective function of the system is optimized, and a predictive model is constructed and discretized. Parameters such as the simulation sampling period, prediction horizon, and control horizon of the MPC are determined. Simulation and comparative experiments demonstrate that, after achieving stability, the indoor temperature controlled by the MPC method exhibits an average absolute error reduction of approximately 3 °C compared to fuzzy control, and the energy consumption of the system is reduced by up to 15.29%.

articleTitle: Online Harmonic Phasor Measurement of Sub/supsynchronous Oscillation for Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The existing phasor measurement units and the wide-area measurement systems are both used to accurately measure power frequency phasors, but they do not specifically consider sub/super-synchronous harmonics, which have obvious side-effects on measurement accuracy. In this paper, an online harmonic phasor measurement method is proposed, and a matched wide-area measurement system is subsequently designed, which are helpful for dispatchers to timely discover the sub/sup-synchronous oscillation events of the target power grid. Simulation data and experimental data from real power grid are adopted to verify the superior performance of the proposed measurement method and system.

articleTitle: Study on prediction of energy storage penetration rate for electric futures based on ARMA-GARCH model
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The futures market has the market function of price discovery and risk avoidance, and can also greatly activate the electricity trading. The implement of electricity futures market based on renewable energy will help to increase the penetration rate of renewable energy. However, the instability of renewable energy will increase the delivery risk of renewable energy power futures. The addition of energy storage units will help renewable energy producers overcome futures delivery problems caused by instability. Nevertheless, the increase in energy storage will also cause the cost of selling electricity to increase. Therefore, this paper proposes an electric futures price prediction model based on ARMA-GARCH model, according to which the energy storage capacity can be adjusted to ensure the maximum benefit of producers. Through the empirical test, the prediction of futures price in this paper has a high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Current Status and Development Direction of Partial Discharge Monitoring and Diagnosis Technology for Large Pumped Storage Units
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The intelligent on-line monitoring of partial discharge of large pumped storage unit is an important means to ensure the safe and stable operation of the unit. In foreign countries, the sample base of local discharge of large generators and the core technology of local discharge monitoring are strictly blocked, and the monitoring level of domestic large generators is much lower than that of foreign countries. At present, the intelligent online monitoring system of the bureau discharge of large pumping and storage units is widely used in industrial sites, which can realize the integration of local monitoring and central management system, detect potential faults, reduce the occurrence of sudden power outage accidents, and improve the reliability of power supply.

articleTitle: Bi-level configuration optimization model for multi-energy capacities in virtual power plant cluster
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, the types of power loads become more and more complicated, and their requirements for power quality are further improved. The type and quantity of distributed resources involved in a single VPP are limited, and independent operation is difficult to adapt to changes in load demand. Therefore, an optimal configuration of virtual power plant cluster based on resource characteristics is proposed. Firstly, a VPPC model including diesel engine groups, wind power, photovoltaic, energy storage and interruptible load is established. Then, a bi-level model of cluster configuration optimization is established. The upper model aims at the minimum comprehensive cost of the cluster, and the lower model aims at the minimum difference between the purchase and sale of electricity. Moreover use scenario generation to solve the uncertainty of wind power and photovoltaic. Finally, the simulation results show that this optimal configuration can balance the economy and flexibility of the virtual power plant cluster and improve the power quality.

articleTitle: Battery Capacity Degradation Trajectory Estimation for Real-World Electric Vehicles Based on Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate estimation of the capacity degradation trajectory of the battery is essential to ensuring the effective and safe operation of electric vehicles (EVs). This paper proposes a practical method for estimating the capacity degradation trajectory of EV batteries. Firstly, the actual operational data of EV is thoroughly analyzed to explore the charging modes. Then, a charging segment filtering method is presented to enhance the accuracy of the battery capacity estimation. Based on this method, the capacity degradation trajectory of the battery is estimated. Next, complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) is employed to eliminate the noise of the capacity degradation trajectory, thereby better reflecting the aging situation of the battery. Furthermore, three battery capacity degradation trajectories under different aging conditions are obtained from the battery aging experiments. Different smoothing algorithms are compared, and the superiority of the CEEMDAN algorithm is verified. The results show that using the CEEMDAN algorithm, the root-mean-square-error and mean-absolute-error between the obtained and true capacity degradation trajectories are as low as 6% and 5%, respectively. In conclusion, the method proposed in this work effectively extracts capacity degradation trajectories from on-road data, providing a foundation for battery aging stress exploration and capacity degradation trajectory prediction.

articleTitle: Spacecraft Power Charging Regulator Based on Two-domain Control
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Switching Shunt Regulator (S3R) architecture solar cell utilization is high, the advantages are obvious, in most of the high orbit satellite applications at home and abroad, but the control process needs to experience two control dead zones, making the bus voltage fluctuation becomes larger, the response speed is reduced. For this reason, this paper proposes a two-current loop control strategy for the battery charging regulator, that is, only the charging current is controlled when the battery is not full, the power is balanced by adjusting the charging current, and the bus voltage is stabilized by the battery discharge regulator, so as to improve the response speed of the bus in the cross-domain and reduce the fluctuation of the bus voltage. In this paper, the Superbuck topology is selected as the main circuit of the battery charging regulator, and its working principle is analyzed in detail. The steady-state and dynamic characteristics of the converter are analyzed by using the state-space average method. The feasibility of the converter is verified by a 200 W/100 kHz prototype.

articleTitle: Differentiated Distribution Network Reconstruction Strategy Considering Dual-Carbon Target Under the Background of New Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to find a distribution network reconstruction strategy considering the dual-carbon target under the background of new power system, firstly, the sensitivity analysis is carried out from two aspects of equipment failure parameters and distribution network characteristic parameters to propose an analysis method of multi-dimensional influencing factors of reliability. Then, the investment cost of typical project scenarios is calculated and the investment optimization model considering carbon cost is constructed to propose the distribution network investment optimization strategy based on differentiated reliability analysis under the dual-carbon target. Finally, Guangdong distribution network in 2021 is selected for analysis to calculate the sensitivity of distribution network characteristic parameters and propose the investment plan for 2022-2025. The results show that this method comprehensively analyzes the multi-dimensional influencing factors of reliability and takes carbon cost into account in the investment optimization model. It is a new method for dual-carbon target differentiated distribution network reconstruction.

articleTitle: Classification of Transient Power Quality Disturbances Based on Digital Image Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the advancement of technology and the transformation of energy systems, electrical energy has become an essential part of various industries. In modern active distribution networks, there have been new trends in the structure of distribution networks and loads. The sensitivity of devices has increased, and issues related to voltage oscillations and voltage sag have become increasingly important in terms of power quality. Therefore, improving power grid quality requires rapid and efficient classification and detection of various disturbances. To achieve accurate classification and identification of disturbance signals, digital image processing methods such as gamma correction, edge detection, and local extremum analysis can be used. By extracting the morphological characteristics of disturbance signals, effective classification and recognition of disturbance types can be achieved. Subsequently, normalization processing is applied to the power quality disturbance data, generating new grayscale images. Analysis of experimental data indicates that the improved method for transient power quality disturbance classification has higher accuracy, making it a feasible and efficient approach.

articleTitle: A novel distribution system weak node identification method based on finite synchronous phase measurement information
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that weak nodes of the new distribution system are difficult to be accurately identified, an identification method of weak nodes based on the finite synchronous phase measurement unit is proposed. Firstly, the specific framework of the new power distribution system and the current research status of weak nodes are introduced, and then, considering the economic performance of the PMU device, it can only be configured in some nodes, and for this reason, the distribution network is stratified, which provides a basis for the rapid identification of weak nodes afterwards; and then, through the establishment of the judgement bases of the radius of curvature and the rate, system nodes are classified through the improved clustering method, and the weak nodes are found. Finally, the reliability of the method is verified by using the IEEE 33-node power distribution system as an object, and the common identification method is compared, and the results show that the identification results of the method are faster and more reliable than the existing methods.

articleTitle: Ship energy consumption analysis and transformation power distribution system solution based on real ship monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A ship energy efficiency data collection system has been developed based on the operating characteristics of the Bohai Bay Marine Engineering Boat. This research aims to evaluate the mixed power generation system of the marine engineering ship "Ocean Petroleum XXX" comprehensively. By analyzing the energy efficiency data collected from real ships, the characteristic curves of the ship’s main engine and diesel engine, as well as the energy consumption in different ship states, are analyzed. A hybrid transformation scheme for the ship’s distribution system is designed, which provides valuable insights for the future mixed use of distribution diesel and electricity in newly built and operating ships.

articleTitle: Optimization model of a ring-grid distribution system based on a solid-state hydrogen storage station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Solid-state hydrogen storage station is an excellent new energy storage mode, which has been applied on the ground in the engineering field. However, it still needs to be optimized in terms of practical application scenarios and payback cycle. Therefore, this paper proposes an optimization model of a ring-grid distribution system for a solid-state hydrogen storage station with photovoltaic power generation (RHP) . Distributed photovoltaic power generation is common on the rooftops of villages and factories, and the model integrates the characteristics of the solid-state hydrogen storage station with them, and uses the solid-state hydrogen storage station as the point of contact to loop the villages and factories in a low-voltage network, and establishes an optimization model with the lowest operating cost as the objective function. The results of the analysis based on typical data show that RHP improves the overall power supply reliability and operation economy of the distribution network, and has good business value and development prospects.

articleTitle: A novel design for biogas-based power generation incorporating a coal-fired power plant
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this study, a hybrid power system was developed that includes biogas power generation and coal-fired power generation. The integration principle behind this system is as follows: the biogas obtained from anaerobic digestion is utilized by a gas turbine, and subsequently, the thermal exhaust from the gas turbine enhances the steam cycle of the coal-fired power generation system. Consequently, the energy derived from the gas turbine is transferred to the steam cycle of the coal-fired power plants, thereby improving the power generation efficiency of the entire coupling system. By considering the 162t/d biogas generator unit and the 350MW coal-fired generator unit as examples, a comprehensive evaluation of the design was conducted, taking into account thermodynamics. The results indicate that the integration has led to a 2.50 percentage point increase in the power generation efficiency of the coal-fired units, along with a net power generation of 20.97MW for the gas turbine.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Measurement and Control System for Crossing Frame
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing demand for electricity, electricity transmission construction is expanding. The construction of the existing transmission line straddling frame requires a lot of manpower and material resources, and project in the construction will encounter the cross of transmission lines of different voltage levels, road, railway, river and other obstacles, the use of assembly and disassembly time is long. In this paper, a safe and efficient intelligent straddle frame is designed, which can realize no power failure and safe and efficient construction. The measurement and control unit of intelligent straddle frame is composed of sensor, controller and actuator. The sensor unit detects the parameters affecting the construction safety and construction period, such as the levelness of the base of the straddling frame, weather conditions and lifting height, and the controller controls the lifting and lifting action of the straddling frame. The actuator provides power for the lifting and crossing movements. Each module is networked in wireless mode, which is not restricted by the onsite environment.

articleTitle: Short-term output prediction of distributed photovoltaic based on dual attention mechanism recurrent neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The fluctuating output of distributed photovoltaic (PV) power generation systems due to weather conditions poses challenges to the safety and stability of the power grid. Therefore, accurate prediction of PV power output has become increasingly important for grid management. This paper proposes a method for distributed PV power prediction using feature selection and dual attention mechanism recurrent neural network (DA-RNN). The Pearson correlation coefficient method is employed to select the optimal meteorological factors, and a DA-RNN prediction model is established. In the encoder phase, a feature attention mechanism is introduced to calculate the attention weights of distributed PV power towards meteorological features. In the decoder phase, a time attention mechanism is incorporated to determine the temporal importance weight of the encoder's hidden state for the predicted target. This method effectively captures the complex nonlinear relationship between input features and output power, enabling high-precision prediction.

articleTitle: A Method for Generating Fault Current in VSC-HVDC Protection Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that VSC-HVDC protection cannot effectively test the fault transient response capability, a fault current generation method for VSC-HVVDC protection test is proposed. Firstly, the overall configuration scheme of VSC-HVDC protection and the coupling relationship with control are analyzed, and then the specific idea and implementation steps of the method are described. The development of fault current is divided into three stages, and the corresponding state function is derived. Combined with the sampling rate of VSC-HVDC protection, discretization processing is carried out, which makes it possible to test the fault transient response capability of VSC-HVDC protection. Finally, the progressiveness and practicability of this method are summarized, and the advantages and feasibility of this method are analyzed concretely.

articleTitle: Online Prediction Nadir Point in Primary Frequency Response of Power System Containing Converter-Based Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In low-inertia power systems, the primary frequency response is of great interest. Based on the frequency nadir, the frequency response can be quickly analyzed to see whether it will disrupt the stable operation of the grid, so this paper proposes an online prediction method for the frequency nadir. Firstly, a detailed frequency response model containing converter-based generation to provide frequency support is established, and the model structure is simplified according to the common features of the complex control loops. The simplified model can easily achieve the analytical expression of the frequency nadir so that the frequency nadir prediction can be performed by parameter calculation. In the derived frequency nadir expression, the system parameters that are strongly frequency-dependent, such as inertia, and the simplified frequency regulation parameters are retained. In order to enhance the fit between the frequency nadir prediction and the actual system, these parameters are obtained through online information, where the system parameters are based on online estimation, and the simplified frequency regulation parameters are obtained through parameter identification. Case tests demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and are easy to implement.

articleTitle: Study on profit model and operation strategy optimization of energy storage power station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the acceleration of China's energy structure transformation, energy storage, as a new form of operation, plays a key role in improving power quality, absorption, frequency modulation and power reliability of the grid [1]. However, China's electric power market is not perfect, how to maximize the income of energy storage power station is an important issue that needs to be solved in the investment and operation of the electric power market environment [2]. This paper studies the optimal operation strategy of energy storage power station participating in the power market, and analyzes the feasibility of energy storage participating in the power market from the aspects of China's power market construction policy [3]. Based on the rules of spot market and FM market in a province, the optimization model of energy storage power station participating in price arbitrage service and FM service market is established. At the same time, this paper compares and analyzes the income of energy storage power station under the mode of only declaring electricity without declaring electricity price and the mode of simultaneously declaring electricity and electricity price, so as to provide reference for the operation mode of energy storage power station to participate in the power market [4].

articleTitle: Research on Strategy of Wind-Storage Combined System Participating in Primary Frequency Modulation of Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the yearly increase in wind power penetration and the mature application of energy storage (ES) technology, the primary frequency modulation (PFM) of wind-storage auxiliary power system is the main frequency modulation (FM) mode of the new power system in the future. First of all, this paper proposes the control strategy of wind-storage combined FM and the corresponding mathematical model. Thus, a combined FM control strategy of adaptive inertia control and ES dynamic droop control of wind turbine (WT) is proposed. Secondly, according to the operating conditions of the WT, this paper divides the wind speed section of the WT, and formulates the comprehensive control strategy of wind storage FM in different regions of low wind speed, medium wind speed and high wind speed, so as to improve the frequency response ability of the system. Finally, a typical two-area four-machine system is used as an example for simulation. The results show that the PFM of the auxiliary power system combined with WT and ES system can complement each other. It not only effectively improves the FM ability of the system, but also ensures the safe and stable operation of the high proportion of new energy power system.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Treatment Device of Low Voltage Distribution Network Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous access of large-scale distributed photovoltaics (PV) to low-voltage distribution networks, the three-phase imbalance problem of low-voltage distribution networks is becoming increasingly severe, and problems such as voltage over-limit are prone to occur when the PV output is excessive. To solve the above, this paper proposes a comprehensive treatment device based on the coordinated operation of small-capacity energy storage converters and reactors. By controlling each phase's active and reactive power, the voltage over-limit can be controlled, and the three-phase voltage imbalance can be alleviated. By using the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, simulation analysis was carried out in an IEEE-20 node low-voltage distribution network, which verified the effectiveness of the proposed comprehensive treatment device in dealing with low-voltage distribution network voltage over-limit and three-phase imbalance.

articleTitle: Health State Estimation of Lithium Battery Based on Wavelet Packet Transform and Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate estimation of the state of health (SoH) of lithium batteries is extremely important for safe and stable battery operation. The quality of data feature extraction directly affects the accuracy of SoH estimation for lithium batteries. To this end, this study proposes an SoH estimation method for lithium batteries based on wavelet packet transform and Transformer model. Firstly, three features related to SoH decay were extracted from the battery operation data. The wavelet packet transformation technique was applied to noise reduction of the features to improve their correlation with SoH. Then, the features are used as input to estimate SoH by the Transformer model. Finally, the validity of the SoH estimation method proposed in this study is verified using the battery dataset from the NASA Ames Research Center. Experimental results show that the WPT-Transformer model proposed in this study suits battery SoH estimation. Its estimation accuracy is significantly better than that of the traditional LSTM model. In addition, its maximum root mean square error (RMSE) is only 0.0041; after data noise reduction, the Transformer model has 46.15% less RMSE than the initial model.

articleTitle: Frequency Dynamics-Constrained Unit Commitment with High Penetration of Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind power, the inertia level and primary frequency response (PFR) capability in the power system will continue to decline, which seriously threatens the frequency stability of power system. To enhance the frequency stability of power systems with high penetration of wind power, this paper proposes the frequency dynamics-constrained unit commitment (UC) with wind power participating in frequency regulation. Firstly, the frequency dynamics in power system including wind power frequency regulation is analyzed. Secondly, the frequency dynamics constraints about the rate of change of frequency, frequency deviation and quasi-steady-state frequency deviation are derived. Then, the UC model with linearized frequency dynamics constraints is constructed. Finally, case studies on the modified IEEE 39-bus system are carried out, and the effectiveness of wind power in participating in frequency regulation of UC is verified.

articleTitle: Prediction Method of Wind speed and Wind power Under the Influence of Multi-factor Coupling Under Extreme Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Wind power is greatly influenced by natural factors, and extreme weather will significantly affect wind power output. A new prediction method is proposed to address the issue of reduced prediction performance caused by the limited number of wind power samples under extreme weather conditions, which cannot fully consider the impact of meteorological factors on the dynamic coupling of wind power. Firstly, the TimeGAN algorithm is used to enrich meteorological and power samples, and on this basis, self attention is introduced to capture the auto-correlation of high-dimensional wind power sequences; The cross attention is used to reconstruct the wind power and meteorological factors, mine the temporal and spatial correlations of multidimensional feature sequences, and then extract the corresponding time series characteristics using the Long short-term memory network. The obtained time series characteristics are input into the full connection layer after being fused by the global attention denoising and gating mechanism for wind power prediction. Finally, simulation analysis was conducted, and compared to conventional prediction modes, the proposed method demonstrated good prediction performance in extreme weather conditions.

articleTitle: Fault Ride-through Strategy of Wind Power System Based on Flexible DC Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the DC over-voltage problem caused by the AC fault at the receiving end of the wind power via the flexible DC system, this paper first analyzes the topology and fault voltage characteristics of the wind power via the flexible DC system, which provides a theoretical basis for the design of fault ride-through methods. Then, for single pole fault, the reasonable switching of bipolar MMC control mode is adopted to cooperate with the accurate load shedding control strategy of the wind farm to reduce the impact of single stage fault on the receiving AC power grid. For bipolar fault, the active output of the wind farm is actively reduced according to the change rate and deviation of DC voltage to suppress the rise rate and amplitude of DC voltage, and in cooperation with the additional pitch angle control, so that the capacitance in the wind farm and each converter station can jointly maintain the stability of DC voltage and improve the system fault ride through capability. Finally, a simulation model is built to show that the proposed coordinated suppression voltage strategy can ensure that the DC voltage is within the safe operating range and maintain the safe and stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: Distributed Control Strategy of DC Microgrid Based on Convex Relaxation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: A new distributed control strategy for DC microgrid based on convex relaxation method is proposed, which can stabilize the system at the optimal power flow solution. Firstly, a non-convex optimal power flow problem is convexized using a suitable convex relaxation method, and the accuracy of the proposed convex relaxation method is proved. Then, the KKT optimality condition of the relaxation problem is equivalently transformed, a synchronization item is derived and applied into the control strategy to realize the distributed control under the optimal power flow. Finally, the proposed method is verified using simulations and numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Reduced Order Model of MMC Grid-Connected System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development and promotion of new energy power generation technology, power electronic equipment has become an important interface for new energy to access the distribution network, and the number of power electronic equipment in the distribution network has soared. However, this also leads to the higher and higher order of the mathematical model of the distribution network, which brings difficulties to the stability analysis of the system. To solve this problem, a nonlinear model reduction method of MMC grid-connected inverter based on singular perturbation theory is proposed in this paper, taking modular multilevel converter grid-connected inverter as an example. Firstly, the nonlinear model of MMC grid-connected inverter including voltage and current sampling delay, phase-locked loop, power outer loop and current inner loop is established by considering the coupling characteristics between the phase-locked loop and other control loops. Then the state variables of the system are divided into fast variables and slow variables according to the time scale through the participation factor analysis of the dominant modes, and then the fast variables are reduced based on the singular perturbation theory, so as to establish the reduced order model of the original system. This method can greatly reduce the computation and analysis complexity while ensuring the accuracy. Finally, the validity of the original model and the reduced order model is verified by MATLAB/Simulink time domain simulation.

articleTitle: Control Strategies and Prospects for Flexible Multi-State Switch in Intelligent Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Renewable energy generation is friendly to the environment and increases rapidly. However, its random output impacts the power quality and stability of the traditional distribution network significantly, including negative sequence current, voltage drop, and power disturbance. A flexible multi-state switch (FMS) can improve the flexibility and security of distribution network operation. It provides a new technical solution for a series of problems caused by the high proportion of renewable energy access to distributed generation. In this paper, the principle and topology of FMS are briefly described. Aiming for the power quality of the distribution network, the control strategies of FMS in unbalanced current regulation, voltage fluctuation suppression, as well as power flow dispatch among ports and feeders are reviewed. The critical control strategies are analyzed and compared. Furthermore, the prospective FMS applications in intelligent distribution networks with renewable energy are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on overall architecture and Functional Application of digital UHV substation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Against the backdrop of the digitalization, intelligence, and networking of substations, ultra-high voltage substations have numerous equipment and require huge operation and maintenance workload. With the continuous expansion of the scale of ultra-high voltage substations, it is difficult to ensure the safe and stable operation of substations, which makes analyzing the operational safety of ultra-high voltage substations critical. This paper proposes a concept of a digitalized ultra-high voltage substation, whose information flow in the secondary system has a key function in reflecting and regulating the energy flow of the primary system. Then, a business analysis model is constructed for UHV substations to achieve a refined characterization of network traffic, based on which a simulation platform for the network architecture of ultra-high voltage substations is developed using OPNET simulation software. The communication service modeling and simulation of the three-zone business structure of digitalized ultra-high voltage substations are conducted to analyze their communication service capabilities and verify the feasibility and reliability of the digitalized architecture.

articleTitle: Study on Automatic Oil Sample Collection Device for Power Transformer of Photovoltaic Power Station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the technical problem that it is difficult to automatically collect oil samples from power transformer in photovoltaic power station, this paper designs an automatic collection device. By designing the automatic driving mechanism and its control system, the 6-DOF mechanical arm mechanism, and its control system, and the transformer oil circuit acquisition mechanism and its control system, this paper realizes the automatic acquisition of transformer oil samples. The proposed automatic collection scheme of power transformer oil sample can realize the safe, efficient, and automatic collection of transformer oil, improve the automation level of substation maintenance, and reduce the operational difficulties and safety risks of manual transformer oil sample collection. This scheme provides technical support for the automatic collection of transformer oil samples.

articleTitle: Research on the operation strategy of energy storage power station under the environment of power market
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of the new situation of traditional energy and environmental protection, the power system is undergoing an unprecedented transformation[1]. A large number of intermittent new energy grid-connected will reduce the flexibility of the current power system production and operation, which may lead to a decline in the utilization of power generation infrastructure and grid assets. However, China's electric power market is not perfect, how to maximize the income of energy storage power station is an important issue that needs to be solved in the investment and operation of the electric power market environment. Therefore, under the new energy situation, studying the operation strategy of energy storage power station in the power market environment is the need of the current development of energy storage technology, and it is also the urgent need of energy and power technology in the new situation[2]. Based on the current market rules issued by a province, this paper studies the charge-discharge strategy of energy storage power station's joint participation in the power spot market and the frequency modulation auxiliary service market, and establishes an optimization model of energy storage power station's participation in the market with the aim of maximizing the operating income of energy storage power station[3]. The clearing price of a province's power spot market during trial operation is used as the basic data of the example to verify the operating income of the energy storage power station, which is helpful to improve the operating economy of the energy storage power station[4].

articleTitle: A Differential Protection Scheme for Distribution Networks with Multiple T-connected Inverter-Interfaced Distributed Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Inverter-interfaced distributed generators (IIDGs) connected to distribution networks may cause the failure of conventional three-stage current protection or current differential protection. In this paper a novel differential scheme for distribution networks with multiple T-connected IIDGs is proposed. After building and analyzing the positive-sequence equivalent circuit of distribution networks with multiple T-connected IIDGs and equating multiple IIDGs to single IIDG, the protection criterion of this scheme is constructed only according to electrical quantities at both ends of the protected line. A simulation in MATLAB of a distribution network with multiple T-connected IIDGs is built to validate this proposed protection scheme. The feasibility and reliability of the proposed protection scheme are proved by the results of case studies.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Mobile Energy Storage for Mitigating Voltage Problem in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the continuous increase in the penetration rate of intermittent renewable energy sources, the distribution grid may face multiple challenges in terms of system security and reliability, such as load leveling, peak shaving, voltage regulation, and emergency backup. The advancement of modern technology and the proliferation of high-rise buildings have promoted the development of distributed energy resources (DER). In this context, mobile power sources in conjunction with buildings can provide more flexible services to the distribution grid. This paper considers three types of DERs: distributed generators (DG), mobile energy storage systems (MESS), and demand response (DR), and proposes a joint scheduling model to optimize the operational cost of the distribution grid. The model also incorporates a 1-norm to optimize the number of activated MESS. The simulation analysis of this model is conducted on the IEEE 33-node system, and the results demonstrate that this optimization framework can reduce the number of activated devices and the operational cost of the system while maintaining system stability.

articleTitle: Analysis of Incentive Policies and Typical Models for Electric Vehicle Participation in the Market
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of China's electric vehicle market, the participation of electric vehicles in the electricity market has formed a certain scale and pattern. However, the problems of difficulty in consuming new energy and significant impact on the power grid still exist, which poses challenges to the construction of new power systems. Therefore, reasonably guiding the participation of electric vehicle loads in the electricity market is an important measure to solve the contradiction between electricity supply and demand. Reasonably guiding electric vehicle loads to participate in the power market is an important measure and strategic requirement to alleviate the contradiction between power supply and demand. This article first investigates the policies for electric vehicle participation in the market, including charging prices and encouraging participation in the market; Secondly, it introduces the current ways of electric vehicle participation in the market from three perspectives, and studies the specific pilot implementation of electric vehicles in different markets; Finally, by analyzing the typical models of electric vehicle operators participating in the market, the development direction of future electric vehicle participation in the market is summarized, providing certain theoretical support for the development of electric vehicle participation in the market.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technologies and Development Roadmap for Hydrogen in China
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the dual carbon goal, green hydrogen produced from renewable energy through electrolysis will become an important component of a more diversified clean energy system. The hydrogen system will interact closely with the power grid in the future. In this paper, the development trend of key technologies in the hydrogen industry is analyzed, and the development of hydrogen energy technology in China is compared with that abroad. Furthermore, the supply structure and consumption structure of hydrogen in the future is predicted, which pictures the development path of hydrogen in China in the future. The results presented in this paper could serve as an outlook and is of some importance to the hydrogen industry.

articleTitle: Study of the effect of low-dose gamma radiation on the surface properties of silicone rubber materials
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The effect of cosmic ray irradiation on the surface properties of silicone rubber insulators at high altitude is rarely reported. Aiming at the problem that the influence of cosmic rays on silicone rubber umbrella skirt materials at high altitude is not known, this paper carries out low-dose gamma-ray irradiation test of HTV silicone rubber materials and its surface property test. The dose of gamma-ray irradiation test was set at 0-9 kGy, and the performance tests included scanning electron microscopy, dispersive spectroscopy, Fourier infrared spectroscopy, hydrophobicity and hardness tests. The results showed that the holes and cracks on the surface of the specimen increased significantly after the irradiation dose exceeded 5 kGy; after irradiation, the relative atomic number of the element Al increased, while the other elements remained almost unchanged; analyzed by infrared spectroscopy, the Si-O-Si content on the surface of the silicone rubber increased and then decreased with the increase of the irradiation dose, and the Si-CH4 content also increased and then decreased with the increase of the gamma-ray irradiation dose; and finally, the Finally, the change rule of static contact angle is not obvious after low-dose gamma irradiation, and the hardness becomes larger. The results of this study can provide a reference for the operation and maintenance of silicone rubber insulators at high altitude.

articleTitle: Total Supply Capability Evaluation of Distribution Systems considering Soft Open Points and Network Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The increasing power demands in cities pose great challenges in power supply capacities of distribution networks. This paper introduces an emerged power electronic device, soft open point (SOP), and network reconfiguration to enhance the maximum total supply capability (TSC) of distribution networks. Unlike previous studies usually leverage simplified models, we propose an accurate mixed-integer second-order cone model to evaluate and optimize the TSC of a distribution networks, in which power flows and SOPs are precisely described. Simulation results confirm that employing SOPs can significantly enhance network TSC through active power transmission and reactive power compensation. Moreover, it can also reduce the power loss among the whole systems so that the energy-efficiency can be improved.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Variable Frequency and Phase-Shift Control Strategy of CLLLC Resonant Converter Based on LADRC
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The voltage gain range in the over-resonant region of CLLLC resonant converter under pulse frequency modulation (PFM) at light load is insufficient. Phase shift modulation (PSM) can only realize the buck function, and the load switching perturbation has a large impact on the output voltage. In response to the above problem this paper proposes a variable frequency and phase-shift control method that can freely switch the control mode according to the input voltage range to achieve a wide voltage range soft switching and output voltage stability. The system model is acquired by the extended descriptive function method and reduced to the second order. The second-order linear active disturbance rejection control (LADRC) strategy is introduced to reduce the impact of the load casting perturbation on the output voltage and improve the dynamic performance of the system. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the control strategy are verified by PLECS simulation.

articleTitle: Power Oscillation Suppression Method for Multi-Parallel Synchronverters
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: It is a promising solution to connect distributed generators (DGs) units to the grid via synchronverter.
