However, the differences between the parallel system composed of two synchronverters will affect the transient stability of the system, the fixed parameters cannot be applied to both steady state and dynamic state, which could threaten the stable operation of the system. Variable parameters using frequency or rate of change of frequency (ROCOF) are affected by grid voltage unbalance and harmonics. To solve this problem, a centralized virtual electromagnetic torque compensation control is proposed. In this paper, the reason of power oscillation of multi-VSG system is analyzed by taking the parallel system as an example. Based on this, a centralized virtual electromagnetic torque compensation control is proposed, and compared with the traditional control mode, the results show that the proposed control strategy can effectively reduce the oscillation frequency and attenuation coefficient of the system. A simulation model is built in Matlab/Simulink to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed control strategy over the traditional control.

articleTitle: Research on the Design Methodology of Integrated Energy System Evaluation System Considering Different Weighting Rates of Multiple Indicators
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Regarding the integrated energy system centered on a dual-source efficiency heat pump coupled with biomass-air energy, this paper proposes a design method for the evaluation system of the integrated energy system under the consideration of multiple indicators with different weighting rates, in order to solve the problems such as the difficulty of the capacity configuration, the evaluation complexity of later stage, and the difficulty of quantification. By combining the engineering practice, different capacity allocation schemes of renewable energies are given, and based on this, the simulation examples of eight sets of capacity allocation schemes under the dynamic change of the weighting rates of five indicators are established with full consideration of multiple indicators, such as renewable energy consumption rate, carbon emission, investment and operation economy, distribution grid capacity, COP and so on. The results show that the algorithm can calculate the comprehensive performance of different capacity allocation schemes under the changing weights of indicators, and the evaluation system helps to determine the best renewable energy capacity allocation scheme according to the engineering practice.

articleTitle: Real-time pricing method through market auction based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the development of distributed energy systems, pricing different energy sources in microgrids has become a significant challenge. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an real-time pricing method through market auction based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. The energy supply side provides different energy production and quotations, while consumers on the energy demand side freely quote and purchase the required energy in the energy market based on their own needs. The final transaction price of different energy sources is determined by the quotes of the buyer and seller who have reached the transaction. The simulation results indicate that the proposed pricing method have a good performance.

articleTitle: Study on the error characteristics of all-fiber-optic current transformers under extreme operating environments
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Statistics from the operation and maintenance department show that fiber optical current transformer(FOCT) has problems of accuracy degradation and high failure rate under extreme environment (extreme environment in this paper refers to extreme temperature). In this paper, the angle error and ratio error of FOCT are investigated in terms of delay and temperature, respectively. Firstly, the principle structure and optical wave transmission characteristics of FOCT are analyzed, and a transmission simulation model is established based on the operating principles of optical devices and FOCT. Finally, the error characteristics of FOCT are studied in terms of angle error and ratio error based on the simulation model. The research results can provide a theoretical basis for the fault analysis and operational reliability improvement of FOCT.

articleTitle: Resilience-Constrained Planning of Energy Hub Considering Waste Heat Reuse of Data Center
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In recent years, extreme natural disasters such as typhoons, earthquakes and floods have caused serious disruptions to energy supplies, raising awareness of the threat of extreme events. In this paper, a novel resilience-constrained planning method for the energy hub (EH) is proposed, in which the waste heat from the data center (DC) is used to improve the resilience of the EH against seismic events. First, the EH model and resilience analysis methodology are introduced based on the energy bus, in which the tight coupling of various energy devices before and after seismic events can be described conveniently. Then, the model of DC is formulated from various aspects, i.e., computing process, thermodynamic process, multi-energy consumption, waste heat reuse, service quality. On this basis, the resilience-constrained planning model of EH is established. Case studies indicate that the waste heat reuse of DC can enhance the resilience of EH to extreme seismic events.

articleTitle: Research on the application of energy consumption monitoring technology in the construction of pumped storage power station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Pumped storage power station plays an important role in peak shaving, frequency regulation, voltage regulation, phase regulation and accident backup in the power grid, and the safety of the power system of the plant will directly affect the operation reliability of the power station due to frequent start and stop of the unit. In this paper, the principle of energy consumption monitoring technology, the composition, application scenarios and energy consumption evaluation methods of pumped storage power station energy consumption monitoring system are studied. Based on the integrated platform, the intelligent application of energy consumption monitoring system is developed, which realizes real-time monitoring, fault warning and positioning of energy consumption of plant power equipment, analyzes energy efficiency indicators, analyzes energy utilization and energy loss in the production process, and realizes the optimization and improvement of energy efficiency management system.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Phase Shifter Interconnection on Differential Protection of 110kV Power Network
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The phase shifter has good power flow regulation characteristics, can achieve large phase angle adjustment, and has certain economic benefits in investment and land occupation, making it increasingly widely used in power grids. Firstly, the basic operating principle and voltage regulation method of the phase shifter were analyzed. Then, based on different types of differential protection criteria, the malfunction and rejection of the phase shifter under single-phase ground fault, two-phase ground fault, two-phase inter-phase fault, and three-phase short circuit fault were analyzed. The results show that both the separated phase current differential protection (CDP) corrected by the voltage at both ends of the line and the positive sequence CDP corrected by the positive sequence voltage at both ends of the line will experience malfunction and rejection. However, the positive sequence CDP corrected by the gear information (assuming that the protection can measure the gear information of the phase shifter) can operate correctly in the event of an internal fault, and when there is an external fault, it can be relied on without malfunction.

articleTitle: Output Impedance Reshaping of Grid-connected Inverter Based on Voltage Feedforward under Extremely Weak Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Aiming at the stability problem of grid-connected inverter under extremely weak grid, firstly, the q-axis output impedance model is constructed, and the stability margin of grid-connected inverter under extremely weak grid is analyzed. Then, an accurate transfer function of output impedance reshaping strategy based on the voltage feedforward is constructed, which can improve the phase-frequency characteristics of the output impedance without changing the amplitude-frequency characteristics at the intersection frequency, and thus improve the stability. However, the discretization of the above transfer function is relatively complicated. Considering the output impedance characteristics under extremely weak grid, the voltage feedforward transfer function is simplified and optimized under the condition that the amplitude of output impedance phase boosting does not produce large deviation and the complexity of engineering implementation is much reduced. Finally, the hardware-in-loop simulation results verify the effectiveness of output impedance reshaping strategy.

articleTitle: Short-term Wind Power Prediction Based on Error Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Highly reliable wind power prediction is a crucial assurance for the large-scale integration of renewable energy into the power system. In order to enhance the accuracy of wind power prediction, this paper proposes a short-term wind power prediction method based on error estimation. Firstly, using historical data from numerical weather prediction (NWP) as input, a bi-directional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) network model is employed for preliminary wind power prediction. Preliminary prediction errors are calculated based on the prediction results. Subsequently, an Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) algorithm is utilized to build a learning model capable of efficiently estimating BiLSTM’s prediction errors. This facilitates rapid estimation of BiLSTM’s preliminary prediction errors when provided with future NWP data for a certain period. Furthermore, the error estimation is incorporated with the preliminary prediction results to yield the improved wind power predication. Finally, the proposed method is tested with real data collected from a wind farm, and comparative results with various mainstream wind power prediction methods demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in enhancing the performance of short-term wind power predictions.

articleTitle: Optimal Spot Market Trading of Electricity Service Provider under Renewable Energy and Price Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In the context of electricity market reform and the increasing integration of renewable energy, electricity service provider (ESP) has assumed the role of intermediaries in electricity market transactions. However, the unpredictability of renewable energy and the uncertainty of load demand expose ESPs to market risks during spot market transactions. To address these issues, this study first develops an operation model for ESP under spot market transactions. Subsequently, leveraging the credibility theory, the spot electricity price and electricity load are treated as fuzzy variables, and a fuzzy chance constraint model is formulated to address multiple uncertainties. The model aims to maximize the realization of optimal spot market transactions for ESPs while considering both expected operating costs and operation risks arising from various uncertainties. Finally, numerical analysis is conducted on the IEEE 33-node distribution network to evaluate the proposed model. Various scenarios with different levels of uncertain risk factors are set to examine the model's performance. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the model in optimizing spot market transactions for ESP under multiple uncertainties.

articleTitle: Random Comprehensive Dispatching of Distribution Network Based on Expected Value Model
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Due to the strong volatility and uncertainty of renewable energy output, which is directly influenced by factors such as weather and the environment, it has brought numerous adverse effects to the operation of the power distribution grid, posing new challenges for its safety, stability, and economic performance. In response to this issue, this paper proposes a comprehensive scheduling method for power distribution grids that simultaneously considers network reconfiguration and capacitor bank switching under the conditions of uncertain distributed energy source output. Through simulation calculations on practical examples, it has been verified that the proposed comprehensive scheduling method for power distribution grids can significantly reduce system operating costs and improve power supply quality.

articleTitle: Coordinated Operation Strategy for Multi-application Scenarios of Energy Storage in Traction Supply Power System Considering Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The economic benefits of energy storage system (ESS) acting in a single application scenario are not high, and the traction load is stochastic, resulting in further weakening of the energy and power balance capability of the traction power supply system (TPSS) and affecting the dispatch operation of the traction substation. In view of the above problems, a synergistic operation strategy is proposed for the ESS to participate in both peak shaving and valley filling and plan tracking application scenarios at the same time. Firstly, the ESS capacity allocation of multi-application scenarios is quantitatively evaluated by energy storage capacity coefficients, and the day-ahead scheduling plan of the traction substation is investigated according to the optimal return under the traction load peak shaving and valley filling application scenarios, based on which the coordinated and optimal scheduling model of multi-application scenarios based on chance constraint planning is constructed by taking into consideration the uncertainty of the prediction error of the traction load to determine the optimal operation strategy of the ESS. Based on the actual data of a traction substation, different schemes are set up to compare and verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, and the impact of confidence level on penalty cost is analyzed.

articleTitle: DC bias suppression strategy for dual active bridge DC-DC Converter based on generalized second-order differentiation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In this paper, a generalized second order differentiator is constructed for the first time to solve the DC bias problem of DAB. Compared to traditional differential functions, the generalized second-order differentiator retains the differential effect of phase advance compensation for a specific frequency range, and eliminates the inherent high-frequency noise amplification problem of differentiation through a constructor. At the same time, it can freely adjust the amplitude characteristics of the phase advance compensation frequency range. This method is based on the traditional PI closed-loop control, By incorporating a parallel compensation control loop based on a generalized second-order differentiator, the DC bias of the inductance current is suppressed and the output ripple is reduced. Finally, the effectiveness of the control method was verified through MATLAB/Simulink simulation

articleTitle: Optimization Design of the Black Start Process of Auxiliary Power Supply System for Shenzhen Pumped Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper describes the technical optimization of the black start process of auxiliary power supply system for Shenzhen Pumped Storage Power Station in terms of automatic identification of power grid working status and the reduction of system impulse current, which reducing the risk of human failure, increasing the success rate of the black start of power plant auxiliary power system, implementing the function of the quick start of pumped storage power station unit in case of power grid accident.

Author Keywords: automatic identification of power grid working status

articleTitle: Auxiliary modelling error and probability density function based neuro-fuzzy short-term wind power prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Accurate wind power forecasting not only optimizes the power supply structure of integrated energy system but also promotes the development of a low-carbon power industry. However, modeling and predicting wind power sequence using conventional forecasting methods can be hard due to its high volatility and intermittent nature. Thus this study proposes a hybrid model comprising the subsequent steps to improve the prediction accuracy. Firstly, the wind power sequence is denoised and the primary characteristics of the raw data are found using an ensemble empirical mode decomposition algorithm. Secondly, in order to achieve high precision, this paper propose an auxiliary modelling error and probability density function based Neuro-Fuzzy model (NFM) applied in wind power prediction. In particular, an innovative hybrid parameter identification algorithm is constructed by using auxiliary modelling error and probability density function (PDF) to identify parameters of the proposed NFM. This is auxiliary error converges to the invariant set based on Lyapunov’s global convergence, and then converting parameter updating into shape control of PDF for auxiliary modeling error, which follows a target pdf to update model parameters. The experiment demonstrates a considerable improvement in accuracy in comparison to the separate models.

articleTitle: Improved droop control strategy for AC microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Traditional droop control is characterized by no interconnecting wires and easy redundancy control which can be applied to microgrid is composed of both photovoltaic (PV) and battery energy storage (BES) components to realize the "plug-and-play" characteristics of PV and BES inverters. Therefore, droop control is widely used in the AC microgrid. Nevertheless, photovoltaic power generation is irregular, variable and unpredictable while AC microgrid loads remain unsteady, conventional droop control is less resilient to these disturbances and cannot ensure rapid power tracking. Considering the limitations of the conventional droop control method, virtual-based impedance control is performed in the control circuit using the inverter's own output voltage signal instead of the current signal. It has been enhanced to achieve stable AC microgrid voltage output and quick power tracking capability without compromising the system's stability. The effectiveness of the control method has been verified through simulations.

articleTitle: A Deep Convolutional Embedded Clustering Method for Scenario Reduction of Production Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Renewable energy has significant seasonal characteristics and random and fluctuating features, which bring great challenges to the planning and operation of power systems. Typical scenarios of production simulation can provide a decision-making basis for the formulation of dispatch and operation modes, which is significant for the planning and operation of the power system. To obtain the representative production simulation scenarios, a method for scenario reduction based on deep convolutional embedded clustering (DCEC) is proposed in this paper. The convolutional self-encoder is used to reduce dimension and extract features from the high-dimensional production simulation data, and input to the clustering layer to obtain the initial clustering centers. A joint loss function combining clustering loss and reconstruction loss is established, and the final clustering results are obtained by iterative update. The clustering evaluation index Calinski-Harabaz index score and Silhouette coefficient are used to analyze the clustering results, and the results verified the validity of the typical scenarios of production simulation obtained by DCEC aggregation.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Allocation Strategy of Hybrid Energy Storage for Wind-Photovoltaic Hybrid Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In view of the influence of wind power output fluctuation on the reliable operation of power system, an optimal energy storage strategy is proposed to stabilize the grid-connected power fluctuation. A hybrid energy storage target output power control scheme based on model predictive control is established, and a hybrid energy storage power allocation strategy based on adaptive method is proposed to complete the adaptive adjustment and optimal allocation of hybrid energy storage output power. The simulation results show that the hybrid energy storage optimal allocation scheme proposed in this paper can effectively stabilize the fluctuation of grid-connected power, and has good engineering practical value for the distribution network system with high proportion of new energy.

articleTitle: Accident Warning and Calculation of Accident Spray Volume for Desulfurization System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In a bypass-free degasification wet scrubber power plant, reliable operation of the absorption tower is an important prerequisite for the safe and stable operation of the plant, so an accidental spraying system is an essential safeguard for the plant. In order to improve the safe and stable operation of the power plant, this paper designs an accident warning system for the FGD system based on the actual operating data of the limestone-gypsum wet FGD plant of a 600MW unit boiler, to provide early warning before a fault condition occurs, realising real-time temperature information data comparison, trend analysis and abnormal alarm. It also simply and accurately calculates the amount of cooling water required for flue gas accident spraying in the event of an accident, and provides guidance on the operation of the plant for accident handling.

articleTitle: Study On Fine Simulation Method Of Wind Field In Complex Terrain
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Under the severe challenge of global energy shortage and climate warming, wind energy as a renewable energy has been paid more and more attention by all countries. With the rapid development of wind power in recent years, more and more wind farms are built in complex terrain areas. Since the surface characteristics of complex terrain have a great impact on small and micro-scale wind field characteristics, it is necessary to obtain detailed information of local wind field characteristics to guide the accurate location selection of wind turbines. To solve the above problems, a set of numerical simulation methods is established in this paper, which can quickly reconstruct the three-dimensional surface model and simulate the wind field characteristics in the complex terrain area, and provide a basis for the precise location selection of wind turbines. Firstly, this paper establishes a set of surface reconstruction algorithm to generate structured or unstructured surface grids based on geographic information data (GIS), and proposes automatic waste point repair algorithm and grid generation algorithm, which greatly improves the grid generation efficiency. Then, according to the characteristics of atmospheric boundary layer, the self-preserving boundary conditions of atmospheric boundary layer are established, which can simulate atmospheric boundary layer flow. Finally, a CFD solver is established to simulate the wind field. The solver adopts the finite volume method to discrete, the convective term has second-order accuracy, and the SIMPLE algorithm is used to solve the RANS equations. For the turbulent flow field in complex terrain, the turbulence model and optimized wall function are developed in this paper to solve the turbulence, which supports large-scale parallel computation. The test results show that the surface reconstruction method proposed in this paper can quickly and accurately construct complex surface grids, and the flow field simulation model has good accuracy and large-scale parallel computation capability, which is suitable for wind field simulation in complex terrain environment.

articleTitle: Enhanced Power Synchronization Based Vector Control with Fault Ride Through for VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The power synchronization based vector control is proposed with the power synchronization controller (PSC) replacing the conventional phase locked loop (PLL) recently. It is reported that the power synchronization unit can have comparable performance of the conventional PLL based vector control. However, the steady state analysis of the PSC control dq frame orientation and the corresponding steady equilibrium points are not discussed. Worse more, fault ride through of the PSC based vector control is not addressed in the related literatures. First, the measurements error on the performance on PSC based vector control is analyzed and the enhanced PSC based vector control is proposed to further reduce the control complexity. Based on the enhanced PSC based vector control, the equilibrium points and the dq frame orientation of PSC based vector control and its comparison with PLL based one are analyzed in the normal operation. After that, the fault ride through strategy is proposed with consideration of equilibrium point. Finally, simulations using PSC based vector control for voltage source converter based high voltage dc transmission station (VSC-HVDC) are carried out to verify the analysis.

articleTitle: Power-Imbalance Stimulation and Internal-Voltage Response Relationships Based Modeling Method of Multi-Timescale PE-Interfaced Device
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy in power systems, frequency and voltage dynamics that the focus of the system depends more and more on the frequency and amplitude response characteristics of power electronic (PE)-interfaced devices under power imbalance. Due to the different timescale energy storage elements and controls of the device involved in system dynamics, multi-timescale (about 10ms level to 100ms level) dynamic problems, which are different from those of conventional power systems, appear in the system. However, the multi-timescale characteristics of the PE-interfaced device during system frequency and voltage dynamics are not intuitively illustrated by the existing structure-oriented models. Thus, this paper aims to propose a function-oriented modeling methodology of the multi-timescale PE-interfaced device based on power-imbalance stimulation and internal-voltage response relationships. According to the multi-timescale structure of the device, the dynamics of the internal voltage amplitude/frequency depends on the different timescale energy storage elements and controls of the device. By analyzing the mechanism of the formation of the internal voltage amplitude/frequency with different timescale components in response to the active/reactive power imbalance, the model of the multi-timescale PE-interfaced device is proposed. Based on the model, the similarities and differences between the characteristics of the PE-interfaced device and SG are recognized.

articleTitle: The Impact of Carbon Emission Trading Pilot Policy on Energy Security
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Energy security is a concern for national security, and as environmental problems have become more prominent, environmental governance policies have become more wide -ranging, and the effectiveness of curbing carbon emissions has been continuously highlighted. However, since China's environmental governance is still in its early childhood, the path of balancing environmental, energy, and economic development remains to be determined. This paper, first, measure the level of energy security using entropy TOPSIS with 30 provinces as the research sample from 2008 to 2019, and then using carbon emissions trading pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment, looks at the effect of environmental governance policies on energy security using Lasso and multi-period DID models. and it further tests heterogeneity by region and energy security index subsample. Results indicate that the pilot carbon emissions trading strategy impairs energy security, however, this effect is not significant in the western region, which is resource-rich, and on the environmental security index. The research offers governance concepts for China's environmental governance policy development and maintenance of energy security.

articleTitle: Flexibility and Operation Economy of Cogeneration Unit with Air-cooled Condenser and High Back Pressure Heating System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The flexibility transformation of existing fossil-fired power generation units should conform stringently to regulatory rules set by the government authorities. The peak regulation capacity of co-generation units is restricted due to the coupling characteristics of thermal-electric production. The operational flexibility of co-generation with ACC and high back pressure heating system configuration was addressed. The model-based software suite EBSILON was employed for performance simulation of a 660MW supercritical co-generation unit with ACC and high back pressure heating system arrangement. The peaking load capability and heating fuel expenditure under three heating modes and various district heating load conditions were analyzed. To prevent ventilation and excessively elevated temperatures of the LPT final stage blading, the LPT exhaust steam volumetric flow rate must be meticulously checked. Results indicate that the minimum peaking power output of 207.91MW, 270.25MW is attained under ESH heating mode and HBPH mode respectively, which corresponds to 31.5% and 40.95% of the rated load. Based on the coal consumption per GJ heating curves established under various heating modes, a priority analysis of three heating modes was conducted. In most circumstances, the three modes are arranged in the order of the optimal economic efficiency: HBPH mode, HBPH+ESH mode, and ESH mode. An algorithm for computation of the standard coal flow rate under certain heating mode was proposed, which would facilitate the prediction of fuel cost when the studied co-generation unit is in operation optimization with other units. The peak load regulating capability and coal consumption per GJ heating curves established under various heating modes will assist to fully harness the peak shaving potential of the co-generation and achieve better fuel cost economies.

articleTitle: A Demand Side Adjustable Load Cluster Regulation Method Based on Alternating Direction Multiplier Method
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: On the demand side, a large number of adjustable load clusters are connected to the distribution network as diversified stakeholders. In order to reduce its electricity cost and improve the local consumption rate of new energy, it is necessary to study the fine control strategy of adjustable load cluster to guide its optimal operation when connected to the distribution network. This paper proposes a demand-side adjustable load cluster control method. Firstly, a cooperative game model of multi-adjustable load cluster is established based on Nash negotiation theory. Then, the revenue is distributed in an asymmetric bargaining manner, and the objective function is decomposed into two subproblems: alliance cost minimization and intra-cluster revenue distribution. Finally, the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is used to solve the problem iteratively. The example verification shows that the proposed method has good convergence performance and computational efficiency, gives full play to the regulation potential of the adjustable load cluster, and effectively reduces the operating cost.

articleTitle: Asymmetrical High-Voltage Ride Through of Brushless Doubly Fed Induction Generators for the Wind Power Generation Based on Improved Indirect Power Control
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper analyzes and deduces the transient currents of the control winding (CW) of the brushless doubly fed induction generator (BDFIG) during an asymmetric voltage rapid-rise fault in the power grid. It indicates that restraining the overcurrent of the CW is not the key solution to the asymmetric high-voltage ride through issue of the BDFIG. Meanwhile, the relationship between the CW flux linkage, active and reactive power of the power winding (PW), and the electromagnetic torque during the fault is analyzed. The analysis results demonstrate that in order to eliminate the second harmonic components in reactive power and electromagnetic torque, negative sequence components need to be injected into the CW flux linkage. An improved indirect power control strategy is proposed, and a system structure diagram is constructed. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy, significantly mitigating the second harmonic components in reactive power and torque during asymmetric fault conditions, this reduces the pressure on the drive train and enhances the fault-ride-through capability of the BDFIG.

Author Keywords: Asymmetric high voltage fault ride through

articleTitle: Non-Destructive Testing of Reinforced Concrete Utility Poles Based on Electromagnetic Induction
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The power industry plays a crucial role as a key foundational sector in the national economy and social development. Reinforced concrete is widely used in various power infrastructure projects, where the quality of the reinforcing steel directly influences the component's resistance to shear, bending, torsion, and earthquake resistance. When the internal steel reinforcement is not designed properly or does not meet the required standards, the overall performance of the reinforced concrete will be severely compromised, leading to significant safety hazards. The quality and safety of reinforced concrete electrical poles used in distribution power lines directly impact the secure operation of the power system. Therefore, during the production, inspection, and maintenance of reinforced concrete electrical poles, it is necessary to conduct non-destructive testing on the quantity, diameter, position, and thickness of the protective layer of the internal steel reinforcement. Thus, researching a nondestructive testing method for assessing the quality of reinforced concrete electrical poles is essential. The non-destructive testing method utilized in this study is based on the electromagnetic induction effect, which utilizes the eddy current effect generated by a magnetic field to test and study the internal steel reinforcement's position, protective layer thickness, spacing, and diameter within the concrete structure. Experimental results indicate that this method accurately measures the position, orientation, distribution, and protective layer thickness of the steel reinforcement inside the electrical poles, providing valuable references for future testing of reinforced concrete electrical poles.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Transmission Characteristics of AC power grid
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: With the access of a large number of power electronic devices, the harmonic isusse of power grid is becoming more and more prominent. Harmonics can be transferred between different voltage levels and the same voltage level in the AC power grid, and assessment of harmonic transfer characteristics is the basis for harmonic management. The transmission characteristics of harmonic voltage and harmonic current between different voltage levels are analyzed, and the transmission characteristics of harmonics caused by AC overhead lines in the same voltage level grid are studied. The research in this paper can provide theoretical basis for the transmission of harmonics in large power grids.

articleTitle: Frequency Stability Analysis and Optimal Control Method in DG-BESS Microgrid System
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Microgrid with diesel generator (DG) as main source has the characteristics of low inertia and slow dynamic response. In this paper, the model of diesel generator system is first established to analyzes the impact on transient state due to main parameters, including inertia and response delay. The energy storage system (ESS) with auxiliary frequency regulation is used to improve the dynamic response of system and the parameter design method of auxiliary frequency regulation is given. In addition, a small signal model of DG-ESS system is established to prove the stability of the system. Finally, the experimental platform of DG-ESS microgrid is built, and the test results prove that the auxiliary frequency regulation of ESS can reduce the frequency transient fluctuation under the change of static load or motor load. Therefore, the experiment verifies the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Control strategy for energy storage batteries participating in secondary frequency regulation considering the frequency characteristics of the power grid
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: In response to the increasing application of battery energy storage in frequency regulation of thermal power units, but its output control method is not perfect, this paper designs a comprehensive control strategy for secondary frequency regulation of thermal power units assisted by energy storage batteries based on the frequency characteristics of the power grid. Firstly, based on the control deviation (ACE) signal of the secondary frequency regulation area of the thermal power unit, considering the output characteristics of the energy storage battery and the unit, a Butterworth low-pass filter is designed to decompose the ACE signal into high-frequency and low-frequency signals, and allocate the high-frequency signal to the energy storage battery and low-frequency signal to the thermal power unit. Secondly, considering the state of charge (SOC) of the energy storage battery, the control strategy of the energy storage output is designed based on the Sigmoid function; And design frequency modulation intervals based on frequency characteristics to achieve coordinated operation of thermal power units and battery energy storage. Finally, a simulation model is built in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the control strategy through simulation. The results show that the control strategy proposed in this article can improve the frequency modulation effect and maintain a good state of SOC.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Short-Circuit Current Restricted Rules Based on Fusion of Gaussian Mixture Model and Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The problem of excessive short-circuit current is becoming more serious and short-circuit current restricted rules are difficult to formulate. Therefore, an identification method of short-circuit current restricted rule is proposed based on Gaussian mixture model and decision tree. Firstly, the influence of equipment shutdown on short-circuit current distribution is analyzed based on the principle of short-circuit current superposition. Short-circuit current distribution is fitted by Gaussian mixture model which is used to judge the existence of short-circuit current restricted rules. Then, short-circuit current restricted rules are extracted by fusion method of short-circuit current sensitivity, Gaussian mixture model and C4.5 decision tree. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm proposed in this paper is verified based on an example of a provincial power grid. Compared with the classical decision tree, the proposed method can avoid the risk of violating physical laws of safety and stability rules extracted by machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on High Voltage High Capacity Multi-port Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Energy routers are key devices that promote the utilization and consumption of new energy resources, as well as achieve energy conversion and routing. This article proposes a new idea of high-voltage and large-capacity energy routers for regional energy management. A 110kV seven-port energy router electrical topology is constructed, consisting of three modular multi-level AC/DC converters, three bidirectional DC/DC transformers, and one DC circuit breaker. A detailed analysis is conducted on four different operating modes and the respective control strategies of the energy router. The VF droop controller is designed, including voltage droop control and frequency droop control. For demonstration engineering applications, an energy router start stop control logic has been designed. Finally, the effectiveness of the control strategy proposed in this paper is verified through the switching test waveforms between the main operation mode and auxiliary operation mode on the demonstration project site.

articleTitle: Time-varying correlation analysis and modeling of distributed renewable energy joint output based on time-varying Copula
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: The uncertainty and correlation of distributed renewable energy, represented by wind power and photovoltaic, which are connected to the power grid on a large scale, are posing new difficulties for the operation and planning of the power grid. According to the limitation of conventional static Copula function which is unable to accurately describe the time-varying correlation of distributed renewable energy (DRE) joint output, this paper proposes a time-varying Copula-based modeling method for the time-varying correlation of the wind-solar power joint output, and studies time-varying correlation of the wind-solar joint output. Firstly, the marginal probability distributions of the output of PV and wind power are obtained separately using nonparametric kernel density estimation method. Secondly, the time-varying Copula function is used to construct the wind-solar power joint output model, the time-varying correlation coefficient is applied to describe correlation of joint output. The superiority of the time-varying Copula compared to the conventional static Copula is verified using the goodness-of-fit test method. Finally, the measured data of a distributed PV station and a distributed wind farm in a region of Jiangsu Province in China in 2020 are taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Calculation Method of Recovering and Replenishing Electricity Based on Load Curve Restoration
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Electric energy metering device is an important guarantee for fair and just settlement between power companies and customers. When the metering device fails, it will cause metering errors, and it is necessary to calculate the supplementary power. Aiming at the shortcomings of the current power supplementary calculation methods, this paper proposes a power supplementary calculation method based on load curve data. The scientificity of the method is demonstrated through uncertainty evaluation, and the comparison and verification are carried out with actual case data. The results show that the calculation method has high accuracy and can be popularized and applied in practical work.

articleTitle: Data Self-Expansion and DoppelGANger-Based Time-Series Modeling for Realistic Steam Data Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: Steam heating is an essential component of numerous industrial production processes that consume energy extensively. In particular, steam data are of significant commercial interest, and the privacy of the heat suppliers and steam users for whom this data is confidential is of paramount importance. However, the complexity and intricacy of steam data make it challenging to generate realistic samples using conventional data generation algorithms. This paper proposes a self-expansion data process method that multiplies samples with a coarser granularity. We then apply the time-series generation model, DoppelGANger, to steam data. Post-processing for the generated data is implemented to eliminate the effects of a certain level of noise. To validate the proposed method and model, we conduct experiments using field data obtained from a thermopower company. The results indicate that DoppelGANger can capture the steam operating characteristics and generate realistic samples reflecting steam data patterns. The difference between the statistic metrics of the true and generated samples is around 2.87%. The mean DTW distance of features’ principal components is around 16.32. Overall, this study offers a promising workflow for data generation across many steam system scenarios. This approach is valuable for energy management, privacy protection, and data sharing in industrial domains.

articleTitle: A novel medical waste-to-hydrogen design based on plasma gasification
publicationTitle: 2023 8th International Conference on Power and Renewable Energy (ICPRE)
abstract: This paper proposes A novel medical waste-to-hydrogen design based on plasma gasification. The new system makes use of the syngas exported from the plasma gasifier to produce hydrogen, and by recovering the waste heat of the process, it greatly improves the energy utilization efficiency, solves the waste pollution problem, and alleviates the energy scarcity problem, and reduces carbon emissions. The combination of both energy analysis and exergy analysis are used to effectively promote the optimization and development of the system to achieve the reduction, harmlessness, and resourceful disposal of medical waste. 131.17 kg/h of hydrogen is produced by the novel system when 833.33 kg/h of medical waste is consumed. The process efficiency of the novel system can reach 70.73%. The novel system has a total exergy loss of 2.25 MW and a process exergy efficiency of 65.39. The results of the thermodynamic analysis show that the novel system is efficient and feasible.
